vulg: initium evangelii Iesu Christi Filii Dei
clem: Initium Evangelii Jesu Christi, Filii Dei.
tr: αρχη του ευαγγελιου ιησου χριστου υιου του θεου
kjv: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;

vulg: sicut scriptum est in Esaia propheta ecce mitto angelum meum ante faciem tuam qui praeparabit viam tuam
clem: Sicut scriptum est in Isaia propheta: [Ecce ego mitto angelum meum ante faciem tuam, qui prparabit viam tuam ante te.
tr: ως γεγραπται εν τοις προφηταις ιδου εγω αποστελλω τον αγγελον μου προ προσωπου σου ος κατασκευασει την οδον σου εμπροσθεν σου
kjv: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

vulg: vox clamantis in deserto parate viam Domini rectas facite semitas eius
clem: Vox clamantis in deserto: Parate viam Domini, rectas facite semitas ejus.]
tr: φωνη βοωντος εν τη ερημω ετοιμασατε την οδον κυριου ευθειας ποιειτε τας τριβους αυτου
kjv: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

vulg: fuit Iohannes in deserto baptizans et praedicans baptismum paenitentiae in remissionem peccatorum
clem: Fuit Joannes in deserto baptizans, et prdicans baptismum pnitenti in remissionem peccatorum.
tr: εγενετο ιωαννης βαπτιζων εν τη ερημω και κηρυσσων βαπτισμα μετανοιας εις αφεσιν αμαρτιων
kjv: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.

vulg: et egrediebatur ad illum omnis Iudaeae regio et Hierosolymitae universi et baptizabantur ab illo in Iordane flumine confitentes peccata sua
clem: Et egrediebatur ad eum omnis Jud regio, et Jerosolymit universi, et baptizabantur ab illo in Jordanis flumine, confitentes peccata sua.
tr: και εξεπορευετο προς αυτον πασα η ιουδαια χωρα και οι ιεροσολυμιται και εβαπτιζοντο παντες εν τω ιορδανη ποταμω υπ αυτου εξομολογουμενοι τας αμαρτιας αυτων
kjv: And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.

vulg: et erat Iohannes vestitus pilis cameli et zona pellicia circa lumbos eius et lucustas et mel silvestre edebat
clem: Et erat Joannes vestitus pilis cameli, et zona pellicea circa lumbos ejus, et locustas et mel silvestre edebat.
tr: ην δε ιωαννης ενδεδυμενος τριχας καμηλου και ζωνην δερματινην περι την οσφυν αυτου και εσθιων ακριδας και μελι αγριον
kjv: And John was clothed with camel's hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;

vulg: et praedicabat dicens venit fortior me post me cuius non sum dignus procumbens solvere corrigiam calciamentorum eius
clem: Et prdicabat dicens: Venit fortior post me, cujus non sum dignus procumbens solvere corrigiam calceamentorum ejus.
tr: και εκηρυσσεν λεγων ερχεται ο ισχυροτερος μου οπισω μου ου ουκ ειμι ικανος κυψας λυσαι τον ιμαντα των υποδηματων αυτου
kjv: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.

vulg: ego baptizavi vos aqua ille vero baptizabit vos Spiritu Sancto
clem: Ego baptizavi vos aqua, ille vero baptizabit vos Spiritu Sancto.
tr: εγω μεν εβαπτισα υμας εν υδατι αυτος δε βαπτισει υμας εν πνευματι αγιω
kjv: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.

vulg: et factum est in diebus illis venit Iesus a Nazareth Galilaeae et baptizatus est in Iordane ab Iohanne
clem: Et factum est: in diebus illis venit Jesus a Nazareth Galil: et baptizatus est a Joanne in Jordane.
tr: και εγενετο εν εκειναις ταις ημεραις ηλθεν  ιησους απο ναζαρετ  ναζαρεθ  της γαλιλαιας και εβαπτισθη υπο ιωαννου εις τον ιορδανην
kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.

vulg: et statim ascendens de aqua vidit apertos caelos et Spiritum tamquam columbam descendentem et manentem in ipso
clem: Et statim ascendens de aqua, vidit clos apertos, et Spiritum tamquam columbam descendentem, et manentem in ipso.
tr: και ευθεως αναβαινων απο του υδατος ειδεν σχιζομενους τους ουρανους και το πνευμα ωσει περιστεραν καταβαινον επ αυτον
kjv: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:

vulg: et vox facta est de caelis tu es Filius meus dilectus in te conplacui
clem: Et vox facta est de clis: Tu es Filius meus dilectus, in te complacui.
tr: και φωνη εγενετο εκ των ουρανων συ ει ο υιος μου ο αγαπητος εν ω ευδοκησα
kjv: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

vulg: et statim Spiritus expellit eum in desertum
clem: Et statim Spiritus expulit eum in desertum.
tr: και ευθυς το πνευμα αυτον εκβαλλει εις την ερημον
kjv: And immediately the spirit driveth him into the wilderness.

vulg: et erat in deserto quadraginta diebus et quadraginta noctibus et temptabatur a Satana eratque cum bestiis et angeli ministrabant illi
clem: Et erat in deserto quadraginta diebus, et quadraginta noctibus: et tentabatur a Satana: eratque cum bestiis, et angeli ministrabant illi.
tr: και ην εκει εν τη ερημω ημερας τεσσαρακοντα πειραζομενος υπο του σατανα και ην μετα των θηριων και οι αγγελοι διηκονουν αυτω
kjv: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.

vulg: postquam autem traditus est Iohannes venit Iesus in Galilaeam praedicans evangelium regni Dei
clem: Postquam autem traditus est Joannes, venit Jesus in Galilam, prdicans Evangelium regni Dei,
tr: μετα δε το παραδοθηναι τον ιωαννην ηλθεν ο ιησους εις την γαλιλαιαν κηρυσσων το ευαγγελιον της βασιλειας του θεου
kjv: Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,

vulg: et dicens quoniam impletum est tempus et adpropinquavit regnum Dei paenitemini et credite evangelio
clem: et dicens: Quoniam impletum est tempus, et appropinquavit regnum Dei: pnitemini, et credite Evangelio.
tr: και λεγων οτι πεπληρωται ο καιρος και ηγγικεν η βασιλεια του θεου μετανοειτε και πιστευετε εν τω ευαγγελιω
kjv: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.

vulg: et praeteriens secus mare Galilaeae vidit Simonem et Andream fratrem eius mittentes retia in mare erant enim piscatores
clem: Et prteriens secus mare Galil, vidit Simonem, et Andream fratrem ejus, mittentes retia in mare (erant enim piscatores),
tr: περιπατων δε παρα την θαλασσαν της γαλιλαιας ειδεν σιμωνα και ανδρεαν τον αδελφον αυτου βαλλοντας αμφιβληστρον εν τη θαλασση ησαν γαρ αλιεις
kjv: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

vulg: et dixit eis Iesus venite post me et faciam vos fieri piscatores hominum
clem: et dixit eis Jesus: Venite post me, et faciam vos fieri piscatores hominum.
tr: και ειπεν αυτοις ο ιησους δευτε οπισω μου και ποιησω υμας γενεσθαι αλιεις ανθρωπων
kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.

vulg: et protinus relictis retibus secuti sunt eum
clem: Et protinus relictis retibus, secuti sunt eum.
tr: και ευθεως αφεντες τα δικτυα αυτων ηκολουθησαν αυτω
kjv: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.

vulg: et progressus inde pusillum vidit Iacobum Zebedaei et Iohannem fratrem eius et ipsos in navi conponentes retia
clem: Et progressus inde pusillum, vidit Jacobum Zebedi, et Joannem fratrem ejus, et ipsos componentes retia in navi:
tr: και προβας εκειθεν ολιγον ειδεν ιακωβον τον του ζεβεδαιου και ιωαννην τον αδελφον αυτου και αυτους εν τω πλοιω καταρτιζοντας τα δικτυα
kjv: And when he had gone a little farther thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.

vulg: et statim vocavit illos et relicto patre suo Zebedaeo in navi cum mercennariis secuti sunt eum
clem: et statim vocavit illos. Et relicto patre suo Zebedo in navi cum mercenariis, secuti sunt eum.
tr: και ευθεως εκαλεσεν αυτους και αφεντες τον πατερα αυτων ζεβεδαιον εν τω πλοιω μετα των μισθωτων απηλθον οπισω αυτου
kjv: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.

vulg: et ingrediuntur Capharnaum et statim sabbatis ingressus synagogam docebat eos
clem: Et ingrediuntur Capharnaum: et statim sabbatis ingressus in synagogam, docebat eos.
tr: και εισπορευονται εις καπερναουμ και ευθεως τοις σαββασιν εισελθων εις την συναγωγην εδιδασκεν
kjv: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.

vulg: et stupebant super doctrina eius erat enim docens eos quasi potestatem habens et non sicut scribae
clem: Et stupebant super doctrina ejus: erat enim docens eos quasi potestatem habens, et non sicut scrib.
tr: και εξεπλησσοντο επι τη διδαχη αυτου ην γαρ διδασκων αυτους ως εξουσιαν εχων και ουχ ως οι γραμματεις
kjv: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.

vulg: et erat in synagoga eorum homo in spiritu inmundo et exclamavit
clem: Et erat in synagoga eorum homo in spiritu immundo: et exclamavit,
tr: και ην εν τη συναγωγη αυτων ανθρωπος εν πνευματι ακαθαρτω και ανεκραξεν
kjv: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,

vulg: dicens quid nobis et tibi Iesu Nazarene venisti perdere nos scio qui sis Sanctus Dei
clem: dicens: Quid nobis et tibi, Jesu Nazarene? venisti perdere nos? scio qui sis, Sanctus Dei.
tr: λεγων εα τι ημιν και σοι ιησου ναζαρηνε ηλθες απολεσαι ημας οιδα σε τις ει ο αγιος του θεου
kjv: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.

vulg: et comminatus est ei Iesus dicens obmutesce et exi de homine
clem: Et comminatus est ei Jesus, dicens: Obmutesce, et exi de homine.
tr: και επετιμησεν αυτω ο ιησους λεγων φιμωθητι και εξελθε εξ αυτου
kjv: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.

vulg: et discerpens eum spiritus inmundus et exclamans voce magna exivit ab eo
clem: Et discerpens eum spiritus immundus, et exclamans voce magna, exiit ab eo.
tr: και σπαραξαν αυτον το πνευμα το ακαθαρτον και κραξαν φωνη μεγαλη εξηλθεν εξ αυτου
kjv: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.

vulg: et mirati sunt omnes ita ut conquirerent inter se dicentes quidnam est hoc quae doctrina haec nova quia in potestate et spiritibus inmundis imperat et oboediunt ei
clem: Et mirati sunt omnes, ita ut conquirerent inter se dicentes: Quidnam est hoc? qunam doctrina hc nova? quia in potestate etiam spiritibus immundis imperat, et obediunt ei.
tr: και εθαμβηθησαν παντες ωστε συζητειν προς αυτους λεγοντας τι εστιν τουτο τις η διδαχη η καινη αυτη οτι κατ εξουσιαν και τοις πνευμασιν τοις ακαθαρτοις επιτασσει και υπακουουσιν αυτω
kjv: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.

vulg: et processit rumor eius statim in omnem regionem Galilaeae
clem: Et processit rumor ejus statim in omnem regionem Galil.
tr: εξηλθεν δε η ακοη αυτου ευθυς εις ολην την περιχωρον της γαλιλαιας
kjv: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.

vulg: et protinus egredientes de synagoga venerunt in domum Simonis et Andreae cum Iacobo et Iohanne
clem: Et protinus egredientes de synagoga, venerunt in domum Simonis et Andre, cum Jacobo et Joanne.
tr: και ευθεως εκ της συναγωγης εξελθοντες ηλθον εις την οικιαν σιμωνος και ανδρεου μετα ιακωβου και ιωαννου
kjv: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

vulg: decumbebat autem socrus Simonis febricitans et statim dicunt ei de illa
clem: Decumbebat autem socrus Simonis febricitans: et statim dicunt ei de illa.
tr: η δε πενθερα σιμωνος κατεκειτο πυρεσσουσα και ευθεως λεγουσιν αυτω περι αυτης
kjv: But Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.

vulg: et accedens elevavit eam adprehensa manu eius et continuo dimisit eam febris et ministrabat eis
clem: Et accedens elevavit eam, apprehensa manu ejus: et continuo dimisit eam febris, et ministrabat eis.
tr: και προσελθων ηγειρεν αυτην κρατησας της χειρος αυτης και αφηκεν αυτην ο πυρετος ευθεως και διηκονει αυτοις
kjv: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.

vulg: vespere autem facto cum occidisset sol adferebant ad eum omnes male habentes et daemonia habentes
clem: Vespere autem facto cum occidisset sol, afferebant ad eum omnes male habentes, et dmonia habentes:
tr: οψιας δε γενομενης οτε εδυ ο ηλιος εφερον προς αυτον παντας τους κακως εχοντας και τους δαιμονιζομενους
kjv: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.

vulg: et erat omnis civitas congregata ad ianuam
clem: et erat omnis civitas congregata ad januam.
tr: και η πολις ολη επισυνηγμενη ην προς την θυραν
kjv: And all the city was gathered together at the door.

vulg: et curavit multos qui vexabantur variis languoribus et daemonia multa eiciebat et non sinebat loqui ea quoniam sciebant eum
clem: Et curavit multos, qui vexabantur variis languoribus, et dmonia multa ejiciebat, et non sinebat ea loqui, quoniam sciebant eum.
tr: και εθεραπευσεν πολλους κακως εχοντας ποικιλαις νοσοις και δαιμονια πολλα εξεβαλεν και ουκ ηφιεν λαλειν τα δαιμονια οτι ηδεισαν αυτον
kjv: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.

vulg: et diluculo valde surgens egressus abiit in desertum locum ibique orabat
clem: Et diluculo valde surgens, egressus abiit in desertum locum, ibique orabat.
tr: και πρωι εννυχον λιαν αναστας εξηλθεν και απηλθεν εις ερημον τοπον κακει προσηυχετο
kjv: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.

vulg: et persecutus est eum Simon et qui cum illo erant
clem: Et prosecutus est eum Simon, et qui cum illo erant.
tr: και κατεδιωξαν αυτον ο σιμων και οι μετ αυτου
kjv: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.

vulg: et cum invenissent eum dixerunt ei quia omnes quaerunt te
clem: Et cum invenissent eum, dixerunt ei: Quia omnes qurunt te.
tr: και ευροντες αυτον λεγουσιν αυτω οτι παντες ζητουσιν σε
kjv: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.

vulg: et ait illis eamus in proximos vicos et civitates ut et ibi praedicem ad hoc enim veni
clem: Et ait illis: Eamus in proximos vicos, et civitates, ut et ibi prdicem: ad hoc enim veni.
tr: και λεγει αυτοις αγωμεν εις τας εχομενας κωμοπολεις ινα κακει κηρυξω εις τουτο γαρ εξεληλυθα
kjv: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.

vulg: et erat praedicans in synagogis eorum et omni Galilaea et daemonia eiciens
clem: Et erat prdicans in synagogis eorum, et in omni Galila, et dmonia ejiciens.
tr: και ην κηρυσσων εν ταις συναγωγαις αυτων εις ολην την γαλιλαιαν και τα δαιμονια εκβαλλων
kjv: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.

vulg: et venit ad eum leprosus deprecans eum et genu flexo dixit si vis potes me mundare
clem: Et venit ad eum leprosus deprecans eum: et genu flexo dixit ei: Si vis, potes me mundare.
tr: και ερχεται προς αυτον λεπρος παρακαλων αυτον και γονυπετων αυτον και λεγων αυτω οτι εαν θελης δυνασαι με καθαρισαι
kjv: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

vulg: Iesus autem misertus eius extendit manum suam et tangens eum ait illi volo mundare
clem: Jesus autem misertus ejus, extendit manum suam: et tangens eum, ait illi: Volo: mundare.
tr: ο δε ιησους σπλαγχνισθεις εκτεινας την χειρα ηψατο αυτου και λεγει αυτω θελω καθαρισθητι
kjv: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.

vulg: et cum dixisset statim discessit ab eo lepra et mundatus est
clem: Et cum dixisset, statim discessit ab eo lepra, et mundatus est.
tr: και ειποντος αυτου ευθεως απηλθεν απ αυτου η λεπρα και εκαθαρισθη
kjv: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.

vulg: et comminatus ei statim eiecit illum
clem: Et comminatus est ei, statimque ejecit illum,
tr: και εμβριμησαμενος αυτω ευθεως εξεβαλεν αυτον
kjv: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;

vulg: et dicit ei vide nemini dixeris sed vade ostende te principi sacerdotum et offer pro emundatione tua quae praecepit Moses in testimonium illis
clem: et dicit ei: Vide nemini dixeris: sed vade, ostende te principi sacerdotum, et offer pro emundatione tua, qu prcepit Moyses in testimonium illis.
tr: και λεγει αυτω ορα μηδενι μηδεν ειπης αλλ υπαγε σεαυτον δειξον τω ιερει και προσενεγκε περι του καθαρισμου σου α προσεταξεν μωσης εις μαρτυριον αυτοις
kjv: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

vulg: at ille egressus coepit praedicare et diffamare sermonem ita ut iam non posset manifeste in civitatem introire sed foris in desertis locis esse et conveniebant ad eum undique
clem: At ille egressus cpit prdicare, et diffamare sermonem, ita ut jam non posset manifeste introire in civitatem, sed foris in desertis locis esset, et conveniebant ad eum undique.
tr: ο δε εξελθων ηρξατο κηρυσσειν πολλα και διαφημιζειν τον λογον ωστε μηκετι αυτον δυνασθαι φανερως εις πολιν εισελθειν αλλ εξω εν ερημοις τοποις ην και ηρχοντο προς αυτον πανταχοθεν
kjv: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.

vulg: et iterum intravit Capharnaum post dies
clem: Et iterum intravit Capharnaum post dies,
tr: και παλιν εισηλθεν εις καπερναουμ δι ημερων και ηκουσθη οτι εις οικον εστιν
kjv: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.

vulg: et auditum est quod in domo esset et convenerunt multi ita ut non caperet neque ad ianuam et loquebatur eis verbum
clem: et auditum est quod in domo esset, et convenerunt multi, ita ut non caperet neque ad januam, et loquebatur eis verbum.
tr: και ευθεως συνηχθησαν πολλοι ωστε μηκετι χωρειν μηδε τα προς την θυραν και ελαλει αυτοις τον λογον
kjv: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them, no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.

vulg: et venerunt ferentes ad eum paralyticum qui a quattuor portabatur
clem: Et venerunt ad eum ferentes paralyticum, qui a quatuor portabatur.
tr: και ερχονται προς αυτον παραλυτικον φεροντες αιρομενον υπο τεσσαρων
kjv: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.

vulg: et cum non possent offerre eum illi prae turba nudaverunt tectum ubi erat et patefacientes submiserunt grabattum in quo paralyticus iacebat
clem: Et cum non possent offerre eum illi pr turba, nudaverunt tectum ubi erat: et patefacientes submiserunt grabatum in quo paralyticus jacebat.
tr: και μη δυναμενοι προσεγγισαι αυτω δια τον οχλον απεστεγασαν την στεγην οπου ην και εξορυξαντες χαλωσιν τον κραββατον εφ ω ο παραλυτικος κατεκειτο
kjv: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.

vulg: cum vidisset autem Iesus fidem illorum ait paralytico fili dimittuntur tibi peccata
clem: Cum autem vidisset Jesus fidem illorum, ait paralytico: Fili, dimittuntur tibi peccata tua.
tr: ιδων δε ο ιησους την πιστιν αυτων λεγει τω παραλυτικω τεκνον αφεωνται σοι αι αμαρτιαι σου
kjv: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.

vulg: erant autem illic quidam de scribis sedentes et cogitantes in cordibus suis
clem: Erant autem illic quidam de scribis sedentes, et cogitantes in cordibus suis:
tr: ησαν δε τινες των γραμματεων εκει καθημενοι και διαλογιζομενοι εν ταις καρδιαις αυτων
kjv: But there was certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,

vulg: quid hic sic loquitur blasphemat quis potest dimittere peccata nisi solus Deus
clem: Quid hic sic loquitur? blasphemat. Quis potest dimittere peccata, nisi solus Deus?
tr: τι ουτος ουτως λαλει βλασφημιας τις δυναται αφιεναι αμαρτιας ει μη εις ο θεος
kjv: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?

vulg: quo statim cognito Iesus spiritu suo quia sic cogitarent intra se dicit illis quid ista cogitatis in cordibus vestris
clem: Quo statim cognito Jesus spiritu suo, quia sic cogitarent intra se, dicit illis: Quid ista cogitatis in cordibus vestris?
tr: και ευθεως επιγνους ο ιησους τω πνευματι αυτου οτι ουτως διαλογιζονται εν εαυτοις ειπεν αυτοις τι ταυτα διαλογιζεσθε εν ταις καρδιαις υμων
kjv: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?

vulg: quid est facilius dicere paralytico dimittuntur tibi peccata an dicere surge et tolle grabattum tuum et ambula
clem: Quid est facilius dicere paralytico: Dimittuntur tibi peccata tua: an dicere: Surge, tolle grabatum tuum, et ambula?
tr: τι εστιν ευκοπωτερον ειπειν τω παραλυτικω αφεωνται σοι αι αμαρτιαι η ειπειν εγειραι και αρον σου τον κραββατον και περιπατει
kjv: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?

vulg: ut autem sciatis quia potestatem habet Filius hominis in terra dimittendi peccata ait paralytico
clem: Ut autem sciatis quia Filius hominis habet potestatem in terra dimittendi peccata (ait paralytico),
tr: ινα δε ειδητε οτι εξουσιαν εχει ο υιος του ανθρωπου αφιεναι επι της γης αμαρτιας λεγει τω παραλυτικω
kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)

vulg: tibi dico surge tolle grabattum tuum et vade in domum tuam
clem: tibi dico: Surge, tolle grabatum tuum, et vade in domum tuam.
tr: σοι λεγω εγειραι και αρον τον κραββατον σου και υπαγε εις τον οικον σου
kjv: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.

vulg: et statim ille surrexit et sublato grabatto abiit coram omnibus ita ut admirarentur omnes et honorificarent Deum dicentes quia numquam sic vidimus
clem: Et statim surrexit ille: et, sublato grabato, abiit coram omnibus, ita ut mirarentur omnes, et honorificent Deum, dicentes: Quia numquam sic vidimus.
tr: και ηγερθη ευθεως και αρας τον κραββατον εξηλθεν εναντιον παντων ωστε εξιστασθαι παντας και δοξαζειν τον θεον λεγοντας οτι ουδεποτε ουτως ειδομεν
kjv: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.

vulg: et egressus est rursus ad mare omnisque turba veniebat ad eum et docebat eos
clem: Et egressus est rursus ad mare, omnisque turba veniebat ad eum, et docebat eos.
tr: και εξηλθεν παλιν παρα την θαλασσαν και πας ο οχλος ηρχετο προς αυτον και εδιδασκεν αυτους
kjv: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.

vulg: et cum praeteriret vidit Levin Alphei sedentem ad teloneum et ait illi sequere me et surgens secutus est eum
clem: Et cum prteriret, vidit Levi Alphi sedentem ad telonium, et ait illi: Sequere me. Et surgens secutus est eum.
tr: και παραγων ειδεν λευιν τον του αλφαιου καθημενον επι το τελωνιον και λεγει αυτω ακολουθει μοι και αναστας ηκολουθησεν αυτω
kjv: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.

vulg: et factum est cum accumberet in domo illius multi publicani et peccatores simul discumbebant cum Iesu et discipulis eius erant enim multi qui et sequebantur eum
clem: Et factum est, cum accumberet in domo illius, multi publicani et peccatores simul discumbebant cum Jesu et discipulis ejus: erant enim multi, qui et sequebantur eum.
tr: και εγενετο εν τω κατακεισθαι αυτον εν τη οικια αυτου και πολλοι τελωναι και αμαρτωλοι συνανεκειντο τω ιησου και τοις μαθηταις αυτου ησαν γαρ πολλοι και ηκολουθησαν αυτω
kjv: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.

vulg: et scribae et Pharisaei videntes quia manducaret cum peccatoribus et publicanis dicebant discipulis eius quare cum publicanis et peccatoribus manducat et bibit magister vester
clem: Et scrib et pharisi videntes quia manducaret cum publicanis et peccatoribus, dicebant discipulis ejus: Quare cum publicanis et peccatoribus manducat et bibit Magister vester?
tr: και οι γραμματεις και οι φαρισαιοι ιδοντες αυτον εσθιοντα μετα των τελωνων και αμαρτωλων ελεγον τοις μαθηταις αυτου τι οτι μετα των τελωνων και αμαρτωλων εσθιει και πινει
kjv: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?

vulg: hoc audito Iesus ait illis non necesse habent sani medicum sed qui male habent non enim veni vocare iustos sed peccatores
clem: Hoc audito Jesus ait illis: Non necesse habent sani medico, sed qui male habent: non enim veni vocare justos, sed peccatores.
tr: και ακουσας ο ιησους λεγει αυτοις ου χρειαν εχουσιν οι ισχυοντες ιατρου αλλ οι κακως εχοντες ουκ ηλθον καλεσαι δικαιους αλλα αμαρτωλους εις μετανοιαν
kjv: When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

vulg: et erant discipuli Iohannis et Pharisaei ieiunantes et veniunt et dicunt illi cur discipuli Iohannis et Pharisaeorum ieiunant tui autem discipuli non ieiunant
clem: Et erant discipuli Joannis et pharisi jejunantes: et veniunt, et dicunt illi: Quare discipuli Joannis et pharisorum jejunant, tui autem discipuli non jejunant?
tr: και ησαν οι μαθηται ιωαννου και οι των φαρισαιων νηστευοντες και ερχονται και λεγουσιν αυτω δια τι οι μαθηται ιωαννου και οι των φαρισαιων νηστευουσιν οι δε σοι μαθηται ου νηστευουσιν
kjv: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?

vulg: et ait illis Iesus numquid possunt filii nuptiarum quamdiu sponsus cum illis est ieiunare quanto tempore habent secum sponsum non possunt ieiunare
clem: Et ait illis Jesus: Numquid possunt filii nuptiarum, quamdiu sponsus cum illis est, jejunare? Quanto tempore habent secum sponsum, non possunt jejunare.
tr: και ειπεν αυτοις ο ιησους μη δυνανται οι υιοι του νυμφωνος εν ω ο νυμφιος μετ αυτων εστιν νηστευειν οσον χρονον μεθ εαυτων εχουσιν τον νυμφιον ου δυνανται νηστευειν
kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.

vulg: venient autem dies cum auferetur ab eis sponsus et tunc ieiunabunt in illa die
clem: Venient autem dies cum auferetur ab eis sponsus: et tunc jejunabunt in illis diebus.
tr: ελευσονται δε ημεραι οταν απαρθη απ αυτων ο νυμφιος και τοτε νηστευσουσιν εν εκειναις ταις ημεραις
kjv: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.

vulg: nemo adsumentum panni rudis adsuit vestimento veteri alioquin aufert supplementum novum a veteri et maior scissura fit
clem: Nemo assumentum panni rudis assuit vestimento veteri: alioquin aufert supplementum novum a veteri, et major scissura fit.
tr: και ουδεις επιβλημα ρακους αγναφου επιρραπτει επι ιματιω παλαιω ει δε μη αιρει το πληρωμα αυτου το καινον του παλαιου και χειρον σχισμα γινεται
kjv: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.

vulg: et nemo mittit vinum novellum in utres veteres alioquin disrumpet vinum utres et vinum effunditur et utres peribunt sed vinum novum in utres novos mitti debet
clem: Et nemo mittit vinum novum in utres veteres: alioquin dirumpet vinum utres, et vinum effundetur, et utres peribunt: sed vinum novum in utres novos mitti debet.
tr: και ουδεις βαλλει οινον νεον εις ασκους παλαιους ει δε μη ρησσει ο οινος ο νεος τους ασκους και ο οινος εκχειται και οι ασκοι απολουνται αλλα οινον νεον εις ασκους καινους βλητεον
kjv: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.

vulg: et factum est iterum cum sabbatis ambularet per sata et discipuli eius coeperunt praegredi et vellere spicas
clem: Et factum est iterum Dominus sabbatis ambularet per sata, et discipuli ejus cperunt progredi, et vellere spicas.
tr: και εγενετο παραπορευεσθαι αυτον εν τοις σαββασιν δια των σποριμων και ηρξαντο οι μαθηται αυτου οδον ποιειν τιλλοντες τους σταχυας
kjv: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.

vulg: Pharisaei autem dicebant ei ecce quid faciunt sabbatis quod non licet
clem: Pharisi autem dicebant ei: Ecce, quid faciunt sabbatis quod non licet?
tr: και οι φαρισαιοι ελεγον αυτω ιδε τι ποιουσιν εν τοις σαββασιν ο ουκ εξεστιν
kjv: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?

vulg: et ait illis numquam legistis quid fecerit David quando necessitatem habuit et esuriit ipse et qui cum eo erant
clem: Et ait illis: Numquam legistis quid fecerit David, quando necessitatem habuit, et esuriit ipse, et qui cum eo erant?
tr: και αυτος ελεγεν αυτοις ουδεποτε ανεγνωτε τι εποιησεν δαβιδ οτε χρειαν εσχεν και επεινασεν αυτος και οι μετ αυτου
kjv: And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?

vulg: quomodo introiit in domum Dei sub Abiathar principe sacerdotum et panes propositionis manducavit quos non licet manducare nisi sacerdotibus et dedit eis qui cum eo erant
clem: quomodo introibit in domum Dei sub Abiathar principe sacerdotum, et panes propositionis manducavit, quos non licebat manducare, nisi sacerdotibus, et dedit eis qui cum eo erant?
tr: πως εισηλθεν εις τον οικον του θεου επι αβιαθαρ του αρχιερεως και τους αρτους της προθεσεως εφαγεν ους ουκ εξεστιν φαγειν ει μη τοις ιερευσιν και εδωκεν και τοις συν αυτω ουσιν
kjv: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?

vulg: et dicebat eis sabbatum propter hominem factum est et non homo propter sabbatum
clem: Et dicebat eis: Sabbatum propter hominem factum est, et non homo propter sabbatum.
tr: και ελεγεν αυτοις το σαββατον δια τον ανθρωπον εγενετο ουχ ο ανθρωπος δια το σαββατον
kjv: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:

vulg: itaque dominus est Filius hominis etiam sabbati
clem: Itaque Dominus est Filius hominis, etiam sabbati.
tr: ωστε κυριος εστιν ο υιος του ανθρωπου και του σαββατου
kjv: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

vulg: et introivit iterum synagogam et erat ibi homo habens manum aridam
clem: Et introivit iterum in synagogam: et erat ibi homo habens manum aridam.
tr: και εισηλθεν παλιν εις την συναγωγην και ην εκει ανθρωπος εξηραμμενην εχων την χειρα
kjv: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.

vulg: et observabant eum si sabbatis curaret ut accusarent illum
clem: Et observabant eum, si sabbatis curaret, ut accusarent illum.
tr: και παρετηρουν αυτον ει τοις σαββασιν θεραπευσει αυτον ινα κατηγορησωσιν αυτου
kjv: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.

vulg: et ait homini habenti manum aridam surge in medium
clem: Et ait homini habenti manum aridam: Surge in medium.
tr: και λεγει τω ανθρωπω τω εξηραμμενην εχοντι την χειρα εγειραι εις το μεσον
kjv: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.

vulg: et dicit eis licet sabbatis bene facere an male animam salvam facere an perdere at illi tacebant
clem: Et dicit eis: Licet sabbatis benefacere, an male? animam salvam facere, an perdere? At illi tacebant.
tr: και λεγει αυτοις εξεστιν τοις σαββασιν αγαθοποιησαι η κακοποιησαι ψυχην σωσαι η αποκτειναι οι δε εσιωπων
kjv: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.

vulg: et circumspiciens eos cum ira contristatus super caecitatem cordis eorum dicit homini extende manum tuam et extendit et restituta est manus illi
clem: Et circumspiciens eos cum ira, contristatus super ccitate cordis eorum, dicit homini: Extende manum tuam. Et extendit, et restituta est manus illi.
tr: και περιβλεψαμενος αυτους μετ οργης συλλυπουμενος επι τη πωρωσει της καρδιας αυτων λεγει τω ανθρωπω εκτεινον την χειρα σου και εξετεινεν και αποκατεσταθη η χειρ αυτου υγιης ως η αλλη
kjv: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

vulg: exeuntes autem statim Pharisaei cum Herodianis consilium faciebant adversus eum quomodo eum perderent
clem: Exeuntes autem pharisi, statim cum Herodianis consilium faciebant adversus eum quomodo eum perderent.
tr: και εξελθοντες οι φαρισαιοι ευθεως μετα των ηρωδιανων συμβουλιον εποιουν κατ αυτου οπως αυτον απολεσωσιν
kjv: And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

vulg: et Iesus cum discipulis suis secessit ad mare et multa turba a Galilaea et Iudaea secuta est eum
clem: Jesus autem cum discipulis suis secessit ad mare: et multa turba a Galila et Juda secuta est eum,
tr: και ο ιησους ανεχωρησεν μετα των μαθητων αυτου προς την θαλασσαν και πολυ πληθος απο της γαλιλαιας ηκολουθησαν αυτω και απο της ιουδαιας
kjv: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judaea,

vulg: et ab Hierosolymis et ab Idumea et trans Iordanen et qui circa Tyrum et Sidonem multitudo magna audientes quae faciebat venerunt ad eum
clem: et ab Jerosolymis, et ab Iduma, et trans Jordanem: et qui circa Tyrum et Sidonem multitudo magna, audientes qu faciebat, venerunt ad eum.
tr: και απο ιεροσολυμων και απο της ιδουμαιας και περαν του ιορδανου και οι περι τυρον και σιδωνα πληθος πολυ ακουσαντες οσα εποιει ηλθον προς αυτον
kjv: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.

vulg: et dixit discipulis suis ut navicula sibi deserviret propter turbam ne conprimerent eum
clem: Et dicit discipulis suis ut navicula sibi deserviret propter turbam, ne comprimerent eum:
tr: και ειπεν τοις μαθηταις αυτου ινα πλοιαριον προσκαρτερη αυτω δια τον οχλον ινα μη θλιβωσιν αυτον
kjv: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.

vulg: multos enim sanabat ita ut inruerent in eum ut illum tangerent quotquot habebant plagas
clem: multos enim sanabat, ita ut irruerent in eum ut illum tangerent, quotquot habebant plagas.
tr: πολλους γαρ εθεραπευσεν ωστε επιπιπτειν αυτω ινα αυτου αψωνται οσοι ειχον μαστιγας
kjv: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.

vulg: et spiritus inmundi cum illum videbant procidebant ei et clamabant dicentes
clem: Et spiritus immundi, cum illum videbant, procidebant ei: et clamabant, dicentes:
tr: και τα πνευματα τα ακαθαρτα οταν αυτον εθεωρει προσεπιπτεν αυτω και εκραζεν λεγοντα οτι συ ει ο υιος του θεου
kjv: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.

vulg: tu es Filius Dei et vehementer comminabatur eis ne manifestarent illum
clem: Tu es Filius Dei. Et vehementer comminabatur eis ne manifestarent illum.
tr: και πολλα επετιμα αυτοις ινα μη αυτον φανερον ποιησωσιν
kjv: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.

vulg: et ascendens in montem vocavit ad se quos voluit ipse et venerunt ad eum
clem: Et ascendens in montem vocavit ad se quos voluit ipse: et venerunt ad eum.
tr: και αναβαινει εις το ορος και προσκαλειται ους ηθελεν αυτος και απηλθον προς αυτον
kjv: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.

vulg: et fecit ut essent duodecim cum illo et ut mitteret eos praedicare
clem: Et fecit ut essent duodecim cum illo: et ut mitteret eos prdicare.
tr: και εποιησεν δωδεκα ινα ωσιν μετ αυτου και ινα αποστελλη αυτους κηρυσσειν
kjv: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,

vulg: et dedit illis potestatem curandi infirmitates et eiciendi daemonia
clem: Et dedit illis potestatem curandi infirmitates et ejiciendi dmonia.
tr: και εχειν εξουσιαν θεραπευειν τας νοσους και εκβαλλειν τα δαιμονια
kjv: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:

vulg: et inposuit Simoni nomen Petrus
clem: Et imposuit Simoni nomen Petrus:
tr: και επεθηκεν τω σιμωνι ονομα πετρον
kjv: And Simon he surnamed Peter;

vulg: et Iacobum Zebedaei et Iohannem fratrem Iacobi et inposuit eis nomina Boanerges quod est Filii tonitrui
clem: et Jacobum Zebedi, et Joannem fratrem Jacobi, et imposuit eis nomina Boanerges, quod est, Filii tonitrui:
tr: και ιακωβον τον του ζεβεδαιου και ιωαννην τον αδελφον του ιακωβου και επεθηκεν αυτοις ονοματα βοανεργες ο εστιν υιοι βροντης
kjv: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:

vulg: et Andream et Philippum et Bartholomeum et Mattheum et Thomam et Iacobum Alphei et Thaddeum et Simonem Cananeum
clem: et Andram, et Philippum, et Bartholomum, et Matthum, et Thomam, et Jacobum Alphi, et Thaddum, et Simonem Cananum,
tr: και ανδρεαν και φιλιππον και βαρθολομαιον και ματθαιον και θωμαν και ιακωβον τον του αλφαιου και θαδδαιον και σιμωνα τον κανανιτην
kjv: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,

vulg: et Iudam Scarioth qui et tradidit illum
clem: et Judas Iscariotem, qui et tradidit illum.
tr: και ιουδαν ισκαριωτην ος και παρεδωκεν αυτον και ερχονται εις οικον
kjv: And Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed him: and they went into an house.

vulg: et veniunt ad domum et convenit iterum turba ita ut non possent neque panem manducare
clem: Et veniunt ad domum: et convenit iterum turba, ita ut non possent neque panem manducare.
tr: και συνερχεται παλιν οχλος ωστε μη δυνασθαι αυτους μητε αρτον φαγειν
kjv: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

vulg: et cum audissent sui exierunt tenere eum dicebant enim quoniam in furorem versus est
clem: Et cum audissent sui, exierunt tenere eum: dicebant enim: Quoniam in furorem versus est.
tr: και ακουσαντες οι παρ αυτου εξηλθον κρατησαι αυτον ελεγον γαρ οτι εξεστη
kjv: And when his friends heard of it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.

vulg: et scribae qui ab Hierosolymis descenderant dicebant quoniam Beelzebub habet et quia in principe daemonum eicit daemonia
clem: Et scrib, qui ab Jerosolymis descenderant, dicebant: Quoniam Beelzebub habet, et quia in principe dmoniorum ejicit dmonia.
tr: και οι γραμματεις οι απο ιεροσολυμων καταβαντες ελεγον οτι βεελζεβουλ εχει και οτι εν τω αρχοντι των δαιμονιων εκβαλλει τα δαιμονια
kjv: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.

vulg: et convocatis eis in parabolis dicebat illis quomodo potest Satanas Satanan eicere
clem: Et convocatis eis in parabolis dicebat illis: Quomodo potest Satanas Satanam ejicere?
tr: και προσκαλεσαμενος αυτους εν παραβολαις ελεγεν αυτοις πως δυναται σατανας σαταναν εκβαλλειν
kjv: And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?

vulg: et si regnum in se dividatur non potest stare regnum illud
clem: Et si regnum in se dividatur, non potest regnum illud stare.
tr: και εαν βασιλεια εφ εαυτην μερισθη ου δυναται σταθηναι η βασιλεια εκεινη
kjv: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

vulg: et si domus super semet ipsam dispertiatur non poterit domus illa stare
clem: Et si domus super semetipsam dispertiatur, non potest domus illa stare.
tr: και εαν οικια εφ εαυτην μερισθη ου δυναται σταθηναι η οικια εκεινη
kjv: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

vulg: et si Satanas consurrexit in semet ipsum dispertitus est et non potest stare sed finem habet
clem: Et si Satanas consurrexerit in semetipsum, dispertitus est, et non poterit stare, sed finem habet.
tr: και ει ο σατανας ανεστη εφ εαυτον και μεμερισται ου δυναται σταθηναι αλλα τελος εχει
kjv: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.

vulg: nemo potest vasa fortis ingressus in domum diripere nisi prius fortem alliget et tunc domum eius diripiet
clem: Nemo potest vasa fortis ingressus in domum diripere, nisi prius fortem alliget, et tunc domum ejus diripiet.
tr: ου δυναται ουδεις τα σκευη του ισχυρου εισελθων εις την οικιαν αυτου διαρπασαι εαν μη πρωτον τον ισχυρον δηση και τοτε την οικιαν αυτου διαρπασει
kjv: No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.

vulg: amen dico vobis quoniam omnia dimittentur filiis hominum peccata et blasphemiae quibus blasphemaverint
clem: Amen dico vobis, quoniam omnia dimittentur filiis hominum peccata, et blasphemi quibus blasphemaverint:
tr: αμην λεγω υμιν οτι παντα αφεθησεται τα αμαρτηματα τοις υιοις των ανθρωπων και βλασφημιαι οσας αν βλασφημησωσιν
kjv: Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:

vulg: qui autem blasphemaverit in Spiritum Sanctum non habet remissionem in aeternum sed reus erit aeterni delicti
clem: qui autem blasphemaverit in Spiritum Sanctum, non habebit remissionem in ternum, sed reus erit terni delicti.
tr: ος δ αν βλασφημηση εις το πνευμα το αγιον ουκ εχει αφεσιν εις τον αιωνα αλλ ενοχος εστιν αιωνιου κρισεως
kjv: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation.

vulg: quoniam dicebant spiritum inmundum habet
clem: Quoniam dicebant: Spiritum immundum habet.
tr: οτι ελεγον πνευμα ακαθαρτον εχει
kjv: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.

vulg: et veniunt mater eius et fratres et foris stantes miserunt ad eum vocantes eum
clem: Et veniunt mater ejus et fratres: et foris stantes miserunt ad eum vocantes eum,
tr: ερχονται ουν οι αδελφοι και η μητηρ αυτου και εξω εστωτες απεστειλαν προς αυτον φωνουντες αυτον
kjv: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.

vulg: et sedebat circa eum turba et dicunt ei ecce mater tua et fratres tui foris quaerunt te
clem: et sedebat circa eum turba: et dicunt ei: Ecce mater tua et fratres tui foris qurunt te.
tr: και εκαθητο οχλος περι αυτον ειπον δε αυτω ιδου η μητηρ σου και οι αδελφοι σου εξω ζητουσιν σε
kjv: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.

vulg: et respondens eis ait quae est mater mea et fratres mei
clem: Et respondens eis, ait: Qu est mater mea et fratres mei?
tr: και απεκριθη αυτοις λεγων τις εστιν η μητηρ μου η οι αδελφοι μου
kjv: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?

vulg: et circumspiciens eos qui in circuitu eius sedebant ait ecce mater mea et fratres mei
clem: Et circumspiciens eos, qui in circuitu ejus sedebant, ait: Ecce mater mea et fratres mei.
tr: και περιβλεψαμενος κυκλω τους περι αυτον καθημενους λεγει ιδε η μητηρ μου και οι αδελφοι μου
kjv: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!

vulg: qui enim fecerit voluntatem Dei hic frater meus et soror mea et mater est
clem: Qui enim fecerit voluntatem Dei, hic frater meus, et soror mea, et mater est.
tr: ος γαρ αν ποιηση το θελημα του θεου ουτος αδελφος μου και αδελφη μου και μητηρ εστιν
kjv: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.

vulg: et iterum coepit docere ad mare et congregata est ad eum turba multa ita ut in navem ascendens sederet in mari et omnis turba circa mare super terram erat
clem: Et iterum cpit docere ad mare: et congregata est ad eum turba multa, ita ut navim ascendens sederet in mari, et omnis turba circa mare super terram erat:
tr: και παλιν ηρξατο διδασκειν παρα την θαλασσαν και συνηχθη προς αυτον οχλος πολυς ωστε αυτον εμβαντα εις το πλοιον καθησθαι εν τη θαλασση και πας ο οχλος προς την θαλασσαν επι της γης ην
kjv: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.

vulg: et docebat eos in parabolis multa et dicebat illis in doctrina sua
clem: et docebat eos in parabolis multa, et dicebat illis in doctrina sua:
tr: και εδιδασκεν αυτους εν παραβολαις πολλα και ελεγεν αυτοις εν τη διδαχη αυτου
kjv: And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,

vulg: audite ecce exiit seminans ad seminandum
clem: Audite: ecce exiit seminans ad seminandum.
tr: ακουετε ιδου εξηλθεν ο σπειρων του σπειραι
kjv: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:

vulg: et dum seminat aliud cecidit circa viam et venerunt volucres et comederunt illud
clem: Et dum seminat, aliud cecidit circa viam, et venerunt volucres cli, et comederunt illud.
tr: και εγενετο εν τω σπειρειν ο μεν επεσεν παρα την οδον και ηλθεν τα πετεινα του ουρανου και κατεφαγεν αυτο
kjv: And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.

vulg: aliud vero cecidit super petrosa ubi non habuit terram multam et statim exortum est quoniam non habebat altitudinem terrae
clem: Aliud vero cecidit super petrosa, ubi non habuit terram multam: et statim exortum est, quoniam non habebat altitudinem terr:
tr: αλλο δε επεσεν επι το πετρωδες οπου ουκ ειχεν γην πολλην και ευθεως εξανετειλεν δια το μη εχειν βαθος γης
kjv: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:

vulg: et quando exortus est sol exaestuavit et eo quod non haberet radicem exaruit
clem: et quando exortus est sol, exstuavit: et eo quod non habebat radicem, exaruit.
tr: ηλιου δε ανατειλαντος εκαυματισθη και δια το μη εχειν ριζαν εξηρανθη
kjv: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

vulg: et aliud cecidit in spinas et ascenderunt spinae et offocaverunt illud et fructum non dedit
clem: Et aliud cecidit in spinas: et ascenderunt spin, et suffocaverunt illud, et fructum non dedit.
tr: και αλλο επεσεν εις τας ακανθας και ανεβησαν αι ακανθαι και συνεπνιξαν αυτο και καρπον ουκ εδωκεν
kjv: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

vulg: et aliud cecidit in terram bonam et dabat fructum ascendentem et crescentem et adferebat unum triginta et unum sexaginta et unum centum
clem: Et aliud cecidit in terram bonam: et dabat fructum ascendentem et crescentem, et afferebat unum triginta, unum sexaginta, et unum centum.
tr: και αλλο επεσεν εις την γην την καλην και εδιδου καρπον αναβαινοντα και αυξανοντα και εφερεν εν τριακοντα και εν εξηκοντα και εν εκατον
kjv: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.

vulg: et dicebat qui habet aures audiendi audiat
clem: Et dicebat: Qui habet aures audiendi, audiat.
tr: και ελεγεν αυτοις ο εχων ωτα ακουειν ακουετω
kjv: And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

vulg: et cum esset singularis interrogaverunt eum hii qui cum eo erant cum duodecim parabolas
clem: Et cum esset singularis, interrogaverunt eum hi qui cum eo erant duodecim, parabolam.
tr: οτε δε εγενετο καταμονας ηρωτησαν αυτον οι περι αυτον συν τοις δωδεκα την παραβολην
kjv: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.

vulg: et dicebat eis vobis datum est mysterium regni Dei illis autem qui foris sunt in parabolis omnia fiunt
clem: Et dicebat eis: Vobis datum est nosse mysterium regni Dei: illis autem, qui foris sunt, in parabolis omnia fiunt:
tr: και ελεγεν αυτοις υμιν δεδοται γνωναι το μυστηριον της βασιλειας του θεου εκεινοις δε τοις εξω εν παραβολαις τα παντα γινεται
kjv: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:

vulg: ut videntes videant et non videant et audientes audiant et non intellegant nequando convertantur et dimittantur eis peccata
clem: ut videntes videant, et non videant: et audientes audiant, et non intelligant: nequando convertantur, et dimittantur eis peccata.
tr: ινα βλεποντες βλεπωσιν και μη ιδωσιν και ακουοντες ακουωσιν και μη συνιωσιν μηποτε επιστρεψωσιν και αφεθη αυτοις τα αμαρτηματα
kjv: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.

vulg: et ait illis nescitis parabolam hanc et quomodo omnes parabolas cognoscetis
clem: Et ait illis: Nescitis parabolam hanc? Et quomodo omnes parabolas cognoscetis?
tr: και λεγει αυτοις ουκ οιδατε την παραβολην ταυτην και πως πασας τας παραβολας γνωσεσθε
kjv: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?

vulg: qui seminat verbum seminat
clem: Qui seminat, verbum seminat.
tr: ο σπειρων τον λογον σπειρει
kjv: The sower soweth the word.

vulg: hii autem sunt qui circa viam ubi seminatur verbum et cum audierint confestim venit Satanas et aufert verbum quod seminatum est in corda eorum
clem: Hi autem sunt, qui circa viam, ubi seminatur verbum, et cum audierint, confestim venit Satanas, et aufert verbum, quod seminatum est in cordibus eorum.
tr: ουτοι δε εισιν οι παρα την οδον οπου σπειρεται ο λογος και οταν ακουσωσιν ευθεως ερχεται ο σατανας και αιρει τον λογον τον εσπαρμενον εν ταις καρδιαις αυτων
kjv: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.

vulg: et hii sunt similiter qui super petrosa seminantur qui cum audierint verbum statim cum gaudio accipiunt illud
clem: Et hi sunt similiter, qui super petrosa seminantur: qui cum audierint verbum, statim cum gaudio accipiunt illud:
tr: και ουτοι εισιν ομοιως οι επι τα πετρωδη σπειρομενοι οι οταν ακουσωσιν τον λογον ευθεως μετα χαρας λαμβανουσιν αυτον
kjv: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;

vulg: et non habent radicem in se sed temporales sunt deinde orta tribulatione et persecutione propter verbum confestim scandalizantur
clem: et non habent radicem in se, sed temporales sunt: deinde orta tribulatione et persecutione propter verbum, confestim scandalizantur.
tr: και ουκ εχουσιν ριζαν εν εαυτοις αλλα προσκαιροι εισιν ειτα γενομενης θλιψεως η διωγμου δια τον λογον ευθεως σκανδαλιζονται
kjv: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word's sake, immediately they are offended.

vulg: et alii sunt qui in spinis seminantur hii sunt qui verbum audiunt
clem: Et alii sunt qui in spinas seminantur: hi sunt qui verbum audiunt,
tr: και ουτοι εισιν οι εις τας ακανθας σπειρομενοι ουτοι εισιν   οι τον λογον ακουοντες
kjv: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,

vulg: et aerumnae saeculi et deceptio divitiarum et circa reliqua concupiscentiae introeuntes suffocant verbum et sine fructu efficitur
clem: et rumn sculi, et deceptio divitiarum, et circa reliqua concupiscenti intrountes suffocant verbum, et sine fructu efficitur.
tr: και αι μεριμναι του αιωνος τουτου και η απατη του πλουτου και αι περι τα λοιπα επιθυμιαι εισπορευομεναι συμπνιγουσιν τον λογον και ακαρπος γινεται
kjv: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.

vulg: et hii sunt qui super terram bonam seminati sunt qui audiunt verbum et suscipiunt et fructificant unum triginta et unum sexaginta et unum centum
clem: Et hi sunt qui super terram bonam seminati sunt, qui audiunt verbum, et suscipiunt, et fructificant, unum triginta, unum sexaginta, et unum centum.
tr: και ουτοι εισιν οι επι την γην την καλην σπαρεντες οιτινες ακουουσιν τον λογον και παραδεχονται και καρποφορουσιν εν τριακοντα και εν εξηκοντα και εν εκατον
kjv: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.

vulg: et dicebat illis numquid venit lucerna ut sub modio ponatur aut sub lecto nonne ut super candelabrum ponatur
clem: Et dicebat illis: Numquid venit lucerna ut sub modo ponatur, aut sub lecto? nonne ut super candelabrum ponatur?
tr: και ελεγεν αυτοις μητι ο λυχνος ερχεται ινα υπο τον μοδιον τεθη η υπο την κλινην ουχ ινα επι την λυχνιαν επιτεθη
kjv: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?

vulg: non enim est aliquid absconditum quod non manifestetur nec factum est occultum sed ut in palam veniat
clem: Non est enim aliquid absconditum, quod non manifestetur: nec factum est occultum, sed ut in palam veniat.
tr: ου γαρ εστιν τι κρυπτον ο εαν μη φανερωθη ουδε εγενετο αποκρυφον αλλ ινα εις φανερον ελθη
kjv: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.

vulg: si quis habet aures audiendi audiat
clem: Si quis habet aures audiendi, audiat.
tr: ει τις εχει ωτα ακουειν ακουετω
kjv: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.

vulg: et dicebat illis videte quid audiatis in qua mensura mensi fueritis remetietur vobis et adicietur vobis
clem: Et dicebat illis: Videte quid audiatis. In qua mensura mensi fueritis, remetietur vobis, et adjicietur vobis.
tr: και ελεγεν αυτοις βλεπετε τι ακουετε εν ω μετρω μετρειτε μετρηθησεται υμιν και προστεθησεται υμιν τοις ακουουσιν
kjv: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.

vulg: qui enim habet dabitur illi et qui non habet etiam quod habet auferetur ab illo
clem: Qui enim habet, dabitur illi: et qui non habet, etiam quod habet auferetur ab eo.
tr: ος γαρ αν εχη δοθησεται αυτω και ος ουκ εχει και ο εχει αρθησεται απ αυτου
kjv: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.

vulg: et dicebat sic est regnum Dei quemadmodum si homo iaciat sementem in terram
clem: Et dicebat: Sic est regnum Dei, quemadmodum si homo jaciat sementem in terram,
tr: και ελεγεν ουτως εστιν η βασιλεια του θεου ως εαν ανθρωπος βαλη τον σπορον επι της γης
kjv: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;

vulg: et dormiat et exsurgat nocte ac die et semen germinet et increscat dum nescit ille
clem: et dormiat, et exsurgat nocte et die, et semen germinet, et increscat dum nescit ille.
tr: και καθευδη και εγειρηται νυκτα και ημεραν και ο σπορος βλαστανη και μηκυνηται ως ουκ οιδεν αυτος
kjv: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.

vulg: ultro enim terra fructificat primum herbam deinde spicam deinde plenum frumentum in spica
clem: Ultro enim terra fructificat, primum herbam, deinde spicam, deinde plenum frumentum in spica.
tr: αυτοματη γαρ η γη καρποφορει πρωτον χορτον ειτα σταχυν ειτα πληρη σιτον εν τω σταχυι
kjv: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.

vulg: et cum se produxerit fructus statim mittit falcem quoniam adest messis
clem: Et cum producerit fructus, statim mittit falcem, quoniam adsit messis.
tr: οταν δε παραδω ο καρπος ευθεως αποστελλει το δρεπανον οτι παρεστηκεν ο θερισμος
kjv: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.

vulg: et dicebat cui adsimilabimus regnum Dei aut cui parabolae conparabimus illud
clem: Et dicebat: Cui assimilabimus regnum Dei? aut cui parabol comparabimus illud?
tr: και ελεγεν τινι ομοιωσωμεν την βασιλειαν του θεου η εν ποια παραβολη παραβαλωμεν αυτην
kjv: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?

vulg: sicut granum sinapis quod cum seminatum fuerit in terra minus est omnibus seminibus quae sunt in terra
clem: Sicut granum sinapis, quod cum seminatum fuerit in terra, minus est omnibus seminibus, qu sunt in terra:
tr: ως κοκκω σιναπεως ος οταν σπαρη επι της γης μικροτερος παντων των σπερματων εστιν των επι της γης
kjv: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:

vulg: et cum seminatum fuerit ascendit et fit maius omnibus holeribus et facit ramos magnos ita ut possint sub umbra eius aves caeli habitare
clem: et cum seminatum fuerit, ascendit, et fit majus omnibus oleribus, et facit ramos magnos, ita ut possint sub umbra ejus aves cli habitare.
tr: και οταν σπαρη αναβαινει και γινεται παντων των λαχανων μειζων και ποιει κλαδους μεγαλους ωστε δυνασθαι υπο την σκιαν αυτου τα πετεινα του ουρανου κατασκηνουν
kjv: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.

vulg: et talibus multis parabolis loquebatur eis verbum prout poterant audire
clem: Et talibus multis parabolis loquebatur eis verbum, prout poterant audire:
tr: και τοιαυταις παραβολαις πολλαις ελαλει αυτοις τον λογον καθως ηδυναντο ακουειν
kjv: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it.

vulg: sine parabola autem non loquebatur eis seorsum autem discipulis suis disserebat omnia
clem: sine parabola autem non loquebatur eis: seorsum autem discipulis suis disserebat omnia.
tr: χωρις δε παραβολης ουκ ελαλει αυτοις κατ ιδιαν δε τοις μαθηταις αυτου επελυεν παντα
kjv: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.

vulg: et ait illis illa die cum sero esset factum transeamus contra
clem: Et ait illis in illa die, cum sero esset factum: Transeamus contra.
tr: και λεγει αυτοις εν εκεινη τη ημερα οψιας γενομενης διελθωμεν εις το περαν
kjv: And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.

vulg: et dimittentes turbam adsumunt eum ita ut erat in navi et aliae naves erant cum illo
clem: Et dimittentes turbam, assumunt eum ita ut erat in navi: et ali naves erant cum illo.
tr: και αφεντες τον οχλον παραλαμβανουσιν αυτον ως ην εν τω πλοιω και αλλα δε πλοιαρια ην μετ αυτου
kjv: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.

vulg: et facta est procella magna venti et fluctus mittebat in navem ita ut impleretur navis
clem: Et facta est procella magna venti, et fluctus mittebat in navim, ita ut impleretur navis.
tr: και γινεται λαιλαψ ανεμου μεγαλη τα δε κυματα επεβαλλεν εις το πλοιον ωστε αυτο ηδη γεμιζεσθαι
kjv: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.

vulg: et erat ipse in puppi supra cervical dormiens et excitant eum et dicunt ei magister non ad te pertinet quia perimus
clem: Et erat ipse in puppi super cervical dormiens: et excitant eum, et dicunt illi: Magister, non ad te pertinet, quia perimus?
tr: και ην αυτος επι τη πρυμνη επι το προσκεφαλαιον καθευδων και διεγειρουσιν αυτον και λεγουσιν αυτω διδασκαλε ου μελει σοι οτι απολλυμεθα
kjv: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?

vulg: et exsurgens comminatus est vento et dixit mari tace obmutesce et cessavit ventus et facta est tranquillitas magna
clem: Et exsurgens comminatus est vento, et dixit mari: Tace, obmutesce. Et cessavit ventus: et facta est tranquillitas magna.
tr: και διεγερθεις επετιμησεν τω ανεμω και ειπεν τη θαλασση σιωπα πεφιμωσο και εκοπασεν ο ανεμος και εγενετο γαληνη μεγαλη
kjv: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

vulg: et ait illis quid timidi estis necdum habetis fidem et timuerunt magno timore et dicebant ad alterutrum quis putas est iste quia et ventus et mare oboediunt ei
clem: Et ait illis: Quid timidi estis? necdum habetis fidem? et timuerunt timore magno, et dicebant ad alterutrum: Quis, putas, est iste, quia et ventus et mare obediunt ei?
tr: και ειπεν αυτοις τι δειλοι εστε ουτως πως ουκ εχετε πιστιν
kjv: And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?

tr: και εφοβηθησαν φοβον μεγαν και ελεγον προς αλληλους τις αρα ουτος εστιν οτι και ο ανεμος και η θαλασσα υπακουουσιν αυτω
kjv: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?

vulg: et venerunt trans fretum maris in regionem Gerasenorum
clem: Et venerunt trans fretum maris in regionem Gerasenorum.
tr: και ηλθον εις το περαν της θαλασσης εις την χωραν των γαδαρηνων
kjv: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

vulg: et exeunti ei de navi statim occurrit ei de monumentis homo in spiritu inmundo
clem: Et exeunti ei de navi, statim occurrit de monumentis homo in spiritu immundo,
tr: και εξελθοντι αυτω εκ του πλοιου ευθεως απηντησεν αυτω εκ των μνημειων ανθρωπος εν πνευματι ακαθαρτω
kjv: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,

vulg: qui domicilium habebat in monumentis et neque catenis iam quisquam eum poterat ligare
clem: qui domicilium habebat in monumentis, et neque catenis jam quisquam poterat eum ligare:
tr: ος την κατοικησιν ειχεν εν τοις μνημειοις και ουτε αλυσεσιν ουδεις ηδυνατο αυτον δησαι
kjv: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:

vulg: quoniam saepe conpedibus et catenis vinctus disrupisset catenas et conpedes comminuisset et nemo poterat eum domare
clem: quoniam spe compedibus et catenis vinctus, dirupisset catenas, et compedes comminuisset, et nemo poterat eum domare:
tr: δια το αυτον πολλακις πεδαις και αλυσεσιν δεδεσθαι και διεσπασθαι υπ αυτου τας αλυσεις και τας πεδας συντετριφθαι και ουδεις αυτον ισχυεν δαμασαι
kjv: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.

vulg: et semper nocte ac die in monumentis et in montibus erat clamans et concidens se lapidibus
clem: et semper die ac nocte in monumentis, et in montibus erat, clamans, et concidens se lapidibus.
tr: και διαπαντος  δια παντος  νυκτος και ημερας εν τοις ορεσιν και εν τοις μνημασιν ην κραζων και κατακοπτων εαυτον λιθοις
kjv: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.

vulg: videns autem Iesum a longe cucurrit et adoravit eum
clem: Videns autem Jesum a longe, cucurrit, et adoravit eum:
tr: ιδων δε τον ιησουν απο μακροθεν εδραμεν και προσεκυνησεν αυτω
kjv: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,

vulg: et clamans voce magna dicit quid mihi et tibi Iesu Fili Dei summi adiuro te per Deum ne me torqueas
clem: et clamans voce magna dixit: Quid mihi et tibi, Jesu Fili Dei altissimi? adjuro te per Deum, ne me torqueas.
tr: και κραξας φωνη μεγαλη ειπεν τι εμοι και σοι ιησου υιε του θεου του υψιστου ορκιζω σε τον θεον μη με βασανισης
kjv: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.

vulg: dicebat enim illi exi spiritus inmunde ab homine
clem: Dicebat enim illi: Exi spiritus immunde ab homine.
tr: ελεγεν γαρ αυτω εξελθε το πνευμα το ακαθαρτον εκ του ανθρωπου
kjv: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.

vulg: et interrogabat eum quod tibi nomen est et dicit ei Legio nomen mihi est quia multi sumus
clem: Et interrogabat eum: Quod tibi nomen est? Et dicit ei: Legio mihi nomen est, quia multi sumus.
tr: και επηρωτα αυτον τι σοι ονομα και απεκριθη λεγων λεγεων ονομα μοι οτι πολλοι εσμεν
kjv: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.

vulg: et deprecabatur eum multum ne se expelleret extra regionem
clem: Et deprecabatur eum multum, ne se expelleret extra regionem.
tr: και παρεκαλει αυτον πολλα ινα μη αυτους αποστειλη εξω της χωρας
kjv: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

vulg: erat autem ibi circa montem grex porcorum magnus pascens
clem: Erat autem ibi circa montem grex porcorum magnus, pascens.
tr: ην δε εκει προς τα ορη αγελη χοιρων μεγαλη βοσκομενη
kjv: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.

vulg: et deprecabantur eum spiritus dicentes mitte nos in porcos ut in eos introeamus
clem: Et deprecabantur eum spiritus, dicentes: Mitte nos in porcos ut in eos introamus.
tr: και παρεκαλεσαν αυτον παντες οι δαιμονες λεγοντες πεμψον ημας εις τους χοιρους ινα εις αυτους εισελθωμεν
kjv: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.

vulg: et concessit eis statim Iesus et exeuntes spiritus inmundi introierunt in porcos et magno impetu grex praecipitatus est in mare ad duo milia et suffocati sunt in mare
clem: Et concessit eis statim Jesus. Et exeuntes spiritus immundi introierunt in porcos: et magno impetu grex prcipitatus est in mare ad duo millia, et suffocati sunt in mari.
tr: και επετρεψεν αυτοις ευθεως ο ιησους και εξελθοντα τα πνευματα τα ακαθαρτα εισηλθον εις τους χοιρους και ωρμησεν η αγελη κατα του κρημνου εις την θαλασσαν ησαν δε ως δισχιλιοι και επνιγοντο εν τη θαλασση
kjv: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.

vulg: qui autem pascebant eos fugerunt et nuntiaverunt in civitatem et in agros et egressi sunt videre quid esset facti
clem: Qui autem pascebant eos, fugerunt, et nuntiaverunt in civitatem et in agros. Et egressi sunt videre quid esset factum:
tr: οι δε βοσκοντες τους χοιρους εφυγον και ανηγγειλαν εις την πολιν και εις τους αγρους και εξηλθον ιδειν τι εστιν το γεγονος
kjv: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.

vulg: et veniunt ad Iesum et vident illum qui a daemonio vexabatur sedentem vestitum et sanae mentis et timuerunt
clem: et veniunt ad Jesum: et vident illum qui a dmonio vexabatur, sedentem, vestitum, et san mentis, et timuerunt.
tr: και ερχονται προς τον ιησουν και θεωρουσιν τον δαιμονιζομενον καθημενον και ιματισμενον και σωφρονουντα τον εσχηκοτα τον λεγεωνα και εφοβηθησαν
kjv: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

vulg: et narraverunt illis qui viderant qualiter factum esset ei qui daemonium habuerat et de porcis
clem: Et narraverunt illis, qui viderant, qualiter factum esset ei qui dmonium habuerat, et de porcis.
tr: και διηγησαντο αυτοις οι ιδοντες πως εγενετο τω δαιμονιζομενω και περι των χοιρων
kjv: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.

vulg: et rogare eum coeperunt ut discederet de finibus eorum
clem: Et rogare cperunt eum ut discederet de finibus eorum.
tr: και ηρξαντο παρακαλειν αυτον απελθειν απο των οριων αυτων
kjv: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.

vulg: cumque ascenderet navem coepit illum deprecari qui daemonio vexatus fuerat ut esset cum illo
clem: Cumque ascenderet navim, cpit illum deprecari, qui a dmonio vexatus fuerat, ut esset cum illo,
tr: και εμβαντος αυτου εις το πλοιον παρεκαλει αυτον ο δαιμονισθεις ινα η μετ αυτου
kjv: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.

vulg: et non admisit eum sed ait illi vade in domum tuam ad tuos et adnuntia illis quanta tibi Dominus fecerit et misertus sit tui
clem: et non admisit eum, sed ait illi: Vade in domum tuam ad tuos, et annuntia illis quanta tibi Dominus fecerit, et misertus sit tui.
tr: ο δε ιησους ουκ αφηκεν αυτον αλλα λεγει αυτω υπαγε εις τον οικον σου προς τους σους και αναγγειλον αυτοις οσα σοι ο κυριος εποιησεν και ηλεησεν σε
kjv: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.

vulg: et abiit et coepit praedicare in Decapoli quanta sibi fecisset Iesus et omnes mirabantur
clem: Et abiit, et cpit prdicare in Decapoli, quanta sibi fecisset Jesus: et omnes mirabantur.
tr: και απηλθεν και ηρξατο κηρυσσειν εν τη δεκαπολει οσα εποιησεν αυτω ο ιησους και παντες εθαυμαζον
kjv: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.

vulg: et cum transcendisset Iesus in navi rursus trans fretum convenit turba multa ad illum et erat circa mare
clem: Et cum transcendisset Jesus in navi rursum trans fretum, convenit turba multa ad eum, et erat circa mare.
tr: και διαπερασαντος του ιησου εν τω πλοιω παλιν εις το περαν συνηχθη οχλος πολυς επ αυτον και ην παρα την θαλασσαν
kjv: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.

vulg: et venit quidam de archisynagogis nomine Iairus et videns eum procidit ad pedes eius
clem: Et venit quidam de archisynagogis nomine Jairus, et videns eum procidit ad pedes ejus,
tr: και ιδου ερχεται εις των αρχισυναγωγων ονοματι ιαειρος και ιδων αυτον πιπτει προς τους ποδας αυτου
kjv: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,

vulg: et deprecabatur eum multum dicens quoniam filia mea in extremis est veni inpone manus super eam ut salva sit et vivat
clem: et deprecabatur eum multum, dicens: Quoniam filia mea in extremis est, veni, impone manum super eam, ut salva sit, et vivat.
tr: και παρεκαλει αυτον πολλα λεγων οτι το θυγατριον μου εσχατως εχει ινα ελθων επιθης αυτη τας χειρας οπως σωθη και ζησεται
kjv: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.

vulg: et abiit cum illo et sequebatur eum turba multa et conprimebant illum
clem: Et abiit cum illo, et sequebatur eum turba multa, et comprimebant eum.
tr: και απηλθεν μετ αυτου και ηκολουθει αυτω οχλος πολυς και συνεθλιβον αυτον
kjv: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.

vulg: et mulier quae erat in profluvio sanguinis annis duodecim
clem: Et mulier, qu erat in profluvio sanguinis annis duodecim,
tr: και γυνη τις ουσα εν ρυσει αιματος ετη δωδεκα
kjv: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,

vulg: et fuerat multa perpessa a conpluribus medicis et erogaverat omnia sua nec quicquam profecerat sed magis deterius habebat
clem: et fuerat multa perpessa a compluribus medicis: et erogaverat omnia sua, nec quidquam profecerat, sed magis deterius habebat:
tr: και πολλα παθουσα υπο πολλων ιατρων και δαπανησασα τα παρ εαυτης παντα και μηδεν ωφεληθεισα αλλα μαλλον εις το χειρον ελθουσα
kjv: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,

vulg: cum audisset de Iesu venit in turba retro et tetigit vestimentum eius
clem: cum audisset de Jesu, venit in turba retro, et tetigit vestimentum ejus:
tr: ακουσασα περι του ιησου ελθουσα εν τω οχλω οπισθεν ηψατο του ιματιου αυτου
kjv: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.

vulg: dicebat enim quia si vel vestimentum eius tetigero salva ero
clem: dicebat enim: Quia si vel vestimentum ejus tetigero, salva ero.
tr: ελεγεν γαρ οτι καν των ιματιων αυτου αψωμαι σωθησομαι
kjv: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.

vulg: et confestim siccatus est fons sanguinis eius et sensit corpore quod sanata esset a plaga
clem: Et confestim siccatus est fons sanguinis ejus: et sensit corpore quia sanata esset a plaga.
tr: και ευθεως εξηρανθη η πηγη του αιματος αυτης και εγνω τω σωματι οτι ιαται απο της μαστιγος
kjv: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.

vulg: et statim Iesus cognoscens in semet ipso virtutem quae exierat de eo conversus ad turbam aiebat quis tetigit vestimenta mea
clem: Et statim Jesus in semetipso cognoscens virtutem qu exierat de illo, conversus ad turbam, aiebat: Quis tetigit vestimenta mea?
tr: και ευθεως ο ιησους επιγνους εν εαυτω την εξ αυτου δυναμιν εξελθουσαν επιστραφεις εν τω οχλω ελεγεν τις μου ηψατο των ιματιων
kjv: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?

vulg: et dicebant ei discipuli sui vides turbam conprimentem te et dicis quis me tetigit
clem: Et dicebant ei discipuli sui: Vides turbam comprimentem te, et dicis: Quis me tetigit?
tr: και ελεγον αυτω οι μαθηται αυτου βλεπεις τον οχλον συνθλιβοντα σε και λεγεις τις μου ηψατο
kjv: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

vulg: et circumspiciebat videre eam quae hoc fecerat
clem: Et circumspiciebat videre eam, qu hoc fecerat.
tr: και περιεβλεπετο ιδειν την τουτο ποιησασαν
kjv: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.

vulg: mulier autem timens et tremens sciens quod factum esset in se venit et procidit ante eum et dixit ei omnem veritatem
clem: Mulier vero timens et tremens, sciens quod factum esset in se, venit et procidit ante eum, et dixit ei omnem veritatem.
tr: η δε γυνη φοβηθεισα και τρεμουσα ειδυια ο γεγονεν επ αυτη ηλθεν και προσεπεσεν αυτω και ειπεν αυτω πασαν την αληθειαν
kjv: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

vulg: ille autem dixit ei filia fides tua te salvam fecit vade in pace et esto sana a plaga tua
clem: Ille autem dixit ei: Filia, fides tua te salvam fecit: vade in pace, et esto sana a plaga tua.
tr: ο δε ειπεν αυτη θυγατερ η πιστις σου σεσωκεν σε υπαγε εις ειρηνην και ισθι υγιης απο της μαστιγος σου
kjv: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.

vulg: adhuc eo loquente veniunt ab archisynagogo dicentes quia filia tua mortua est quid ultra vexas magistrum
clem: Adhuc eo loquente, veniunt ab archisynagago, dicentes: Quia filia tua mortua est: quid ultra vexas magistrum?
tr: ετι αυτου λαλουντος ερχονται απο του αρχισυναγωγου λεγοντες οτι η θυγατηρ σου απεθανεν τι ετι σκυλλεις τον διδασκαλον
kjv: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?

vulg: Iesus autem verbo quod dicebatur audito ait archisynagogo noli timere tantummodo crede
clem: Jesus autem audito verbo quod dicebatur, ait archisynagogo: Noli timere: tantummodo crede.
tr: ο δε ιησους ευθεως ακουσας τον λογον λαλουμενον λεγει τω αρχισυναγωγω μη φοβου μονον πιστευε
kjv: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.

vulg: et non admisit quemquam sequi se nisi Petrum et Iacobum et Iohannem fratrem Iacobi
clem: Et non admisit quemquam se sequi nisi Petrum, et Jacobum, et Joannem fratrem Jacobi.
tr: και ουκ αφηκεν ουδενα αυτω συνακολουθησαι ει μη πετρον και ιακωβον και ιωαννην τον αδελφον ιακωβου
kjv: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.

vulg: et veniunt in domum archisynagogi et videt tumultum et flentes et heiulantes multum
clem: Et veniunt in domum archisynagogi, et videt tumultum, et flentes, et ejulantes multum.
tr: και ερχεται εις τον οικον του αρχισυναγωγου και θεωρει θορυβον  και  κλαιοντας και αλαλαζοντας πολλα
kjv: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.

vulg: et ingressus ait eis quid turbamini et ploratis puella non est mortua sed dormit
clem: Et ingressus, ait illis: Quid turbamini, et ploratis? puella non est mortua, sed dormit.
tr: και εισελθων λεγει αυτοις τι θορυβεισθε και κλαιετε το παιδιον ουκ απεθανεν αλλα καθευδει
kjv: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.

vulg: et inridebant eum ipse vero eiectis omnibus adsumit patrem et matrem puellae et qui secum erant et ingreditur ubi erat puella iacens
clem: Et irridebant eum. Ipse vero ejectis omnibus assumit patrem, et matrem puell, et qui secum erant, et ingreditur ubi puella erat jacens.
tr: και κατεγελων αυτου ο δε εκβαλων απαντας παραλαμβανει τον πατερα του παιδιου και την μητερα και τους μετ αυτου και εισπορευεται οπου ην το παιδιον ανακειμενον
kjv: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.

vulg: et tenens manum puellae ait illi talitha cumi quod est interpretatum puella tibi dico surge
clem: Et tenens manum puell, ait illi: Talitha cumi, quod est interpretatum: Puella (tibi dico), surge.
