tr: και κρατησας της χειρος του παιδιου λεγει αυτη ταλιθα κουμι ο εστιν μεθερμηνευομενον το κορασιον σοι λεγω εγειραι
kjv: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.

vulg: et confestim surrexit puella et ambulabat erat autem annorum duodecim et obstipuerunt stupore maximo
clem: Et confestim surrexit puella, et ambulabat: erat autem annorum duodecim: et obstupuerunt stupore magno.
tr: και ευθεως ανεστη το κορασιον και περιεπατει ην γαρ ετων δωδεκα και εξεστησαν εκστασει μεγαλη
kjv: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.

vulg: et praecepit illis vehementer ut nemo id sciret et dixit dari illi manducare
clem: Et prcepit illis vehementer ut nemo id sciret: et dixit dari illi manducare.
tr: και διεστειλατο αυτοις πολλα ινα μηδεις γνω τουτο και ειπεν δοθηναι αυτη φαγειν
kjv: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.

vulg: et egressus inde abiit in patriam suam et sequebantur illum discipuli sui
clem: Et egressus inde, abiit in patriam suam: et sequebantur eum discipuli sui:
tr: και εξηλθεν εκειθεν και ηλθεν εις την πατριδα αυτου και ακολουθουσιν αυτω οι μαθηται αυτου
kjv: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.

vulg: et facto sabbato coepit in synagoga docere et multi audientes admirabantur in doctrina eius dicentes unde huic haec omnia et quae est sapientia quae data est illi et virtutes tales quae per manus eius efficiuntur
clem: et facto sabbato cpit in synagoga docere: et multi audientes admirabantur in doctrina ejus, dicentes: Unde huic hc omnia? et qu est sapientia, qu data est illi, et virtutes tales, qu per manus ejus efficiuntur?
tr: και γενομενου σαββατου ηρξατο εν τη συναγωγη διδασκειν και πολλοι ακουοντες εξεπλησσοντο λεγοντες ποθεν τουτω ταυτα και τις η σοφια η δοθεισα αυτω οτι και δυναμεις τοιαυται δια των χειρων αυτου γινονται
kjv: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?

vulg: nonne iste est faber filius Mariae frater Iacobi et Ioseph et Iudae et Simonis nonne et sorores eius hic nobiscum sunt et scandalizabantur in illo
clem: Nonne hic est faber, filius Mari, frater Jacobi, et Joseph, et Jud, et Simonis? nonne et sorores ejus hic nobiscum sunt? Et scandalizabantur in illo.
tr: ουχ ουτος εστιν ο τεκτων ο υιος μαριας αδελφος δε ιακωβου και ιωση και ιουδα και σιμωνος και ουκ εισιν αι αδελφαι αυτου ωδε προς ημας και εσκανδαλιζοντο εν αυτω
kjv: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.

vulg: et dicebat eis Iesus quia non est propheta sine honore nisi in patria sua et in cognatione sua et in domo sua
clem: Et dicebat illis Jesus: Quia non est propheta sine honore nisi in patria sua, et in domo sua, et in cognatione sua.
tr: ελεγεν δε αυτοις ο ιησους οτι ουκ εστιν προφητης ατιμος ει μη εν τη πατριδι αυτου και εν τοις συγγενεσιν και εν τη οικια αυτου
kjv: But Jesus, said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.

vulg: et non poterat ibi virtutem ullam facere nisi paucos infirmos inpositis manibus curavit
clem: Et non poterat ibi virtutem ullam facere, nisi paucos infirmos impositis manibus curavit:
tr: και ουκ ηδυνατο εκει ουδεμιαν δυναμιν ποιησαι ει μη ολιγοις αρρωστοις επιθεις τας χειρας εθεραπευσεν
kjv: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.

vulg: et mirabatur propter incredulitatem eorum
clem: et mirabatur propter incredulitatem eorum, et circuibat castella in circuitu docens.
tr: και εθαυμαζεν δια την απιστιαν αυτων και περιηγεν τας κωμας κυκλω διδασκων
kjv: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.

vulg: et circumibat castella in circuitu docens et convocavit duodecim et coepit eos mittere binos et dabat illis potestatem spirituum inmundorum
clem: Et vocavit duodecim: et cpit eos mittere binos, et dabat illis potestatem spirituum immundorum.
tr: και προσκαλειται τους δωδεκα και ηρξατο αυτους αποστελλειν δυο δυο και εδιδου αυτοις εξουσιαν των πνευματων των ακαθαρτων
kjv: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;

vulg: et praecepit eis ne quid tollerent in via nisi virgam tantum non peram non panem neque in zona aes
clem: Et prcepit eis ne quid tollerent in via, nisi virgam tantum: non peram, non panem, neque in zona s,
tr: και παρηγγειλεν αυτοις ινα μηδεν αιρωσιν εις οδον ει μη ραβδον μονον μη πηραν μη αρτον μη εις την ζωνην χαλκον
kjv: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:

vulg: sed calciatos sandaliis et ne induerentur duabus tunicis
clem: sed calceatos sandaliis, et ne induerentur duabus tunicis.
tr: αλλ υποδεδεμενους σανδαλια και μη ενδυσησθε  ενδυσασθαι  δυο χιτωνας
kjv: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.

vulg: et dicebat eis quocumque introieritis in domum illic manete donec exeatis inde
clem: Et dicebat eis: Quocumque introieritis in domum, illic manete donec exeatis inde:
tr: και ελεγεν αυτοις οπου εαν εισελθητε εις οικιαν εκει μενετε εως αν εξελθητε εκειθεν
kjv: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.

vulg: et quicumque non receperint vos nec audierint vos exeuntes inde excutite pulverem de pedibus vestris in testimonium illis
clem: et quicumque non receperint vos, nec audierint vos, exeuntes inde, excutite pulverem de pedibus vestris in testimonium illis.
tr: και οσοι αν μη δεξωνται υμας μηδε ακουσωσιν υμων εκπορευομενοι εκειθεν εκτιναξατε τον χουν τον υποκατω των ποδων υμων εις μαρτυριον αυτοις αμην λεγω υμιν ανεκτοτερον εσται σοδομοις η γομορροις εν ημερα κρισεως η τη πολει εκεινη
kjv: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.

vulg: et exeuntes praedicabant ut paenitentiam agerent
clem: Et exeuntes prdicabant ut pnitentiam agerent:
tr: και εξελθοντες εκηρυσσον ινα μετανοησωσιν
kjv: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.

vulg: et daemonia multa eiciebant et unguebant oleo multos aegrotos et sanabant
clem: et dmonia multa ejiciebant, et ungebant oleo multos gros, et sanabant.
tr: και δαιμονια πολλα εξεβαλλον και ηλειφον ελαιω πολλους αρρωστους και εθεραπευον
kjv: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.

vulg: et audivit Herodes rex manifestum enim factum est nomen eius et dicebat quia Iohannes Baptista resurrexit a mortuis et propterea inoperantur virtutes in illo
clem: Et audivit rex Herodes (manifestum enim factum est nomen ejus), et dicebat: Quia Joannes Baptista resurrexit a mortuis: et propterea virtutes operantur in illo.
tr: και ηκουσεν ο βασιλευς ηρωδης φανερον γαρ εγενετο το ονομα αυτου και ελεγεν οτι ιωαννης ο βαπτιζων εκ νεκρων ηγερθη και δια τουτο ενεργουσιν αι δυναμεις εν αυτω
kjv: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

vulg: alii autem dicebant quia Helias est alii vero dicebant propheta est quasi unus ex prophetis
clem: Alii autem dicebant: Quia Elias est; alii vero dicebant: Quia propheta est, quasi unus ex prophetis.
tr: αλλοι ελεγον οτι ηλιας εστιν αλλοι δε ελεγον οτι προφητης εστιν η ως εις των προφητων
kjv: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.

vulg: quo audito Herodes ait quem ego decollavi Iohannem hic a mortuis resurrexit
clem: Quo audito Herodes ait: Quem ego decollavi Joannem, hic a mortuis resurrexit.
tr: ακουσας δε ο ηρωδης ειπεν οτι ον εγω απεκεφαλισα ιωαννην ουτος εστιν αυτος ηγερθη εκ νεκρων
kjv: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.

vulg: ipse enim Herodes misit ac tenuit Iohannem et vinxit eum in carcere propter Herodiadem uxorem Philippi fratris sui quia duxerat eam
clem: Ipse enim Herodes misit, ac tenuit Joannem, et vinxit eum in carcere propter Herodiadem uxorem Philippi fratris sui, quia duxerat eam.
tr: αυτος γαρ ο ηρωδης αποστειλας εκρατησεν τον ιωαννην και εδησεν αυτον εν τη φυλακη δια ηρωδιαδα την γυναικα φιλιππου του αδελφου αυτου οτι αυτην εγαμησεν
kjv: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife: for he had married her.

vulg: dicebat enim Iohannes Herodi non licet tibi habere uxorem fratris tui
clem: Dicebat enim Joannes Herodi: Non licet tibi habere uxorem fratris tui.
tr: ελεγεν γαρ ο ιωαννης τω ηρωδη οτι ουκ εξεστιν σοι εχειν την γυναικα του αδελφου σου
kjv: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.

vulg: Herodias autem insidiabatur illi et volebat occidere eum nec poterat
clem: Herodias autem insidiabatur illi: et volebat occidere eum, nec poterat.
tr: η δε ηρωδιας ενειχεν αυτω και ηθελεν αυτον αποκτειναι και ουκ ηδυνατο
kjv: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:

vulg: Herodes enim metuebat Iohannem sciens eum virum iustum et sanctum et custodiebat eum et audito eo multa faciebat et libenter eum audiebat
clem: Herodes enim metuebat Joannem, sciens eum virum justum et sanctum: et custodiebat eum, et audito eo multa faciebat, et libenter eum audiebat.
tr: ο γαρ ηρωδης εφοβειτο τον ιωαννην ειδως αυτον ανδρα δικαιον και αγιον και συνετηρει αυτον και ακουσας αυτου πολλα εποιει και ηδεως αυτου ηκουεν
kjv: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.

vulg: et cum dies oportunus accidisset Herodes natalis sui cenam fecit principibus et tribunis et primis Galilaeae
clem: Et cum dies opportunus accidisset, Herodes natalis sui cnam fecit principibus, et tribunis, et primis Galil:
tr: και γενομενης ημερας ευκαιρου οτε ηρωδης τοις γενεσιοις αυτου δειπνον εποιει τοις μεγιστασιν αυτου και τοις χιλιαρχοις και τοις πρωτοις της γαλιλαιας
kjv: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;

vulg: cumque introisset filia ipsius Herodiadis et saltasset et placuisset Herodi simulque recumbentibus rex ait puellae pete a me quod vis et dabo tibi
clem: cumque introisset filia ipsius Herodiadis, et saltasset, et placuisset Herodi, simulque recumbentibus, rex ait puell: Pete a me quod vis, et dabo tibi:
tr: και εισελθουσης της θυγατρος αυτης της ηρωδιαδος και ορχησαμενης και αρεσασης τω ηρωδη και τοις συνανακειμενοις ειπεν ο βασιλευς τω κορασιω αιτησον με ο εαν θελης και δωσω σοι
kjv: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.

vulg: et iuravit illi quia quicquid petieris dabo tibi licet dimidium regni mei
clem: et juravit illi: Quia quidquid petieris dabo tibi, licet dimidium regni mei.
tr: και ωμοσεν αυτη οτι ο εαν με αιτησης δωσω σοι εως ημισους της βασιλειας μου
kjv: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.

vulg: quae cum exisset dixit matri suae quid petam et illa dixit caput Iohannis Baptistae
clem: Qu cum exisset, dixit matri su: Quid petam? At illa dixit: Caput Joannis Baptist.
tr: η δε εξελθουσα ειπεν τη μητρι αυτης τι αιτησομαι η δε ειπεν την κεφαλην ιωαννου του βαπτιστου
kjv: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.

vulg: cumque introisset statim cum festinatione ad regem petivit dicens volo ut protinus des mihi in disco caput Iohannis Baptistae
clem: Cumque introisset statim cum festinatione ad regem, petivit dicens: Volo ut protinus des mihi in disco caput Joannis Baptist.
tr: και εισελθουσα ευθεως μετα σπουδης προς τον βασιλεα ητησατο λεγουσα θελω ινα μοι δως εξ αυτης  εξαυτης  επι πινακι την κεφαλην ιωαννου του βαπτιστου
kjv: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.

vulg: et contristatus rex propter iusiurandum et propter simul recumbentes noluit eam contristare
clem: Et contristatus est rex: propter jusjurandum, et propter simul discumbentes, noluit eam contristare:
tr: και περιλυπος γενομενος ο βασιλευς δια τους ορκους και τους συνανακειμενους ουκ ηθελησεν αυτην αθετησαι
kjv: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath's sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.

vulg: sed misso speculatore praecepit adferri caput eius in disco et decollavit eum in carcere
clem: sed misso speculatore prcepit afferri caput ejus in disco. Et decollavit eum in carcere,
tr: και ευθεως αποστειλας ο βασιλευς σπεκουλατωρα επεταξεν ενεχθηναι την κεφαλην αυτου (6:28) ο δε απελθων απεκεφαλισεν αυτον εν τη φυλακη
kjv: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

vulg: et adtulit caput eius in disco et dedit illud puellae et puella dedit matri suae
clem: et attulit caput ejus in disco: et dedit illud puell, et puella dedit matri su.
tr: και ηνεγκεν την κεφαλην αυτου επι πινακι και εδωκεν αυτην τω κορασιω και το κορασιον εδωκεν αυτην τη μητρι αυτης
kjv: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.

vulg: quo audito discipuli eius venerunt et tulerunt corpus eius et posuerunt illud in monumento
clem: Quo audito, discipuli ejus venerunt, et tulerunt corpus ejus: et posuerunt illud in monumento.
tr: και ακουσαντες οι μαθηται αυτου ηλθον και ηραν το πτωμα αυτου και εθηκαν αυτο εν τω   μνημειω
kjv: And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.

vulg: et convenientes apostoli ad Iesum renuntiaverunt illi omnia quae egerant et docuerant
clem: Et convenientes Apostoli ad Jesum, renuntiaverunt ei omnia qu egerant, et docuerant.
tr: και συναγονται οι αποστολοι προς τον ιησουν και απηγγειλαν αυτω παντα και οσα εποιησαν και οσα εδιδαξαν
kjv: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.

vulg: et ait illis venite seorsum in desertum locum et requiescite pusillum erant enim qui veniebant et rediebant multi et nec manducandi spatium habebant
clem: Et ait illis: Venite seorsum in desertum locum, et requiescite pusillum. Erant enim qui veniebant et redibant multi: et nec spatium manducandi habebant.
tr: και ειπεν αυτοις δευτε υμεις αυτοι κατ ιδιαν εις ερημον τοπον και αναπαυεσθε ολιγον ησαν γαρ οι ερχομενοι και οι υπαγοντες πολλοι και ουδε φαγειν ηυκαιρουν
kjv: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

vulg: et ascendentes in navi abierunt in desertum locum seorsum
clem: Et ascendentes in navim, abierunt in desertum locum seorsum.
tr: και απηλθον εις ερημον τοπον τω πλοιω κατ ιδιαν
kjv: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.

vulg: et viderunt eos abeuntes et cognoverunt multi et pedestre et de omnibus civitatibus concurrerunt illuc et praevenerunt eos
clem: Et viderunt eos abeuntes, et cognoverunt multi: et pedestres de omnibus civitatibus concurrerunt illuc, et prvenerunt eos.
tr: και ειδον αυτους υπαγοντας οι οχλοι και επεγνωσαν αυτον πολλοι και πεζη απο πασων των πολεων συνεδραμον εκει και προηλθον αυτους και συνηλθον προς αυτον
kjv: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.

vulg: et exiens vidit multam turbam Iesus et misertus est super eos quia erant sicut oves non habentes pastorem et coepit docere illos multa
clem: Et exiens vidit turbam multam Jesus: et misertus est super eos, quia erant sicut oves non habentes pastorem, et cpit docere multa.
tr: και εξελθων ειδεν ο ιησους πολυν οχλον και εσπλαγχνισθη επ αυτοις οτι ησαν ως προβατα μη εχοντα ποιμενα και ηρξατο διδασκειν αυτους πολλα
kjv: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.

vulg: et cum iam hora multa fieret accesserunt discipuli eius dicentes desertus est locus hic et iam hora praeterivit
clem: Et cum jam hora multa fieret, accesserunt discipuli ejus, dicentes: Desertus est locus hic, et jam hora prteriit:
tr: και ηδη ωρας πολλης γενομενης προσελθοντες αυτω οι μαθηται αυτου λεγουσιν οτι ερημος εστιν ο τοπος και ηδη ωρα πολλη
kjv: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:

vulg: dimitte illos ut euntes in proximas villas et vicos emant sibi cibos quos manducent
clem: dimitte illos, ut euntes in proximas villas et vicos, emant sibi cibos, quos manducent.
tr: απολυσον αυτους ινα απελθοντες εις τους κυκλω αγρους και κωμας αγορασωσιν εαυτοις αρτους τι γαρ φαγωσιν ουκ εχουσιν
kjv: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.

vulg: et respondens ait illis date illis manducare et dixerunt ei euntes emamus denariis ducentis panes et dabimus eis manducare
clem: Et respondens ait illis: Date illis vos manducare. Et dixerunt ei: Euntes emamus ducentis denariis panes, et dabimus illis manducare.
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν αυτοις δοτε αυτοις υμεις φαγειν και λεγουσιν αυτω απελθοντες αγορασωμεν διακοσιων δηναριων αρτους και δωμεν αυτοις φαγειν
kjv: He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?

vulg: et dicit eis quot panes habetis ite et videte et cum cognovissent dicunt quinque et duos pisces
clem: Et dicit eis: Quot panes habetis? ite, et videte. Et cum cognovissent, dicunt: Quinque, et duos pisces.
tr: ο δε λεγει αυτοις ποσους αρτους εχετε υπαγετε και ιδετε και γνοντες λεγουσιν πεντε και δυο ιχθυας
kjv: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.

vulg: et praecepit illis ut accumbere facerent omnes secundum contubernia super viride faenum
clem: Et prcepit illis ut accumbere facerent omnes secundum contubernia super viride fnum.
tr: και επεταξεν αυτοις ανακλιναι παντας συμποσια συμποσια επι τω χλωρω χορτω
kjv: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.

vulg: et discubuerunt in partes per centenos et per quinquagenos
clem: Et discubuerunt in partes per centenos et quinquagenos.
tr: και ανεπεσον πρασιαι πρασιαι ανα εκατον και ανα πεντηκοντα
kjv: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.

vulg: et acceptis quinque panibus et duobus piscibus intuens in caelum benedixit et fregit panes et dedit discipulis suis ut ponerent ante eos et duos pisces divisit omnibus
clem: Et acceptis quinque panibus et duobus pisces, intuens in clum, benedixit, et fregit panes, et dedit discipulis suis, ut ponerent ante eos: et duos pisces divisit omnibus.
tr: και λαβων τους πεντε αρτους και τους δυο ιχθυας αναβλεψας εις τον ουρανον ευλογησεν και κατεκλασεν τους αρτους και εδιδου τοις μαθηταις αυτου ινα παραθωσιν αυτοις και τους δυο ιχθυας εμερισεν πασιν
kjv: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.

vulg: et manducaverunt omnes et saturati sunt
clem: Et manducaverunt omnes, et saturati sunt.
tr: και εφαγον παντες και εχορτασθησαν
kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled.

vulg: et sustulerunt reliquias fragmentorum duodecim cofinos plenos et de piscibus
clem: Et sustulerunt reliquias, fragmentorum duodecim cophinos plenos, et de piscibus.
tr: και ηραν κλασματων δωδεκα κοφινους πληρεις και απο των ιχθυων
kjv: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.

vulg: erant autem qui manducaverunt quinque milia virorum
clem: Erant autem qui manducaverunt quinque millia virorum.
tr: και ησαν οι φαγοντες τους αρτους ωσει πεντακισχιλιοι ανδρες
kjv: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.

vulg: et statim coegit discipulos suos ascendere navem ut praecederent eum trans fretum ad Bethsaidam dum ipse dimitteret populum
clem: Et statim cogit discipulos suos ascendere navim, ut prcederent eum trans fretum ad Bethsaidam, dum ipse dimitteret populum.
tr: και ευθεως ηναγκασεν τους μαθητας αυτου εμβηναι 1684 εις το πλοιον και προαγειν εις το περαν προς βηθσαιδαν  βηθσαιδα  εως αυτος απολυση τον οχλον
kjv: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.

vulg: et cum dimisisset eos abiit in montem orare
clem: Et cum dimisisset eos, abiit in montem orare.
tr: και αποταξαμενος αυτοις απηλθεν εις το ορος προσευξασθαι
kjv: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.

vulg: et cum sero esset erat navis in medio mari et ipse solus in terra
clem: Et cum sero esset, erat navis in medio mari et ipse solus in terra.
tr: και οψιας γενομενης ην το πλοιον εν μεσω της θαλασσης και αυτος μονος επι της γης
kjv: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.

vulg: et videns eos laborantes in remigando erat enim ventus contrarius eis et circa quartam vigiliam noctis venit ad eos ambulans super mare et volebat praeterire eos
clem: Et videns eos laborantes in remigando (erat enim ventus contrarius eis) et circa quartam vigiliam noctis venit ad eos ambulans supra mare: et volebat prterire eos.
tr: και ειδεν αυτους βασανιζομενους εν τω ελαυνειν ην γαρ ο ανεμος εναντιος αυτοις και περι τεταρτην φυλακην της νυκτος ερχεται προς αυτους περιπατων επι της θαλασσης και ηθελεν παρελθειν αυτους
kjv: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.

vulg: at illi ut viderunt eum ambulantem super mare putaverunt fantasma esse et exclamaverunt
clem: At illi ut viderunt eum ambulantem supra mare, putaverunt phantasma esse, et exclamaverunt.
tr: οι δε ιδοντες αυτον περιπατουντα επι της θαλασσης εδοξαν φαντασμα ειναι και ανεκραξαν
kjv: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:

vulg: omnes enim eum viderunt et conturbati sunt et statim locutus est cum eis et dixit illis confidite ego sum nolite timere
clem: Omnes enim viderunt eum, et conturbati sunt. Et statim locutus est cum eis, et dixit eis: Confidite, ego sum: nolite timere.
tr: παντες γαρ αυτον ειδον και εταραχθησαν και ευθεως ελαλησεν μετ αυτων και λεγει αυτοις θαρσειτε εγω ειμι μη φοβεισθε
kjv: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.

vulg: et ascendit ad illos in navem et cessavit ventus et plus magis intra se stupebant
clem: Et ascendit ad illos in navim, et cessavit ventus. Et plus magis intra se stupebant:
tr: και ανεβη προς αυτους εις το πλοιον και εκοπασεν ο ανεμος και λιαν εκ περισσου εν εαυτοις εξισταντο και εθαυμαζον
kjv: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.

vulg: non enim intellexerant de panibus erat enim cor illorum obcaecatum
clem: non enim intellexerunt de panibus: erat enim cor eorum obccatum.
tr: ου γαρ συνηκαν επι τοις αρτοις ην γαρ η καρδια αυτων πεπωρωμενη
kjv: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.

vulg: et cum transfretassent pervenerunt in terram Gennesareth et adplicuerunt
clem: Et cum transfretassent, venerunt in terram Genesareth, et applicuerunt.
tr: και διαπερασαντες ηλθον 2064 επι την γην γενησαρετ  γεννησαρετ  και προσωρμισθησαν
kjv: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.

vulg: cumque egressi essent de navi continuo cognoverunt eum
clem: Cumque egressi essent de navi, continuo cognoverunt eum:
tr: και εξελθοντων αυτων εκ του πλοιου ευθεως επιγνοντες αυτον
kjv: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,

vulg: et percurrentes universam regionem illam coeperunt in grabattis eos qui se male habebant circumferre ubi audiebant eum esse
clem: et percurrentes universam regionem illam, cperunt in grabatis eos, qui se male habebant, circumferre, ubi audiebant eum esse.
tr: περιδραμοντες ολην την περιχωρον εκεινην ηρξαντο επι τοις κραββατοις τους κακως εχοντας περιφερειν οπου ηκουον οτι εκει εστιν
kjv: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.

vulg: et quocumque introibat in vicos vel in villas aut civitates in plateis ponebant infirmos et deprecabantur eum ut vel fimbriam vestimenti eius tangerent et quotquot tangebant eum salvi fiebant
clem: Et quocumque introibat, in vicos, vel in villas aut civitates, in plateis ponebant infirmos, et deprecabantur eum, ut vel fimbriam vestimenti ejus tangerent, et quotquot tangebant eum, salvi fiebant.
tr: και οπου αν εισεπορευετο εις κωμας η πολεις η αγρους εν ταις αγοραις ετιθουν τους ασθενουντας και παρεκαλουν αυτον ινα καν του κρασπεδου του ιματιου αυτου αψωνται και οσοι αν ηπτοντο αυτου εσωζοντο
kjv: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.

vulg: et conveniunt ad eum Pharisaei et quidam de scribis venientes ab Hierosolymis
clem: Et conveniunt ad eum pharisi, et quidam de scribis, venientes ab Jerosolymis.
tr: και συναγονται προς αυτον οι φαρισαιοι και τινες των γραμματεων ελθοντες απο ιεροσολυμων
kjv: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.

vulg: et cum vidissent quosdam ex discipulis eius communibus manibus id est non lotis manducare panes vituperaverunt
clem: Et cum vidissent quosdam ex discipulis ejus communibus manibus, id est non lotis, manducare panes, vituperaverunt.
tr: και ιδοντες τινας των μαθητων αυτου κοιναις χερσιν τουτ εστιν ανιπτοις εσθιοντας αρτους εμεμψαντο
kjv: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.

vulg: Pharisaei enim et omnes Iudaei nisi crebro lavent manus non manducant tenentes traditionem seniorum
clem: Pharisi enim, et omnes Judi, nisi crebro laverint manus, non manducant, tenentes traditionem seniorum:
tr: οι γαρ φαρισαιοι και παντες οι ιουδαιοι εαν μη πυγμη νιψωνται τας χειρας ουκ εσθιουσιν κρατουντες την παραδοσιν των πρεσβυτερων
kjv: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.

vulg: et a foro nisi baptizentur non comedunt et alia multa sunt quae tradita sunt illis servare baptismata calicum et urceorum et aeramentorum et lectorum
clem: et a foro nisi baptizentur, non comedunt: et alia multa sunt, qu tradita sunt illis servare, baptismata calicum, et urceorum, et ramentorum, et lectorum:
tr: και απο αγορας εαν μη βαπτισωνται ουκ εσθιουσιν και αλλα πολλα εστιν α παρελαβον κρατειν βαπτισμους ποτηριων και ξεστων και χαλκιων και κλινων
kjv: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.

vulg: et interrogant eum Pharisaei et scribae quare discipuli tui non ambulant iuxta traditionem seniorum sed communibus manibus manducant panem
clem: et interrogabant eum pharisi et scrib: Quare discipuli tui non ambulant juxta traditionem seniorum, sed communibus manibus manducant panem?
tr: επειτα επερωτωσιν αυτον οι φαρισαιοι και οι γραμματεις δια τι οι μαθηται σου ου περιπατουσιν κατα την παραδοσιν των πρεσβυτερων αλλα ανιπτοις χερσιν εσθιουσιν τον αρτον
kjv: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?

vulg: at ille respondens dixit eis bene prophetavit Esaias de vobis hypocritis sicut scriptum est populus hic labiis me honorat cor autem eorum longe est a me
clem: At ille respondens, dixit eis: Bene prophetavit Isaias de vobis hypocritis, sicut scriptum est: [Populus hic labiis me honorat, cor autem eorum longe est a me:
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν αυτοις οτι καλως προεφητευσεν ησαιας περι υμων των υποκριτων ως γεγραπται ουτος ο λαος τοις χειλεσιν με τιμα η δε καρδια αυτων πορρω απεχει απ εμου
kjv: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

vulg: in vanum autem me colunt docentes doctrinas praecepta hominum
clem: in vanum autem me colunt, docentes doctrinas, et prcepta hominum.]
tr: ματην δε σεβονται με διδασκοντες διδασκαλιας ενταλματα ανθρωπων
kjv: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.

vulg: relinquentes enim mandatum Dei tenetis traditionem hominum baptismata urceorum et calicum et alia similia his facitis multa
clem: Relinquentes enim mandatum Dei, tenetis traditionem hominum, baptismata urceorum et calicum: et alia similia his facitis multa.
tr: αφεντες γαρ την εντολην του θεου κρατειτε την παραδοσιν των ανθρωπων βαπτισμους ξεστων και ποτηριων και αλλα παρομοια τοιαυτα πολλα ποιειτε
kjv: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.

vulg: et dicebat illis bene irritum facitis praeceptum Dei ut traditionem vestram servetis
clem: Et dicebat illis: Bene irritum facitis prceptum Dei, ut traditionem vestram servetis.
tr: και ελεγεν αυτοις καλως αθετειτε την εντολην του θεου ινα την παραδοσιν υμων τηρησητε
kjv: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.

vulg: Moses enim dixit honora patrem tuum et matrem tuam et qui maledixerit patri aut matri morte moriatur
clem: Moyses enim dixit: Honora patrem tuum, et matrem tuam. Et: Qui maledixerit patri, vel matri, morte moriatur.
tr: μωσης γαρ ειπεν τιμα τον πατερα σου και την μητερα σου και ο κακολογων πατερα η μητερα θανατω τελευτατω
kjv: For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:

vulg: vos autem dicitis si dixerit homo patri aut matri corban quod est donum quodcumque ex me tibi profuerit
clem: Vos autem dicitis: Si dixerit homo patri, aut matri, Corban (quod est donum) quodcumque ex me, tibi profuerit:
tr: υμεις δε λεγετε εαν ειπη ανθρωπος τω πατρι η τη μητρι κορβαν ο εστιν δωρον ο εαν εξ εμου ωφεληθης
kjv: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.

vulg: et ultra non dimittitis eum quicquam facere patri suo aut matri
clem: et ultra non dimittitis eum quidquam facere patri suo, aut matri,
tr: και ουκετι αφιετε αυτον ουδεν ποιησαι τω πατρι αυτου η τη μητρι αυτου
kjv: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;

vulg: rescindentes verbum Dei per traditionem vestram quam tradidistis et similia huiusmodi multa facitis
clem: rescindentes verbum Dei per traditionem vestram, quam tradidistis: et similia hujusmodi multa facitis.
tr: ακυρουντες τον λογον του θεου τη παραδοσει υμων η παρεδωκατε και παρομοια τοιαυτα πολλα ποιειτε
kjv: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.

vulg: et advocans iterum turbam dicebat illis audite me omnes et intellegite
clem: Et advocans iterum turbam, dicebat illis: Audite me omnes, et intelligite.
tr: και προσκαλεσαμενος παντα τον οχλον ελεγεν αυτοις ακουετε μου παντες και συνιετε
kjv: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:

vulg: nihil est extra hominem introiens in eum quod possit eum coinquinare sed quae de homine procedunt illa sunt quae communicant hominem
clem: Nihil est extra hominem introiens in eum, quod possit eum coinquare, sed qu de homine procedunt illa sunt qu communicant hominem.
tr: ουδεν εστιν εξωθεν του ανθρωπου εισπορευομενον εις αυτον ο δυναται αυτον κοινωσαι αλλα τα εκπορευομενα απ αυτου εκεινα εστιν τα κοινουντα τον ανθρωπον
kjv: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.

vulg: si quis habet aures audiendi audiat
clem: Si quis habet aures audiendi, audiat.
tr: ει τις εχει ωτα ακουειν ακουετω
kjv: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.

vulg: et cum introisset in domum a turba interrogabant eum discipuli eius parabolam
clem: Et cum introisset in domum a turba, interrogabant eum discipuli ejus parabolam.
tr: και οτε εισηλθεν εις οικον απο του οχλου επηρωτων αυτον οι μαθηται αυτου περι της παραβολης
kjv: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.

vulg: et ait illis sic et vos inprudentes estis non intellegitis quia omne extrinsecus introiens in hominem non potest eum communicare
clem: Et ait illis: Sic et vos imprudentes estis? Non intelligitis quia omne extrinsecus introiens in hominem, non potest eum communicare:
tr: και λεγει αυτοις ουτως και υμεις ασυνετοι εστε ου νοειτε οτι παν το εξωθεν εισπορευομενον εις τον ανθρωπον ου δυναται αυτον κοινωσαι
kjv: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;

vulg: quia non introit in cor eius sed in ventrem et in secessum exit purgans omnes escas
clem: quia non intrat in cor ejus, sed in ventrum vadit, et in secessum exit, purgans omnes escas?
tr: οτι ουκ εισπορευεται αυτου εις την καρδιαν αλλ εις την κοιλιαν και εις τον αφεδρωνα εκπορευεται καθαριζον παντα τα βρωματα
kjv: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?

vulg: dicebat autem quoniam quae de homine exeunt illa communicant hominem
clem: Dicebat autem, quoniam qu de homine exeunt, illa communicant hominem.
tr: ελεγεν δε οτι το εκ του ανθρωπου εκπορευομενον εκεινο κοινοι τον ανθρωπον
kjv: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.

vulg: ab intus enim de corde hominum cogitationes malae procedunt adulteria fornicationes homicidia
clem: Ab intus enim de corde hominum mal cogitationes procedunt, adulteria, fornicationes, homicidia,
tr: εσωθεν γαρ εκ της καρδιας των ανθρωπων οι διαλογισμοι οι κακοι εκπορευονται μοιχειαι πορνειαι φονοι
kjv: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,

vulg: furta avaritiae nequitiae dolus inpudicitia oculus malus blasphemia superbia stultitia
clem: furta, avariti, nequiti, dolus, impudiciti, oculus malus, blasphemia, superbia, stultitia.
tr: κλοπαι πλεονεξιαι πονηριαι δολος ασελγεια οφθαλμος πονηρος βλασφημια υπερηφανια αφροσυνη
kjv: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:

vulg: omnia haec mala ab intus procedunt et communicant hominem
clem: Omnia hc mala ab intus procedunt, et communicant hominem.
tr: παντα ταυτα τα πονηρα εσωθεν εκπορευεται και κοινοι τον ανθρωπον
kjv: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.

vulg: et inde surgens abiit in fines Tyri et Sidonis et ingressus domum neminem voluit scire et non potuit latere
clem: Et inde surgens abiit in fines Tyri et Sidonis: et ingressus domum, neminem voluit scire, et non potuit latere.
tr: και εκειθεν αναστας απηλθεν εις τα μεθορια τυρου και σιδωνος και εισελθων εις την οικιαν ουδενα ηθελεν γνωναι και ουκ ηδυνηθη λαθειν
kjv: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.

vulg: mulier enim statim ut audivit de eo cuius habebat filia spiritum inmundum intravit et procidit ad pedes eius
clem: Mulier enim statim ut audivit de eo, cujus filia habebat spiritum immundum, intravit, et procidit ad pedes ejus.
tr: ακουσασα γαρ γυνη περι αυτου ης ειχεν το θυγατριον αυτης πνευμα ακαθαρτον ελθουσα προσεπεσεν προς τους ποδας αυτου
kjv: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:

vulg: erat autem mulier gentilis Syrophoenissa genere et rogabat eum ut daemonium eiceret de filia eius
clem: Erat enim mulier gentilis, Syrophnissa genere. Et rogabat eum ut dmonium ejiceret de filia ejus.
tr: ην δε η γυνη ελληνις συροφοινισσα τω γενει και ηρωτα αυτον ινα το δαιμονιον εκβαλλη εκ της θυγατρος αυτης
kjv: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.

vulg: qui dixit illi sine prius saturari filios non est enim bonum sumere panem filiorum et mittere canibus
clem: Qui dixit illi: Sine prius saturari filios: non est enim bonum sumere panem filiorum, et mittere canibus.
tr: ο δε ιησους ειπεν αυτη αφες πρωτον χορτασθηναι τα τεκνα ου γαρ καλον εστιν λαβειν τον αρτον των τεκνων και βαλειν τοις κυναριοις
kjv: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.

vulg: at illa respondit et dicit ei utique Domine nam et catelli sub mensa comedunt de micis puerorum
clem: At illa respondit, et dixit illi: Utique Domine, nam et catelli comedunt sub mensa de micis puerorum.
tr: η δε απεκριθη και λεγει αυτω ναι κυριε και γαρ τα κυναρια υποκατω της τραπεζης εσθιει απο των ψιχιων των παιδιων
kjv: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.

vulg: et ait illi propter hunc sermonem vade exiit daemonium de filia tua
clem: Et ait illi: Propter hunc sermonem vade: exiit dmonium a filia tua.
tr: και ειπεν αυτη δια τουτον τον λογον υπαγε εξεληλυθεν το δαιμονιον εκ της θυγατρος σου
kjv: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.

vulg: et cum abisset domum suam invenit puellam iacentem supra lectum et daemonium exisse
clem: Et cum abiisset domum suam, invenit puellam jacentem supra lectum, et dmonium exiisse.
tr: και απελθουσα εις τον οικον αυτης ευρεν το δαιμονιον εξεληλυθος και την θυγατερα βεβλημενην επι της κλινης
kjv: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.

vulg: et iterum exiens de finibus Tyri venit per Sidonem ad mare Galilaeae inter medios fines Decapoleos
clem: Et iterum exiens de finibus Tyri, venit per Sidonem ad mare Galil inter medios fines Decapoleos.
tr: και παλιν εξελθων εκ των οριων τυρου και σιδωνος ηλθεν προς την θαλασσαν της γαλιλαιας ανα μεσον των οριων δεκαπολεως
kjv: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.

vulg: et adducunt ei surdum et mutum et deprecantur eum ut inponat illi manum
clem: Et adducunt ei surdum, et mutum, et deprecabantur eum, ut imponat illi manum.
tr: και φερουσιν αυτω κωφον μογιλαλον και παρακαλουσιν αυτον ινα επιθη αυτω την χειρα
kjv: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.

vulg: et adprehendens eum de turba seorsum misit digitos suos in auriculas et expuens tetigit linguam eius
clem: Et apprehendens eum de turba seorsum, misit digitos suos in auriculas ejus: et exspuens, tetigit linguam ejus:
tr: και απολαβομενος αυτον απο του οχλου κατ ιδιαν εβαλεν τους δακτυλους αυτου εις τα ωτα αυτου και πτυσας ηψατο της γλωσσης αυτου
kjv: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;

vulg: et suspiciens in caelum ingemuit et ait illi eppheta quod est adaperire
clem: et suscipiens in clum, ingemuit, et ait illi: Ephphetha, quod est, Adaperire.
tr: και αναβλεψας εις τον ουρανον εστεναξεν και λεγει αυτω εφφαθα ο εστιν διανοιχθητι
kjv: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.

vulg: et statim apertae sunt aures eius et solutum est vinculum linguae eius et loquebatur recte
clem: Et statim apert sunt aures ejus, et solutum est vinculum lingu ejus, et loquebatur recte.
tr: και ευθεως διηνοιχθησαν αυτου αι ακοαι και ελυθη ο δεσμος της γλωσσης αυτου και ελαλει ορθως
kjv: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.

vulg: et praecepit illis ne cui dicerent quanto autem eis praecipiebat tanto magis plus praedicabant
clem: Et prcepit illis ne cui dicerent. Quanto autem eis prcipiebat, tanto magis plus prdicabant:
tr: και διεστειλατο αυτοις ινα μηδενι ειπωσιν οσον δε αυτος αυτοις διεστελλετο μαλλον περισσοτερον εκηρυσσον
kjv: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;

vulg: et eo amplius admirabantur dicentes bene omnia fecit et surdos facit audire et mutos loqui
clem: et eo amplius admirabantur, dicentes: Bene omnia fecit: et surdos fecit audire, et mutos loqui.
tr: και υπερπερισσως εξεπλησσοντο λεγοντες καλως παντα πεποιηκεν και τους κωφους ποιει ακουειν και τους αλαλους λαλειν
kjv: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.

vulg: in illis diebus iterum cum turba multa esset nec haberent quod manducarent convocatis discipulis ait illis
clem: In diebus illis iterum cum turba multa esset, nec haberent quod manducarent, convocatis discipulis, ait illis:
tr: εν εκειναις ταις ημεραις παμπολλου οχλου οντος και μη εχοντων τι φαγωσιν προσκαλεσαμενος ο ιησους τους μαθητας αυτου λεγει αυτοις
kjv: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and saith unto them,

vulg: misereor super turba quia ecce iam triduo sustinent me nec habent quod manducent
clem: Misereor super turbam: quia ecce jam triduo sustinent me, nec habent quod manducent:
tr: σπλαγχνιζομαι επι τον οχλον οτι ηδη ημερας τρεις προσμενουσιν μοι και ουκ εχουσιν τι φαγωσιν
kjv: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:

vulg: et si dimisero eos ieiunos in domum suam deficient in via quidam enim ex eis de longe venerunt
clem: et si dimisero eos jejunos in domum suam, deficient in via: quidam enim ex eis de longe venerunt.
tr: και εαν απολυσω αυτους νηστεις εις οικον αυτων εκλυθησονται εν τη οδω τινες γαρ αυτων μακροθεν ηκασιν
kjv: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.

vulg: et responderunt ei discipuli sui unde istos poterit quis hic saturare panibus in solitudine
clem: Et responderunt ei discipuli sui: Unde illos quis poterit saturare panibus in solitudine?
tr: και απεκριθησαν αυτω οι μαθηται αυτου ποθεν τουτους δυνησεται τις ωδε χορτασαι αρτων επ ερημιας
kjv: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?

vulg: et interrogavit eos quot panes habetis qui dixerunt septem
clem: Et interrogavit eos: Quot panes habetis? Qui dixerunt: Septem.
tr: και επηρωτα αυτους ποσους εχετε αρτους οι δε ειπον επτα
kjv: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.

vulg: et praecepit turbae discumbere supra terram et accipiens septem panes gratias agens fregit et dabat discipulis suis ut adponerent et adposuerunt turbae
clem: Et prcepit turb discumbere super terram. Et accipiens septem panes, gratias agens fregit, et dabat discipulis suis ut apponerent, et apposuerunt turb.
tr: και παρηγγειλεν τω οχλω αναπεσειν επι της γης και λαβων τους επτα αρτους ευχαριστησας εκλασεν και εδιδου τοις μαθηταις αυτου ινα παραθωσιν και παρεθηκαν τω οχλω
kjv: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.

vulg: et habebant pisciculos paucos et ipsos benedixit et iussit adponi
clem: Et habebant pisciculos paucos: et ipsos benedixit, et jussit apponi.
tr: και ειχον ιχθυδια ολιγα και ευλογησας ειπεν παραθειναι και αυτα
kjv: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.

vulg: et manducaverunt et saturati sunt et sustulerunt quod superaverat de fragmentis septem sportas
clem: Et manducaverunt, et saturati sunt, et sustulerunt quod superaverat de fragmentis, septem sportas.
tr: εφαγον δε και εχορτασθησαν και ηραν περισσευματα κλασματων επτα σπυριδας
kjv: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.

vulg: erant autem qui manducaverunt quasi quattuor milia et dimisit eos
clem: Erant autem qui manducaverunt, quasi quatuor millia: et dimisit eos.
tr: ησαν δε οι φαγοντες ως τετρακισχιλιοι και απελυσεν αυτους
kjv: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.

vulg: et statim ascendens navem cum discipulis suis venit in partes Dalmanutha
clem: Et statim ascendens navim cum discipulis suis, venit in partes Dalmanutha.
tr: και ευθεως εμβας εις το πλοιον μετα των μαθητων αυτου ηλθεν εις τα μερη δαλμανουθα
kjv: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.

vulg: et exierunt Pharisaei et coeperunt conquirere cum eo quaerentes ab illo signum de caelo temptantes eum
clem: Et exierunt pharisi, et cperunt conquirere cum eo, qurentes ab illo signum de clo, tentantes eum.
tr: και εξηλθον οι φαρισαιοι και ηρξαντο συζητειν αυτω ζητουντες παρ αυτου σημειον απο του ουρανου πειραζοντες αυτον
kjv: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.

vulg: et ingemescens spiritu ait quid generatio ista quaerit signum amen dico vobis si dabitur generationi isti signum
clem: Et ingemiscens spiritu, ait: Quid generatio ista signum qurit? Amen dico vobis, si dabitur generationi isti signum.
tr: και αναστεναξας τω πνευματι αυτου λεγει τι η γενεα αυτη σημειον επιζητει αμην λεγω υμιν ει δοθησεται τη γενεα ταυτη σημειον
kjv: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.

vulg: et dimittens eos ascendens iterum abiit trans fretum
clem: Et dimittens eos, ascendit iterum navim et abiit trans fretum.
tr: και αφεις αυτους εμβας παλιν εις το πλοιον απηλθεν εις το περαν
kjv: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.

vulg: et obliti sunt sumere panes et nisi unum panem non habebant secum in navi
clem: Et obliti sunt panes sumere: et nisi unum panem non habebant secum in navi.
tr: και επελαθοντο  οι μαθηται  λαβειν αρτους και ει μη ενα αρτον ουκ ειχον μεθ εαυτων εν τω πλοιω
kjv: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.

vulg: et praecipiebat eis dicens videte cavete a fermento Pharisaeorum et fermento Herodis
clem: Et prcipiebat eis, dicens: Videte, et cavete a fermento pharisorum, et fermento Herodis.
tr: και διεστελλετο αυτοις λεγων ορατε βλεπετε απο της ζυμης των φαρισαιων και της ζυμης ηρωδου
kjv: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.

vulg: et cogitabant ad alterutrum dicentes quia panes non habemus
clem: Et cogitabant ad alterutrum, dicentes: quia panes non habemus.
tr: και διελογιζοντο προς αλληλους λεγοντες οτι αρτους ουκ εχομεν
kjv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.

vulg: quo cognito Iesus ait illis quid cogitatis quia panes non habetis nondum cognoscitis nec intellegitis adhuc caecatum habetis cor vestrum
clem: Quo cognito, ait illis Jesus: Quid cogitatis, quia panes non habetis? nondum cognoscetis nec intelligitis? adhuc ccatum habetis cor vestrum?
tr: και γνους ο ιησους λεγει αυτοις τι διαλογιζεσθε οτι αρτους ουκ εχετε ουπω νοειτε ουδε συνιετε ετι πεπωρωμενην εχετε την καρδιαν υμων
kjv: And when Jesus knew it, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?

vulg: oculos habentes non videtis et aures habentes non auditis nec recordamini
clem: oculos habentes non videtis? et aures habentes non auditis? nec recordamini,
tr: οφθαλμους εχοντες ου βλεπετε και ωτα εχοντες ουκ ακουετε και ου μνημονευετε
kjv: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?

vulg: quando quinque panes fregi in quinque milia et quot cofinos fragmentorum plenos sustulistis dicunt ei duodecim
clem: quando quinque panes fregi in quinque millia: quot cophinos fragmentorum plenos sustulistis? Dicunt ei: Duodecim.
tr: οτε τους πεντε αρτους εκλασα εις τους πεντακισχιλιους ποσους κοφινους πληρεις κλασματων ηρατε λεγουσιν αυτω δωδεκα
kjv: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.

vulg: quando et septem panes in quattuor milia quot sportas fragmentorum tulistis et dicunt ei septem
clem: Quando et septem panes in quatuor millia: quot sportas fragmentorum tulistis? Et dicunt ei: Septem.
tr: οτε δε τους επτα εις τους τετρακισχιλιους ποσων σπυριδων πληρωματα κλασματων ηρατε οι δε ειπον επτα
kjv: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.

vulg: et dicebat eis quomodo nondum intellegitis
clem: Et dicebat eis: Quomodo nondum intelligitis?
tr: και ελεγεν αυτοις πως ου συνιετε
kjv: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?

vulg: et veniunt Bethsaida et adducunt ei caecum et rogabant eum ut illum tangeret
clem: Et veniunt Bethsaidam, et adducunt ei ccum, et rogabant eum ut illum tangeret.
tr: και ερχεται εις βηθσαιδαν  βηθσαιδα  και φερουσιν αυτω τυφλον και παρακαλουσιν αυτον ινα αυτου αψηται
kjv: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.

vulg: et adprehendens manum caeci eduxit eum extra vicum et expuens in oculos eius inpositis manibus suis interrogavit eum si aliquid videret
clem: Et apprehensa manu cci, eduxit eum extra vicum: et exspuens in oculos ejus impositis manibus suis, interrogavit eum si quid videret.
tr: και επιλαβομενος της χειρος του τυφλου εξηγαγεν αυτον εξω της κωμης και πτυσας εις τα ομματα αυτου επιθεις τας χειρας αυτω επηρωτα αυτον ει τι βλεπει
kjv: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.

vulg: et aspiciens ait video homines velut arbores ambulantes
clem: Et aspiciens, ait: Video homines velut arbores ambulantes.
tr: και αναβλεψας ελεγεν βλεπω τους ανθρωπους οτι   ως δενδρα ορω   περιπατουντας
kjv: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.

vulg: deinde iterum inposuit manus super oculos eius et coepit videre et restitutus est ita ut videret clare omnia
clem: Deinde iterum imposuit manus super oculos ejus: et cpit videre: et restitutus est ita ut clare videret omnia.
tr: ειτα παλιν επεθηκεν τας χειρας επι τους οφθαλμους αυτου και εποιησεν αυτον αναβλεψαι και αποκατεσταθη και ενεβλεψεν τηλαυγως απαντας
kjv: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.

vulg: et misit illum in domum suam dicens vade in domum tuam et si in vicum introieris nemini dixeris
clem: Et misit illum in domum suam, dicens: Vade in domum tuam: et si in vicum introieris, nemini dixeris.
tr: και απεστειλεν αυτον εις τον οικον αυτου λεγων μηδε εις την κωμην εισελθης μηδε ειπης τινι εν τη κωμη
kjv: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.

vulg: et egressus est Iesus et discipuli eius in castella Caesareae Philippi et in via interrogabat discipulos suos dicens eis quem me dicunt esse homines
clem: Et egressus est Jesus, et discipuli ejus in castella Csare Philippi: et in via interrogabat discipulos suos, dicens eis: Quem me dicunt esse homines?
tr: και εξηλθεν ο ιησους και οι μαθηται αυτου εις τας κωμας καισαρειας της φιλιππου και εν τη οδω επηρωτα τους μαθητας αυτου λεγων αυτοις τινα με λεγουσιν οι ανθρωποι ειναι
kjv: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?

vulg: qui responderunt illi dicentes Iohannem Baptistam alii Heliam alii vero quasi unum de prophetis
clem: Qui responderunt illi, dicentes: Joannem Baptistam, alii Eliam, alii vero quasi unum de prophetis.
tr: οι δε απεκριθησαν ιωαννην τον βαπτιστην και αλλοι ηλιαν αλλοι δε ενα των προφητων
kjv: And they answered, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.

vulg: tunc dicit illis vos vero quem me dicitis esse respondens Petrus ait ei tu es Christus
clem: Tunc dicit illis: Vos vero quem me esse dicitis? Respondens Petrus, ait ei: Tu es Christus.
tr: και αυτος λεγει αυτοις υμεις δε τινα με λεγετε ειναι αποκριθεις δε ο πετρος λεγει αυτω συ ει ο χριστος
kjv: And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.

vulg: et comminatus est eis ne cui dicerent de illo
clem: Et comminatus est eis, ne cui dicerent de illo.
tr: και επετιμησεν αυτοις ινα μηδενι λεγωσιν περι αυτου
kjv: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.

vulg: et coepit docere illos quoniam oportet Filium hominis multa pati et reprobari a senioribus et a summis sacerdotibus et scribis et occidi et post tres dies resurgere
clem: Et cpit docere eos quoniam oportet Filium hominis pati multa, et reprobari a senioribus, et a summis sacerdotibus et scribis, et occidi: et post tres dies resurgere.
tr: και ηρξατο διδασκειν αυτους οτι δει τον υιον του ανθρωπου πολλα παθειν και αποδοκιμασθηναι απο των πρεσβυτερων και αρχιερεων και γραμματεων και αποκτανθηναι και μετα τρεις ημερας αναστηναι
kjv: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

vulg: et palam verbum loquebatur et adprehendens eum Petrus coepit increpare eum
clem: Et palam verbum loquebatur. Et apprehendens eum Petrus, cpit increpare eum.
tr: και παρρησια τον λογον ελαλει και προσλαβομενος αυτον ο πετρος ηρξατο επιτιμαν αυτω
kjv: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.

vulg: qui conversus et videns discipulos suos comminatus est Petro dicens vade retro me Satana quoniam non sapis quae Dei sunt sed quae sunt hominum
clem: Qui conversus, et videns discipulos suos, comminatus est Petro, dicens: Vade retro me Satana, quoniam non sapis qu Dei sunt, sed qu sunt hominum.
tr: ο δε επιστραφεις και ιδων τους μαθητας αυτου επετιμησεν τω πετρω λεγων υπαγε οπισω μου σατανα οτι ου φρονεις τα του θεου αλλα τα των ανθρωπων
kjv: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.

vulg: et convocata turba cum discipulis suis dixit eis si quis vult post me sequi deneget se ipsum et tollat crucem suam et sequatur me
clem: Et convocata turba cum discipulis suis, dixit eis: Si quis vult me sequi, deneget semetipsum: et tollat crucem suam, et sequatur me.
tr: και προσκαλεσαμενος τον οχλον συν τοις μαθηταις αυτου ειπεν αυτοις οστις θελει οπισω μου ελθειν απαρνησασθω εαυτον και αρατω τον σταυρον αυτου και ακολουθειτω μοι
kjv: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

vulg: qui enim voluerit animam suam salvam facere perdet eam qui autem perdiderit animam suam propter me et evangelium salvam eam faciet
clem: Qui enim voluerit animam suam salvam facere, perdet eam: qui autem perdiderit animam suam propter me, et Evangelium, salvam faciet eam.
tr: ος γαρ αν θελη την ψυχην αυτου σωσαι απολεσει αυτην ος δ αν απολεση την ψυχην αυτου ενεκεν εμου και του ευαγγελιου ουτος σωσει αυτην
kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.

vulg: quid enim proderit homini si lucretur mundum totum et detrimentum faciat animae suae
clem: Quid enim proderit homini, si lucretur mundum totum et detrimentum anim su faciat?
tr: τι γαρ ωφελησει ανθρωπον εαν κερδηση τον κοσμον ολον και ζημιωθη την ψυχην αυτου
kjv: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?

vulg: aut quid dabit homo commutationem pro anima sua
clem: Aut quid dabit homo commutationis pro anima sua?
tr: η τι δωσει ανθρωπος ανταλλαγμα της ψυχης αυτου
kjv: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

vulg: qui enim me confusus fuerit et mea verba in generatione ista adultera et peccatrice et Filius hominis confundetur eum cum venerit in gloria Patris sui cum angelis sanctis
clem: Qui enim me confusus fuerit, et verba mea in generatione ista adultera et peccatrice, et Filius hominis confundetur eum, cum venerit in gloria Patris sui cum angelis sanctis.
tr: ος γαρ αν επαισχυνθη με και τους εμους λογους εν τη γενεα ταυτη τη μοιχαλιδι και αμαρτωλω και ο υιος του ανθρωπου επαισχυνθησεται αυτον οταν ελθη εν τη δοξη του πατρος αυτου μετα των αγγελων των αγιων
kjv: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.

vulg: et dicebat illis amen dico vobis quia sunt quidam de hic stantibus qui non gustabunt mortem donec videant regnum Dei veniens in virtute
clem: Et dicebat illis: Amen dico vobis, quia sunt quidam de hic stantibus, qui non gustabunt mortem donec videant regnum Dei veniens in virtute.

vulg: et post dies sex adsumit Iesus Petrum et Iacobum et Iohannem et ducit illos in montem excelsum seorsum solos et transfiguratus est coram ipsis
clem: Et post dies sex assumit Jesus Petrum, et Jacobum, et Joannem, et ducit illos in montem excelsum seorsum solos, et transfiguratus est coram ipsis.
tr: και ελεγεν αυτοις αμην λεγω υμιν οτι εισιν τινες των ωδε εστηκοτων οιτινες ου μη γευσωνται θανατου εως αν ιδωσιν την βασιλειαν του θεου εληλυθυιαν εν δυναμει
kjv: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.

vulg: et vestimenta eius facta sunt splendentia candida nimis velut nix qualia fullo super terram non potest candida facere
clem: Et vestimenta ejus facta sunt splendentia, et candida nimis velut nix, qualia fullo non potest super terram candida facere.
tr: και μεθ ημερας εξ παραλαμβανει ο ιησους τον πετρον και τον ιακωβον και τον ιωαννην και αναφερει αυτους εις ορος υψηλον κατ ιδιαν μονους και μετεμορφωθη εμπροσθεν αυτων
kjv: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.

vulg: et apparuit illis Helias cum Mose et erant loquentes cum Iesu
clem: Et apparuit illis Elias cum Moyse: et erant loquentes cum Jesu.
tr: και τα ιματια αυτου εγενετο στιλβοντα λευκα λιαν ως χιων οια γναφευς επι της γης ου δυναται λευκαναι
kjv: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.

vulg: et respondens Petrus ait Iesu rabbi bonum est hic nos esse et faciamus tria tabernacula tibi unum et Mosi unum et Heliae unum
clem: Et respondens Petrus, ait Jesu: Rabbi, bonum est nos hic esse: et faciamus tria tabernacula, tibi unum, et Moysi unum, et Eli unum.
tr: και ωφθη αυτοις ηλιας συν μωσει και ησαν συλλαλουντες τω ιησου
kjv: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.

vulg: non enim sciebat quid diceret erant enim timore exterriti
clem: Non enim sciebat quid diceret: erant enim timore exterriti.
tr: και αποκριθεις ο πετρος λεγει τω ιησου ραββι καλον εστιν ημας ωδε ειναι και ποιησωμεν σκηνας τρεις σοι μιαν και μωσει μιαν και ηλια μιαν
kjv: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

vulg: et facta est nubes obumbrans eos et venit vox de nube dicens hic est Filius meus carissimus audite illum
clem: Et facta est nubes obumbrans eos: et venit vox de nube, dicens: Hic est Filius meus carissimus: audite illum.
tr: ου γαρ ηδει τι λαληση ησαν γαρ εκφοβοι
kjv: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.

vulg: et statim circumspicientes neminem amplius viderunt nisi Iesum tantum secum
clem: Et statim circumspicientes, neminem amplius viderunt, nisi Jesum tantum secum.
tr: και εγενετο νεφελη επισκιαζουσα αυτοις και ηλθεν φωνη εκ της νεφελης λεγουσα ουτος εστιν ο υιος μου ο αγαπητος αυτου ακουετε
kjv: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

vulg: et descendentibus illis de monte praecepit illis ne cui quae vidissent narrarent nisi cum Filius hominis a mortuis resurrexerit
clem: Et descendentibus illis de monte, prcepit illis ne cuiquam qu vidissent, narrarent: nisi cum Filius hominis a mortuis resurrexerit.
tr: και εξαπινα περιβλεψαμενοι ουκετι ουδενα ειδον αλλα τον ιησουν μονον μεθ εαυτων
kjv: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.

vulg: et verbum continuerunt apud se conquirentes quid esset cum a mortuis resurrexerit
clem: Et verbum continuerunt apud se: conquirentes quid esset, cum a mortuis resurrexerit.
tr: καταβαινοντων δε αυτων απο του ορους διεστειλατο αυτοις ινα μηδενι διηγησωνται α ειδον ει μη οταν ο υιος του ανθρωπου εκ νεκρων αναστη
kjv: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.

vulg: et interrogabant eum dicentes quid ergo dicunt Pharisaei et scribae quia Heliam oporteat venire primum
clem: Et interrogabant eum, dicentes: Quid ergo dicunt pharisi et scrib, quia Eliam oportet venire primum?
tr: και τον λογον εκρατησαν προς εαυτους συζητουντες τι εστιν το εκ νεκρων αναστηναι
kjv: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.

vulg: qui respondens ait illis Helias cum venerit primo restituet omnia et quomodo scriptum est in Filium hominis ut multa patiatur et contemnatur
clem: Qui respondens, ait illis: Elias cum venerit primo, restituet omnia: et quomodo scriptum est in Filium hominis, ut multa patiatur et contemnatur.
tr: και επηρωτων αυτον λεγοντες οτι λεγουσιν οι γραμματεις οτι ηλιαν δει ελθειν πρωτον
kjv: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?

vulg: sed dico vobis quia et Helias venit et fecerunt illi quaecumque voluerunt sicut scriptum est de eo
clem: Sed dico vobis quia et Elias venit (et fecerunt illi qucumque voluerunt) sicut scriptum est de eo.
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν αυτοις ηλιας μεν ελθων πρωτον αποκαθιστα παντα και πως γεγραπται επι τον υιον του ανθρωπου ινα πολλα παθη και εξουδενωθη
kjv: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.

vulg: et veniens ad discipulos suos vidit turbam magnam circa eos et scribas conquirentes cum illis
clem: Et veniens ad discipulos suos, vidit turbam magnam circa eos, et scribas conquirentes cum illis.
tr: αλλα λεγω υμιν οτι και ηλιας εληλυθεν και εποιησαν αυτω οσα ηθελησαν καθως γεγραπται επ αυτον
kjv: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.

vulg: et confestim omnis populus videns eum stupefactus est et adcurrentes salutabant eum
clem: Et confestim omnis populus videns Jesum, stupefactus est, et expaverunt, et accurrentes salutabant eum.
tr: και ελθων προς τους μαθητας ειδεν οχλον πολυν περι αυτους και γραμματεις συζητουντας αυτοις
kjv: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.

vulg: et interrogavit eos quid inter vos conquiritis
clem: Et interrogavit eos: Quid inter vos conquiritis?
tr: και ευθεως πας ο οχλος ιδων αυτον εξεθαμβηθη και προστρεχοντες ησπαζοντο αυτον
kjv: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.

vulg: et respondens unus de turba dixit magister adtuli filium meum ad te habentem spiritum mutum
clem: Et respondens unus de turba, dixit: Magister, attuli filium meum ad te habentem spiritum mutum:
tr: και επηρωτησεν τους γραμματεις τι συζητειτε προς αυτους
kjv: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?

vulg: qui ubicumque eum adprehenderit adlidit eum et spumat et stridet dentibus et arescit et dixi discipulis tuis ut eicerent illum et non potuerunt
clem: qui ubicumque eum apprehenderit, allidit illum, et spumat, et stridet dentibus, et arescit: et dixi discipulis tuis ut ejicerent illum, et non potuerunt.
tr: και αποκριθεις εις εκ του οχλου ειπεν διδασκαλε ηνεγκα τον υιον μου προς σε εχοντα πνευμα αλαλον
kjv: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;

vulg: qui respondens eis dicit o generatio incredula quamdiu apud vos ero quamdiu vos patiar adferte illum ad me
clem: Qui respondens eis, dixit: O generatio incredula, quamdiu apud vos ero? quamdiu vos patiar? afferte illum ad me.
tr: και οπου αν αυτον καταλαβη ρησσει αυτον και αφριζει και τριζει τους οδοντας αυτου και ξηραινεται και ειπον τοις μαθηταις σου ινα αυτο εκβαλωσιν και ουκ ισχυσαν
kjv: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.

vulg: et adtulerunt eum et cum vidisset illum statim spiritus conturbavit eum et elisus in terram volutabatur spumans
clem: Et attulerunt eum. Et cum vidisset eum, statim spiritus conturbavit illum: et elisus in terram, volutabatur spumans.
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις αυτω λεγει ω γενεα απιστος εως ποτε προς υμας εσομαι εως ποτε ανεξομαι υμων φερετε αυτον προς με
kjv: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.

vulg: et interrogavit patrem eius quantum temporis est ex quo hoc ei accidit at ille ait ab infantia
clem: Et interrogavit patrem ejus: Quantum temporis est ex quo ei hoc accidit? At ille ait: Ab infantia:
tr: και ηνεγκαν αυτον προς αυτον και ιδων αυτον ευθεως το πνευμα εσπαραξεν αυτον και πεσων επι της γης εκυλιετο αφριζων
kjv: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.

vulg: et frequenter eum et in ignem et in aquas misit ut eum perderet sed si quid potes adiuva nos misertus nostri
clem: et frequenter eum in ignem, et in aquas misit ut eum perderet: sed si quid potes, adjuva nos, misertus nostri.
tr: και επηρωτησεν τον πατερα αυτου ποσος χρονος εστιν ως τουτο γεγονεν αυτω ο δε ειπεν παιδιοθεν
kjv: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.

vulg: Iesus autem ait illi si potes credere omnia possibilia credenti
clem: Jesus autem ait illi: Si potes credere, omnia possibilia sunt credenti.
tr: και πολλακις αυτον και εις πυρ εβαλεν και εις υδατα ινα απολεση αυτον αλλ ει τι δυνασαι βοηθησον ημιν σπλαγχνισθεις εφ ημας
kjv: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.

vulg: et continuo exclamans pater pueri cum lacrimis aiebat credo adiuva incredulitatem meam
clem: Et continuo exclamans pater pueri, cum lacrimis aiebat: Credo, Domine; adjuva incredulitatem meam.
tr: ο δε ιησους ειπεν αυτω το ει δυνασαι πιστευσαι παντα δυνατα τω πιστευοντι
kjv: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.

vulg: et cum videret Iesus concurrentem turbam comminatus est spiritui inmundo dicens illi surde et mute spiritus ego tibi praecipio exi ab eo et amplius ne introeas in eum
clem: Et cum videret Jesus concurrentem turbam, comminatus est spiritui immundo, dicens illi: Surde et mute spiritus, ego prcipio tibi, exi ab eo: et amplius ne introas in eum.
tr: και ευθεως κραξας ο πατηρ του παιδιου μετα δακρυων ελεγεν πιστευω κυριε βοηθει μου τη απιστια
kjv: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.

vulg: et clamans et multum discerpens eum exiit ab eo et factus est sicut mortuus ita ut multi dicerent quia mortuus est
clem: Et exclamans, et multum discerpens eum, exiit ab eo, et factus est sicut mortuus, ita ut multi dicerent: Quia mortuus est.
tr: ιδων δε ο ιησους οτι επισυντρεχει οχλος επετιμησεν τω πνευματι τω ακαθαρτω λεγων αυτω το πνευμα το αλαλον και κωφον εγω σοι επιτασσω εξελθε εξ αυτου και μηκετι εισελθης εις αυτον
kjv: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.

vulg: Iesus autem tenens manum eius elevavit illum et surrexit
clem: Jesus autem tenens manum ejus elevavit eum, et surrexit.
tr: και κραξαν και πολλα σπαραξαν αυτον εξηλθεν και εγενετο ωσει νεκρος ωστε πολλους λεγειν οτι απεθανεν
kjv: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.

vulg: et cum introisset in domum discipuli eius secreto interrogabant eum quare nos non potuimus eicere eum
clem: Et cum introisset in domum, discipuli ejus secreto interrogabant eum: Quare nos non potuimus ejicere eum?
tr: ο δε ιησους κρατησας αυτον της χειρος ηγειρεν αυτον και ανεστη
kjv: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.

vulg: et dixit illis hoc genus in nullo potest exire nisi in oratione et ieiunio
clem: Et dixit illis: Hoc genus in nullo potest exire, nisi in oratione et jejunio.
tr: και εισελθοντα αυτον εις οικον οι μαθηται αυτου επηρωτων αυτον κατ ιδιαν οτι ημεις ουκ ηδυνηθημεν εκβαλειν αυτο
kjv: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?

vulg: et inde profecti praetergrediebantur Galilaeam nec volebat quemquam scire
clem: Et inde profecti prtergrediebantur Galilam: nec volebat quemquam scire.
tr: και ειπεν αυτοις τουτο το γενος εν ουδενι δυναται εξελθειν ει μη εν προσευχη και νηστεια
kjv: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.

vulg: docebat autem discipulos suos et dicebat illis quoniam Filius hominis tradetur in manus hominum et occident eum et occisus tertia die resurget
clem: Docebat autem discipulos suos, et dicebat illis: Quoniam Filius hominis tradetur in manus hominum, et occident eum, et occisus tertia die resurget.
tr: και εκειθεν εξελθοντες παρεπορευοντο δια της γαλιλαιας και ουκ ηθελεν ινα τις γνω
kjv: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.

vulg: at illi ignorabant verbum et timebant eum interrogare
clem: At illi ignorabant verbum: et timebant interrogare eum.
tr: εδιδασκεν γαρ τους μαθητας αυτου και ελεγεν αυτοις οτι ο υιος του ανθρωπου παραδιδοται εις χειρας ανθρωπων και αποκτενουσιν αυτον και αποκτανθεις τη τριτη ημερα αναστησεται
kjv: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.

vulg: et venerunt Capharnaum qui cum domi esset interrogabat eos quid in via tractabatis
clem: Et venerunt Capharnaum. Qui cum domi essent, interrogabat eos: Quid in via tractabatis?
tr: οι δε ηγνοουν το ρημα και εφοβουντο αυτον επερωτησαι
kjv: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.

vulg: at illi tacebant siquidem inter se in via disputaverant quis esset illorum maior
clem: At illi tacebant: siquidem in via inter se disputaverunt: quis eorum major esset.
tr: και ηλθεν εις καπερναουμ και εν τη οικια γενομενος επηρωτα αυτους τι εν τη οδω προς εαυτους διελογιζεσθε
kjv: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?

vulg: et residens vocavit duodecim et ait illis si quis vult primus esse erit omnium novissimus et omnium minister
clem: Et residens vocavit duodecim, et ait illis: Si quis vult primus esse, erit omnium novissimus, et omnium minister.
tr: οι δε εσιωπων προς αλληλους γαρ διελεχθησαν εν τη οδω τις μειζων
kjv: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.

vulg: et accipiens puerum statuit eum in medio eorum quem cum conplexus esset ait illis
clem: Et accipiens puerum, statuit eum in medio eorum: quem cum complexus esset, ait illis:
tr: και καθισας εφωνησεν τους δωδεκα και λεγει αυτοις ει τις θελει πρωτος ειναι εσται παντων εσχατος και παντων διακονος
kjv: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.

vulg: quisquis unum ex huiusmodi pueris receperit in nomine meo me recipit et quicumque me susceperit non me suscipit sed eum qui me misit
clem: Quisquis unum ex hujusmodi pueris receperit in nomine meo, me recipit: et quicumque me susceperit, non me suscipit, sed eum qui misit me.
tr: και λαβων παιδιον εστησεν αυτο εν μεσω αυτων και εναγκαλισαμενος αυτο ειπεν αυτοις
kjv: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,

vulg: respondit illi Iohannes dicens magister vidimus quendam in nomine tuo eicientem daemonia qui non sequitur nos et prohibuimus eum
clem: Respondit illi Joannes, dicens: Magister, vidimus quemdam in nomine tuo ejicientem dmonia, qui non sequitur nos, et prohibuimus eum.
tr: ος εαν εν των τοιουτων παιδιων δεξηται επι τω ονοματι μου εμε δεχεται και ος εαν εμε δεξηται ουκ εμε δεχεται αλλα τον αποστειλαντα με
kjv: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.

vulg: Iesus autem ait nolite prohibere eum nemo est enim qui faciat virtutem in nomine meo et possit cito male loqui de me
clem: Jesus autem ait: Nolite prohibere eum: nemo est enim qui faciat virtutem in nomine meo, et possit cito male loqui de me:
tr: απεκριθη δε αυτω ο ιωαννης λεγων διδασκαλε ειδομεν τινα  εν  τω ονοματι σου εκβαλλοντα δαιμονια ος ουκ ακολουθει ημιν και εκωλυσαμεν αυτον οτι ουκ ακολουθει ημιν
kjv: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.

vulg: qui enim non est adversum vos pro vobis est
clem: qui enim non est adversum vos, pro vobis est.
tr: ο δε ιησους ειπεν μη κωλυετε αυτον ουδεις γαρ εστιν ος ποιησει δυναμιν επι τω ονοματι μου και δυνησεται ταχυ κακολογησαι με
kjv: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.

vulg: quisquis enim potum dederit vobis calicem aquae in nomine meo quia Christi estis amen dico vobis non perdet mercedem suam
clem: Quisquis enim potum dederit vobis calicem aqu in nomine meo, quia Christi estis: amen dico vobis, non perdet mercedem suam.
tr: ος γαρ ουκ εστιν καθ υμων υπερ υμων  ημων υπερ ημων  εστιν
kjv: For he that is not against us is on our part.

vulg: et quisquis scandalizaverit unum ex his pusillis credentibus in me bonum est ei magis si circumdaretur mola asinaria collo eius et in mare mitteretur
clem: Et quisquis scandalizaverit unum ex his pusillis credentibus in me: bonum est ei magis si circumdaretur mola asinaria collo ejus, et in mare mitteretur.
tr: ος γαρ αν ποτιση υμας ποτηριον υδατος εν τω ονοματι μου οτι χριστου εστε αμην λεγω υμιν ου μη απολεση τον μισθον αυτου
kjv: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.

vulg: et si scandalizaverit te manus tua abscide illam bonum est tibi debilem introire in vitam quam duas manus habentem ire in gehennam in ignem inextinguibilem
clem: Et si scandalizaverit te manus tua, abscide illam: bonum est tibi debilem introire in vitam, quam duas manus habentem ire in gehennam, in ignem inextinguibilem,
tr: και ος αν σκανδαλιση ενα των μικρων  τουτων  των πιστευοντων εις εμε καλον εστιν αυτω μαλλον ει περικειται λιθος μυλικος περι τον τραχηλον αυτου και βεβληται εις την θαλασσαν
kjv: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.

vulg: ubi vermis eorum non moritur et ignis non extinguitur
clem: ubi vermis eorum non moritur, et ignis non extinguitur.
tr: και εαν σκανδαλιζη σε η χειρ σου αποκοψον αυτην καλον σοι εστιν κυλλον εις την ζωην εισελθειν η τας δυο χειρας εχοντα απελθειν εις την γεενναν εις το πυρ το ασβεστον
kjv: And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

vulg: et si pes tuus te scandalizat amputa illum bonum est tibi claudum introire in vitam aeternam quam duos pedes habentem mitti in gehennam ignis inextinguibilis
clem: Et si pes tuus te scandalizat, amputa illum: bonum est tibi claudum introire in vitam ternam, quam duos pedes habentem mitti in gehennam ignis inextinguibilis,
tr: οπου ο σκωληξ αυτων ου τελευτα και το πυρ ου σβεννυται
kjv: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

vulg: ubi vermis eorum non moritur et ignis non extinguitur
clem: ubi vermis eorum non moritur, et ignis non extinguitur.
