tr: και εαν ο πους σου σκανδαλιζη σε αποκοψον αυτον καλον εστιν σοι εισελθειν εις την ζωην χωλον η τους δυο ποδας εχοντα βληθηναι εις την γεενναν εις το πυρ το ασβεστον
kjv: And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

vulg: quod si oculus tuus scandalizat te eice eum bonum est tibi luscum introire in regnum Dei quam duos oculos habentem mitti in gehennam ignis
clem: Quod si oculus tuus scandalizat te, ejice eum: bonum est tibi luscum introire in regnum Dei, quam duos oculos habentem mitti in gehennam ignis,
tr: οπου ο σκωληξ αυτων ου τελευτα και το πυρ ου σβεννυται
kjv: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

vulg: ubi vermis eorum non moritur et ignis non extinguitur
clem: ubi vermis eorum non moritur, et ignis non extinguitur.
tr: και εαν ο οφθαλμος σου σκανδαλιζη σε εκβαλε αυτον καλον σοι εστιν μονοφθαλμον εισελθειν εις την βασιλειαν του θεου η δυο οφθαλμους εχοντα βληθηναι εις την γεενναν του πυρος
kjv: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:

vulg: omnis enim igne sallietur et omnis victima sallietur
clem: Omnis enim igne salietur, et omnis victima sale salietur.
tr: οπου ο σκωληξ αυτων ου τελευτα και το πυρ ου σβεννυται
kjv: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

vulg: bonum est sal quod si sal insulsum fuerit in quo illud condietis habete in vobis sal et pacem habete inter vos
clem: Bonum est sal: quod si sal insulsum fuerit, in quo illud condietis? Habete in vobis sal, et pacem habete inter vos.
tr: πας γαρ πυρι αλισθησεται και πασα θυσια αλι αλισθησεται
kjv: For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.

tr: καλον το αλας εαν δε το αλας αναλον γενηται εν τινι αυτο αρτυσετε εχετε εν εαυτοις αλας και ειρηνευετε εν αλληλοις
kjv: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.

vulg: et inde exsurgens venit in fines Iudaeae ultra Iordanen et conveniunt iterum turbae ad eum et sicut consueverat iterum docebat illos
clem: Et inde exsurgens venit in fines Jud ultra Jordanem: et conveniunt iterum turb ad eum: et sicut consueverat, iterum docebat illos.
tr: κακειθεν αναστας ερχεται εις τα ορια της ιουδαιας δια του περαν του ιορδανου και συμπορευονται παλιν οχλοι προς αυτον και ως ειωθει παλιν εδιδασκεν αυτους
kjv: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.

vulg: et accedentes Pharisaei interrogabant eum si licet viro uxorem dimittere temptantes eum
clem: Et accedentes pharisi interrogabant eum: Si licet vero uxorem dimittere: tentantes eum.
tr: και προσελθοντες οι φαρισαιοι επηρωτησαν αυτον ει εξεστιν ανδρι γυναικα απολυσαι πειραζοντες αυτον
kjv: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.

vulg: at ille respondens dixit eis quid vobis praecepit Moses
clem: At ille respondens, dixit eis: Quid vobis prcepit Moyses?
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν αυτοις τι υμιν ενετειλατο μωσης
kjv: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?

vulg: qui dixerunt Moses permisit libellum repudii scribere et dimittere
clem: Qui dixerunt: Moyses permisit libellum repudii scribere, et dimittere.
tr: οι δε ειπον μωσης επετρεψεν βιβλιον αποστασιου γραψαι και απολυσαι
kjv: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.

vulg: quibus respondens Iesus ait ad duritiam cordis vestri scripsit vobis praeceptum istud
clem: Quibus respondens Jesus, ait: Ad duritiam cordis vestri scripsit vobis prceptum istud:
tr: και αποκριθεις ο ιησους ειπεν αυτοις προς την σκληροκαρδιαν υμων εγραψεν υμιν την εντολην ταυτην
kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.

vulg: ab initio autem creaturae masculum et feminam fecit eos Deus
clem: ab initio autem creatur masculum et feminam fecit eos Deus.
tr: απο δε αρχης κτισεως αρσεν και θηλυ εποιησεν αυτους ο θεος
kjv: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.

vulg: propter hoc relinquet homo patrem suum et matrem et adherebit ad uxorem suam
clem: Propter hoc relinquet homo patrem suum et matrem, et adhrebit ad uxorem suam:
tr: ενεκεν τουτου καταλειψει ανθρωπος τον πατερα αυτου και την μητερα και προσκολληθησεται προς την γυναικα αυτου
kjv: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;

vulg: et erunt duo in carne una itaque iam non sunt duo sed una caro
clem: et erunt duo in carne una. Itaque jam non sunt duo, sed una caro.
tr: και εσονται οι δυο εις σαρκα μιαν ωστε ουκετι εισιν δυο αλλα μια σαρξ
kjv: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.

vulg: quod ergo Deus iunxit homo non separet
clem: Quod ergo Deus conjunxit, homo non separet.
tr: ο ουν ο θεος συνεζευξεν ανθρωπος μη χωριζετω
kjv: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

vulg: et in domo iterum discipuli eius de eodem interrogaverunt eum
clem: Et in domo iterum discipuli ejus de eodem interrogaverunt eum.
tr: και εν τη οικια παλιν οι μαθηται αυτου περι του αυτου επηρωτησαν αυτον
kjv: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.

vulg: et dicit illis quicumque dimiserit uxorem suam et aliam duxerit adulterium committit super eam
clem: Et ait illis: Quicumque dimiserit uxorem suam, et aliam duxerit, adulterium committit super eam.
tr: και λεγει αυτοις ος εαν απολυση την γυναικα αυτου και γαμηση αλλην μοιχαται επ αυτην
kjv: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.

vulg: et si uxor dimiserit virum suum et alii nupserit moechatur
clem: Et si uxor dimiserit virum suum, et alii nupserit, mchatur.
tr: και εαν γυνη απολυση τον ανδρα αυτης και γαμηθη αλλω μοιχαται
kjv: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.

vulg: et offerebant illi parvulos ut tangeret illos discipuli autem comminabantur offerentibus
clem: Et offerebant illi parvulos ut tangeret illos. Discipuli autem comminabantur offerentibus.
tr: και προσεφερον αυτω παιδια ινα αψηται αυτων οι δε μαθηται επετιμων τοις προσφερουσιν
kjv: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.

vulg: quos cum videret Iesus indigne tulit et ait illis sinite parvulos venire ad me et ne prohibueritis eos talium est enim regnum Dei
clem: Quos cum videret Jesus, indigne tulit, et ait illis: Sinite parvulos venire ad me, et ne prohibueritis eos: talium enim est regnum Dei.
tr: ιδων δε ο ιησους ηγανακτησεν και ειπεν αυτοις αφετε τα παιδια ερχεσθαι προς με και μη κωλυετε αυτα των γαρ τοιουτων εστιν η βασιλεια του θεου
kjv: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

vulg: amen dico vobis quisque non receperit regnum Dei velut parvulus non intrabit in illud
clem: Amen dico vobis: Quisquis non receperit regnum Dei velut parvulus, non intrabit in illud.
tr: αμην λεγω υμιν ος εαν μη δεξηται την βασιλειαν του θεου ως παιδιον ου μη εισελθη εις αυτην
kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.

vulg: et conplexans eos et inponens manus super illos benedicebat eos
clem: Et complexans eos, et imponens manus super illos, benedicebat eos.
tr: και εναγκαλισαμενος αυτα τιθεις τας χειρας επ αυτα ηυλογει αυτα
kjv: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.

vulg: et cum egressus esset in viam procurrens quidam genu flexo ante eum rogabat eum magister bone quid faciam ut vitam aeternam percipiam
clem: Et cum egressus esset in viam, procurrens quidam genu flexo ante eum, rogabat eum: Magister bone, quid faciam ut vitam ternam percipiam?
tr: και εκπορευομενου αυτου εις οδον προσδραμων εις και γονυπετησας αυτον επηρωτα αυτον διδασκαλε αγαθε τι ποιησω ινα ζωην αιωνιον κληρονομησω
kjv: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?

vulg: Iesus autem dixit ei quid me dicis bonum nemo bonus nisi unus Deus
clem: Jesus autem dixit ei: Quid me dicis bonum? nemo bonus, nisi unus Deus.
tr: ο δε ιησους ειπεν αυτω τι με λεγεις αγαθον ουδεις αγαθος ει μη εις ο θεος
kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.

vulg: praecepta nosti ne adulteres ne occidas ne fureris ne falsum testimonium dixeris ne fraudem feceris honora patrem tuum et matrem
clem: Prcepta nosti: ne adulteres, ne occidas, ne fureris, ne falsum testimonium dixeris, ne fraudum feceris, honora patrem tuum et matrem.
tr: τας εντολας οιδας μη μοιχευσης μη φονευσης μη κλεψης μη ψευδομαρτυρησης μη αποστερησης τιμα τον πατερα σου και την μητερα
kjv: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.

vulg: et ille respondens ait illi magister omnia haec conservavi a iuventute mea
clem: At ille respondens, ait illi: Magister, hc omnia observavi a juventute mea.
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν αυτω διδασκαλε ταυτα παντα εφυλαξαμην εκ νεοτητος μου
kjv: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.

vulg: Iesus autem intuitus eum dilexit eum et dixit illi unum tibi deest vade quaecumque habes vende et da pauperibus et habebis thesaurum in caelo et veni sequere me
clem: Jesus autem intuitus eum, dilexit eum, et dixit ei: Unum tibi deest: vade, qucumque habes vende, et da pauperibus, et habebis thesaurum in clo: et veni, sequere me.
tr: ο δε ιησους εμβλεψας αυτω ηγαπησεν αυτον και ειπεν αυτω εν σοι υστερει υπαγε οσα εχεις πωλησον και δος τοις πτωχοις και εξεις θησαυρον εν ουρανω και δευρο ακολουθει μοι αρας τον σταυρον
kjv: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.

vulg: qui contristatus in verbo abiit maerens erat enim habens possessiones multas
clem: Qui contristatus in verbo, abiit mrens: erat enim habens multas possessiones.
tr: ο δε στυγνασας επι τω λογω απηλθεν λυπουμενος ην γαρ εχων κτηματα πολλα
kjv: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.

vulg: et circumspiciens Iesus ait discipulis suis quam difficile qui pecunias habent in regnum Dei introibunt
clem: Et circumspiciens Jesus, ait discipulis suis: Quam difficile qui pecunias habent, in regnum Dei introibunt!
tr: και περιβλεψαμενος ο ιησους λεγει τοις μαθηταις αυτου πως δυσκολως οι τα χρηματα εχοντες εις την βασιλειαν του θεου εισελευσονται
kjv: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

vulg: discipuli autem obstupescebant in verbis eius at Iesus rursus respondens ait illis filioli quam difficile est confidentes in pecuniis regnum Dei introire
clem: Discipuli autem obstupescebant in verbis ejus. At Jesus rursus respondens ait illis: Filioli, quam difficile est, confidentes in pecuniis, in regnum Dei introire!
tr: οι δε μαθηται εθαμβουντο επι τοις λογοις αυτου ο δε ιησους παλιν αποκριθεις λεγει αυτοις τεκνα πως δυσκολον εστιν τους πεποιθοτας επι τοις χρημασιν εις την βασιλειαν του θεου εισελθειν
kjv: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!

vulg: facilius est camelum per foramen acus transire quam divitem intrare in regnum Dei
clem: Facilius est camelum per foramen acus transire, quam divitem intrare in regnum Dei.
tr: ευκοπωτερον εστιν καμηλον δια της τρυμαλιας της ραφιδος εισελθειν  διελθειν  η πλουσιον εις την βασιλειαν του θεου εισελθειν
kjv: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

vulg: qui magis admirabantur dicentes ad semet ipsos et quis potest salvus fieri
clem: Qui magis admirabantur, dicentes ad semetipsos: Et quis potest salvus fieri?
tr: οι δε περισσως εξεπλησσοντο λεγοντες προς εαυτους και τις δυναται σωθηναι
kjv: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?

vulg: et intuens illos Iesus ait apud homines inpossibile est sed non apud Deum omnia enim possibilia sunt apud Deum
clem: Et intuens illos Jesus, ait: Apud homines impossibile est, sed non apud Deum: omnia enim possibilia sunt apud Deum.
tr: εμβλεψας δε αυτοις ο ιησους λεγει παρα ανθρωποις αδυνατον αλλ ου παρα τω θεω παντα γαρ δυνατα εστιν παρα τω θεω
kjv: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.

vulg: coepit Petrus ei dicere ecce nos dimisimus omnia et secuti sumus te
clem: Et cpit ei Petrus dicere: Ecce nos dimisimus omnia, et secuti sumus te.
tr: και ηρξατο ο πετρος λεγειν αυτω ιδου ημεις αφηκαμεν παντα και ηκολουθησαμεν σοι
kjv: Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.

vulg: respondens Iesus ait amen dico vobis nemo est qui reliquerit domum aut fratres aut sorores aut matrem aut patrem aut filios aut agros propter me et propter evangelium
clem: Respondens Jesus, ait: Amen dico vobis: Nemo est qui reliquerit domum, aut fratres, aut sorores, aut patrem, aut matrem, aut filios, aut agros propter me et propter Evangelium,
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο ιησους ειπεν αμην λεγω υμιν ουδεις εστιν ος αφηκεν οικιαν η αδελφους η αδελφας η πατερα η μητερα η γυναικα η τεκνα η αγρους ενεκεν εμου και του ευαγγελιου
kjv: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's,

vulg: qui non accipiat centies tantum nunc in tempore hoc domos et fratres et sorores et matres et filios et agros cum persecutionibus et in saeculo futuro vitam aeternam
clem: qui non accipiat centies tantum, nunc in tempore hoc: domos, et fratres, et sorores, et matres, et filios, et agros, cum persecutionibus, et in sculo futuro vitam ternam.
tr: εαν μη λαβη εκατονταπλασιονα νυν εν τω καιρω τουτω οικιας και αδελφους και αδελφας και μητερας και τεκνα και αγρους μετα διωγμων και εν τω αιωνι τω ερχομενω ζωην αιωνιον
kjv: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.

vulg: multi autem erunt primi novissimi et novissimi primi
clem: Multi autem erunt primi novissimi, et novissimi primi.
tr: πολλοι δε εσονται πρωτοι εσχατοι και οι εσχατοι πρωτοι
kjv: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.

vulg: erant autem in via ascendentes in Hierosolyma et praecedebat illos Iesus et stupebant et sequentes timebant et adsumens iterum duodecim coepit illis dicere quae essent ei ventura
clem: Erant autem in via ascendentes Jerosolymam: et prcedebat illos Jesus, et stupebant: et sequentes timebant. Et assumens iterum duodecim, cpit illis dicere qu essent ei eventura.
tr: ησαν δε εν τη οδω αναβαινοντες εις ιεροσολυμα και ην προαγων αυτους ο ιησους και εθαμβουντο και ακολουθουντες εφοβουντο και παραλαβων παλιν τους δωδεκα ηρξατο αυτοις λεγειν τα μελλοντα αυτω συμβαινειν
kjv: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,

vulg: quia ecce ascendimus in Hierosolyma et Filius hominis tradetur principibus sacerdotum et scribis et senioribus et damnabunt eum morti et tradent eum gentibus
clem: Quia ecce ascendimus Jerosolymam, et Filius hominis tradetur principibus sacerdotum, et scribis, et senioribus, et damnabunt eum morte, et tradent eum gentibus:
tr: οτι ιδου αναβαινομεν εις ιεροσολυμα και ο υιος του ανθρωπου παραδοθησεται τοις αρχιερευσιν και τοις γραμματευσιν και κατακρινουσιν αυτον θανατω και παραδωσουσιν αυτον τοις εθνεσιν
kjv: Saying, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:

vulg: et inludent ei et conspuent eum et flagellabunt eum et interficient eum et tertia die resurget
clem: et illudent ei, et conspuent eum, et flagellabunt eum, et interficient eum: et tertia die resurget.
tr: και εμπαιξουσιν αυτω και μαστιγωσουσιν αυτον και εμπτυσουσιν αυτω και αποκτενουσιν αυτον και τη τριτη ημερα αναστησεται
kjv: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.

vulg: et accedunt ad illum Iacobus et Iohannes filii Zebedaei dicentes magister volumus ut quodcumque petierimus facias nobis
clem: Et accedunt ad eum Jacobus et Joannes filii Zebedi, dicentes: Magister, volumus ut quodcumque petierimus, facias nobis.
tr: και προσπορευονται αυτω ιακωβος και ιωαννης οι υιοι ζεβεδαιου λεγοντες διδασκαλε θελομεν ινα ο εαν αιτησωμεν ποιησης ημιν
kjv: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.

vulg: at ille dixit eis quid vultis ut faciam vobis
clem: At ille dixit eis: Quid vultis ut faciam vobis?
tr: ο δε ειπεν αυτοις τι θελετε ποιησαι με υμιν
kjv: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?

vulg: et dixerunt da nobis ut unus ad dexteram tuam et alius ad sinistram tuam sedeamus in gloria tua
clem: Et dixerunt: Da nobis ut unus ad dexteram tuam, et alius ad sinistram tuam sedeamus in gloria tua.
tr: οι δε ειπον αυτω δος ημιν ινα εις εκ δεξιων σου και εις εξ ευωνυμων σου καθισωμεν εν τη δοξη σου
kjv: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.

vulg: Iesus autem ait eis nescitis quid petatis potestis bibere calicem quem ego bibo aut baptismum quo ego baptizor baptizari
clem: Jesus autem ait eis: Nescitis quid petatis: potestis bibere calicem, quem ego bibo, aut baptismo, quo ego baptizor, baptizari?
tr: ο δε ιησους ειπεν αυτοις ουκ οιδατε τι αιτεισθε δυνασθε πιειν το ποτηριον ο εγω πινω και το βαπτισμα ο εγω βαπτιζομαι βαπτισθηναι
kjv: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?

vulg: at illi dixerunt ei possumus Iesus autem ait eis calicem quidem quem ego bibo bibetis et baptismum quo ego baptizor baptizabimini
clem: At illi dixerunt ei: Possumus. Jesus autem ait eis: Calicem quidem, quem ego bibo, bibetis; et baptismo, quo ego baptizor, baptizabimini:
tr: οι δε ειπον αυτω δυναμεθα ο δε ιησους ειπεν αυτοις το μεν ποτηριον ο εγω πινω πιεσθε και το βαπτισμα ο εγω βαπτιζομαι βαπτισθησεσθε
kjv: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:

vulg: sedere autem ad dexteram meam vel ad sinistram non est meum dare sed quibus paratum est
clem: sedere autem ad dexteram meam, vel ad sinistram, non est meum dare vobis, sed quibus paratum est.
tr: το δε καθισαι εκ δεξιων μου και εξ ευωνυμων μου ουκ εστιν εμον δουναι αλλ οις ητοιμασται
kjv: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.

vulg: et audientes decem coeperunt indignari de Iacobo et Iohanne
clem: Et audientes decem, cperunt indignari de Jacobo et Joanne.
tr: και ακουσαντες οι δεκα ηρξαντο αγανακτειν περι ιακωβου και ιωαννου
kjv: And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with James and John.

vulg: Iesus autem vocans eos ait illis scitis quia hii qui videntur principari gentibus dominantur eis et principes eorum potestatem habent ipsorum
clem: Jesus autem vocans eos, ait illis: Scitis quia hi, qui videntur principari gentibus, dominantur eis: et principes eorum potestatem habent ipsorum.
tr: ο δε ιησους προσκαλεσαμενος αυτους λεγει αυτοις οιδατε οτι οι δοκουντες αρχειν των εθνων κατακυριευουσιν αυτων και οι μεγαλοι αυτων κατεξουσιαζουσιν αυτων
kjv: But Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.

vulg: non ita est autem in vobis sed quicumque voluerit fieri maior erit vester minister
clem: Non ita est autem in vobis, sed quicumque voluerit fieri major, erit vester minister:
tr: ουχ ουτως δε εσται εν υμιν αλλ ος εαν θελη γενεσθαι μεγας εν υμιν εσται διακονος υμων
kjv: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:

vulg: et quicumque voluerit in vobis primus esse erit omnium servus
clem: et quicumque voluerit in vobis primus esse, erit omnium servus.
tr: και ος αν θελη υμων γενεσθαι πρωτος εσται παντων δουλος
kjv: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.

vulg: nam et Filius hominis non venit ut ministraretur ei sed ut ministraret et daret animam suam redemptionem pro multis
clem: Nam et Filius hominis non venit ut ministraretur ei, sed ut ministraret, et daret animam suam redemptionem pro multis.
tr: και γαρ ο υιος του ανθρωπου ουκ ηλθεν διακονηθηναι αλλα διακονησαι και δουναι την ψυχην αυτου λυτρον αντι πολλων
kjv: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

vulg: et veniunt Hierichum et proficiscente eo de Hiericho et discipulis eius et plurima multitudine filius Timei Bartimeus caecus sedebat iuxta viam mendicans
clem: Et veniunt Jericho: et proficiscente eo de Jericho, et discipulis ejus, et plurima multitudine, filius Tim Bartimus ccus, sedebat juxta viam mendicans.
tr: και ερχονται εις ιεριχω και εκπορευομενου αυτου απο ιεριχω και των μαθητων αυτου και οχλου ικανου υιος τιμαιου βαρτιμαιος ο τυφλος εκαθητο παρα την οδον προσαιτων
kjv: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging.

vulg: qui cum audisset quia Iesus Nazarenus est coepit clamare et dicere Fili David Iesu miserere mei
clem: Qui cum audisset quia Jesus Nazarenus est, cpit clamare, et dicere: Jesu fili David, miserere mei.
tr: και ακουσας οτι ιησους ο ναζωραιος εστιν ηρξατο κραζειν και λεγειν ο υιος δαβιδ ιησου ελεησον με
kjv: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.

vulg: et comminabantur illi multi ut taceret at ille multo magis clamabat Fili David miserere mei
clem: Et comminabantur ei multi ut taceret. At ille multo magis clamabat: Fili David, miserere mei.
tr: και επετιμων αυτω πολλοι ινα σιωπηση ο δε πολλω μαλλον εκραζεν υιε δαβιδ ελεησον με
kjv: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou son of David, have mercy on me.

vulg: et stans Iesus praecepit illum vocari et vocant caecum dicentes ei animaequior esto surge vocat te
clem: Et stans Jesus prcepit illum vocari. Et vocant ccum, dicentes ei: Animquior esto: surge, vocat te.
tr: και στας ο ιησους ειπεν αυτον φωνηθηναι και φωνουσιν τον τυφλον λεγοντες αυτω θαρσει εγειραι φωνει σε
kjv: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.

vulg: qui proiecto vestimento suo exiliens venit ad eum
clem: Qui projecto vestimento suo exiliens, venit ad eum.
tr: ο δε αποβαλων το ιματιον αυτου αναστας ηλθεν προς τον ιησουν
kjv: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.

vulg: et respondens illi Iesus dixit quid vis tibi faciam caecus autem dixit ei rabboni ut videam
clem: Et respondens Jesus dixit illi: Quid tibi vis faciam? Ccus autem dixit ei: Rabboni, ut videam.
tr: και αποκριθεις λεγει αυτω ο ιησους τι θελεις ποιησω σοι ο δε τυφλος ειπεν αυτω ραββονι ινα αναβλεψω
kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.

vulg: Iesus autem ait illi vade fides tua te salvum fecit et confestim vidit et sequebatur eum in via
clem: Jesus autem ait illi: Vade, fides tua te salvum fecit. Et confestim vidit, et sequebatur eum in via.
tr: ο δε ιησους ειπεν αυτω υπαγε η πιστις σου σεσωκεν σε και ευθεως ανεβλεψεν και ηκολουθει τω ιησου εν τη οδω
kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.

vulg: et cum adpropinquarent Hierosolymae et Bethaniae ad montem Olivarum mittit duos ex discipulis suis
clem: Et cum appropinquarent Jerosolym et Bethani ad montem Olivarum, mittit duos ex discipulis suis,
tr: και οτε εγγιζουσιν εις ιερουσαλημ εις βηθφαγη και βηθανιαν προς το ορος των ελαιων αποστελλει δυο των μαθητων αυτου
kjv: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,

vulg: et ait illis ite in castellum quod est contra vos et statim introeuntes illuc invenietis pullum ligatum super quem nemo adhuc hominum sedit solvite illum et adducite
clem: et ait illis: Ite in castellum, quod contra vos est, et statim intrountes illuc, invenietis pullum ligatum, super quem nemo adhuc hominum sedit: solvite illum, et adducite.
tr: και λεγει αυτοις υπαγετε εις την κωμην την κατεναντι υμων και ευθεως εισπορευομενοι εις αυτην ευρησετε πωλον δεδεμενον εφ ον ουδεις ανθρωπων κεκαθικεν λυσαντες αυτον αγαγετε
kjv: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him.

vulg: et si quis vobis dixerit quid facitis dicite quia Domino necessarius est et continuo illum dimittet huc
clem: Et si quis vobis dixerit: Quid facitis? dicite, quia Domino necessarius est: et continuo illum dimittet huc.
tr: και εαν τις υμιν ειπη τι ποιειτε τουτο ειπατε οτι ο κυριος αυτου χρειαν εχει και ευθεως αυτον αποστελει ωδε
kjv: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.

vulg: et abeuntes invenerunt pullum ligatum ante ianuam foris in bivio et solvunt eum
clem: Et abeuntes invenerunt pullum ligatum ante januam foris in bivio: et solvunt eum.
tr: απηλθον δε και ευρον τον πωλον δεδεμενον προς την θυραν εξω επι του αμφοδου και λυουσιν αυτον
kjv: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.

vulg: et quidam de illic stantibus dicebant illis quid facitis solventes pullum
clem: Et quidam de illic stantibus dicebant illis: Quid facitis solventes pullum?
tr: και τινες των εκει εστηκοτων ελεγον αυτοις τι ποιειτε λυοντες τον πωλον
kjv: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?

vulg: qui dixerunt eis sicut praeceperat illis Iesus et dimiserunt eis
clem: Qui dixerunt eis sicut prceperat illis Jesus, et dimiserunt eis.
tr: οι δε ειπον αυτοις καθως ενετειλατο ο ιησους και αφηκαν αυτους
kjv: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.

vulg: et duxerunt pullum ad Iesum et inponunt illi vestimenta sua et sedit super eo
clem: Et duxerunt pullum ad Jesum: et imponunt illi vestimenta sua, et sedit super eum.
tr: και ηγαγον τον πωλον προς τον ιησουν και επεβαλον αυτω τα ιματια αυτων και εκαθισεν επ αυτω
kjv: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.

vulg: multi autem vestimenta sua straverunt in via alii autem frondes caedebant de arboribus et sternebant in via
clem: Multi autem vestimenta sua straverunt in via: alii autem frondes cdebant de arboribus, et sternebant in via.
tr: πολλοι δε τα ιματια αυτων εστρωσαν εις την οδον αλλοι δε στοιβαδας εκοπτον εκ των δενδρων και εστρωννυον εις την οδον
kjv: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.

vulg: et qui praeibant et qui sequebantur clamabant dicentes osanna benedictus qui venit in nomine Domini
clem: Et qui pribant, et qui sequebantur, clamabant, dicentes: Hosanna: benedictus qui venit in nomine Domini:
tr: και οι προαγοντες και οι ακολουθουντες εκραζον λεγοντες ωσαννα ευλογημενος ο ερχομενος εν ονοματι κυριου
kjv: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:

vulg: benedictum quod venit regnum patris nostri David osanna in excelsis
clem: benedictum quod venit regnum patris nostri David: hosanna in excelsis.
tr: ευλογημενη η ερχομενη βασιλεια εν ονοματι κυριου του πατρος ημων δαβιδ ωσαννα εν τοις υψιστοις
kjv: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.

vulg: et introivit Hierosolyma in templum et circumspectis omnibus cum iam vespera esset hora exivit in Bethania cum duodecim
clem: Et introivit Jerosolymam in templum: et circumspectis omnibus, cum jam vespera esset hora, exiit in Bethaniam cum duodecim.
tr: και εισηλθεν εις ιεροσολυμα ο ιησους και εις το ιερον και περιβλεψαμενος παντα οψιας ηδη ουσης της ωρας εξηλθεν εις βηθανιαν μετα των δωδεκα
kjv: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.

vulg: et alia die cum exirent a Bethania esuriit
clem: Et alia die cum exirent a Bethania, esuriit.
tr: και τη επαυριον εξελθοντων αυτων απο βηθανιας επεινασεν
kjv: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:

vulg: cumque vidisset a longe ficum habentem folia venit si quid forte inveniret in ea et cum venisset ad eam nihil invenit praeter folia non enim erat tempus ficorum
clem: Cumque vidisset a longe ficum habentem folia, venit si quid forte inveniret in ea: et cum venisset ad eam, nihil invenit prter folia: non enim erat tempus ficorum.
tr: και ιδων συκην μακροθεν εχουσαν φυλλα ηλθεν ει αρα ευρησει τι εν αυτη και ελθων επ αυτην ουδεν ευρεν ει μη φυλλα ου γαρ ην καιρος συκων
kjv: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.

vulg: et respondens dixit ei iam non amplius in aeternum quisquam fructum ex te manducet et audiebant discipuli eius
clem: Et respondens dixit ei: Jam non amplius in ternum ex te fructum quisquam manducet. Et audiebant discipuli ejus.
tr: και αποκριθεις ο ιησους ειπεν αυτη μηκετι εκ σου εις τον αιωνα μηδεις καρπον φαγοι και ηκουον οι μαθηται αυτου
kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.

vulg: et veniunt Hierosolymam et cum introisset templum coepit eicere vendentes et ementes in templo et mensas nummulariorum et cathedras vendentium columbas evertit
clem: Et veniunt in Jerosolymam. Et cum introisset in templum, cpit ejicere vendentes et ementes in templo: et mensas numulariorum, et cathedras vendentium columbas evertit:
tr: και ερχονται εις ιεροσολυμα και εισελθων ο ιησους εις το ιερον ηρξατο εκβαλλειν τους πωλουντας και αγοραζοντας εν τω ιερω και τας τραπεζας των κολλυβιστων και τας καθεδρας των πωλουντων τας περιστερας κατεστρεψεν
kjv: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;

vulg: et non sinebat ut quisquam vas transferret per templum
clem: et non sinebat ut quisquam transferret vas per templum:
tr: και ουκ ηφιεν ινα τις διενεγκη σκευος δια του ιερου
kjv: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.

vulg: et docebat dicens eis non scriptum est quia domus mea domus orationis vocabitur omnibus gentibus vos autem fecistis eam speluncam latronum
clem: et docebat, dicens eis: Nonne scriptum est: Quia domus mea, domus orationis vocabitur omnibus gentibus? vos autem fecistis eam speluncam latronum.
tr: και εδιδασκεν λεγων αυτοις ου γεγραπται οτι ο οικος μου οικος προσευχης κληθησεται πασιν τοις εθνεσιν υμεις δε εποιησατε αυτον σπηλαιον ληστων
kjv: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.

vulg: quo audito principes sacerdotum et scribae quaerebant quomodo eum perderent timebant enim eum quoniam universa turba admirabatur super doctrina eius
clem: Quo audito principes sacerdotum et scrib, qurebant quomodo eum perderent: timebant enim eum, quoniam universa turba admirabatur super doctrina ejus.
tr: και ηκουσαν οι γραμματεις και οι αρχιερεις και εζητουν πως αυτον απολεσουσιν εφοβουντο γαρ αυτον οτι πας ο οχλος εξεπλησσετο επι τη διδαχη αυτου
kjv: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.

vulg: et cum vespera facta esset egrediebatur de civitate
clem: Et cum vespera facta esset, egrediebatur de civitate.
tr: και οτε οψε εγενετο εξεπορευετο εξω της πολεως
kjv: And when even was come, he went out of the city.

vulg: et cum mane transirent viderunt ficum aridam factam a radicibus
clem: Et cum mane transirent, viderunt ficum aridam factam a radicibus.
tr: και πρωι παραπορευομενοι ειδον την συκην εξηραμμενην εκ ριζων
kjv: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.

vulg: et recordatus Petrus dicit ei rabbi ecce ficus cui maledixisti aruit
clem: Et recordatus Petrus, dixit ei: Rabbi, ecce ficus, cui maledixisti, aruit.
tr: και αναμνησθεις ο πετρος λεγει αυτω ραββι ιδε η συκη ην κατηρασω εξηρανται
kjv: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.

vulg: et respondens Iesus ait illis habete fidem Dei
clem: Et respondens Jesus ait illis: Habete fidem Dei.
tr: και αποκριθεις ιησους λεγει αυτοις εχετε πιστιν θεου
kjv: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.

vulg: amen dico vobis quicumque dixerit huic monti tollere et mittere in mare et non haesitaverit in corde suo sed crediderit quia quodcumque dixerit fiat fiet ei
clem: Amen dico vobis, quia quicumque dixerit huic monti: Tollere, et mittere in mare, et non hsitaverit in corde suo, sed crediderit, quia quodcumque dixerit fiat, fiat ei.
tr: αμην γαρ λεγω υμιν οτι ος αν ειπη τω ορει τουτω αρθητι και βληθητι εις την θαλασσαν και μη διακριθη εν τη καρδια αυτου αλλα πιστευση οτι α λεγει γινεται εσται αυτω ο εαν ειπη
kjv: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.

vulg: propterea dico vobis omnia quaecumque orantes petitis credite quia accipietis et veniet vobis
clem: Propterea dico vobis, omnia qucumque orantes petitis, credite quia accipietis, et evenient vobis.
tr: δια τουτο λεγω υμιν παντα οσα αν προσευχομενοι αιτεισθε πιστευετε οτι λαμβανετε και εσται υμιν
kjv: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.

vulg: et cum stabitis ad orandum dimittite si quid habetis adversus aliquem ut et Pater vester qui in caelis est dimittat vobis peccata vestra
clem: Et cum stabitis ad orandum, dimittite si quis habetis adversus aliquem: ut et Pater vester, qui in clis est, dimittat vobis peccata vestra.
tr: και οταν στηκητε προσευχομενοι αφιετε ει τι εχετε κατα τινος ινα και ο πατηρ υμων ο εν τοις ουρανοις αφη υμιν τα παραπτωματα υμων
kjv: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.

vulg: quod si vos non dimiseritis nec Pater vester qui in caelis est dimittet vobis peccata vestra
clem: Quod si vos non dimiseritis: nec Pater vester, qui in clis est, dimittet vobis peccata vestra.
tr: ει δε υμεις ουκ αφιετε ουδε ο πατηρ υμων ο εν τοις ουρανοις αφησει τα παραπτωματα υμων
kjv: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.

vulg: et veniunt rursus Hierosolymam et cum ambularet in templo accedunt ad eum summi sacerdotes et scribae et seniores
clem: Et veniunt rursus Jerosolymam. Et cum ambularet in templo, accedunt ad eum summi sacerdotes, et scrib, et seniores:
tr: και ερχονται παλιν εις ιεροσολυμα και εν τω ιερω περιπατουντος αυτου ερχονται προς αυτον οι αρχιερεις και οι γραμματεις και οι πρεσβυτεροι
kjv: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,

vulg: et dicunt illi in qua potestate haec facis et quis tibi dedit hanc potestatem ut ista facias
clem: et dicunt ei: In qua potestate hc facis? et quis dedit tibi hanc potestatem ut ista facias?
tr: και λεγουσιν αυτω εν ποια εξουσια ταυτα ποιεις και τις σοι την εξουσιαν ταυτην εδωκεν ινα ταυτα ποιης
kjv: And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?

vulg: Iesus autem respondens ait illis interrogabo vos et ego unum verbum et respondete mihi et dicam vobis in qua potestate haec faciam
clem: Jesus autem respondens, ait illis: Interrogabo vos et ego unum verbum, et respondete mihi: et dicam vobis in qua potestate hc faciam.
tr: ο δε ιησους αποκριθεις ειπεν αυτοις επερωτησω υμας καγω ενα λογον και αποκριθητε μοι και ερω υμιν εν ποια εξουσια ταυτα ποιω
kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

vulg: baptismum Iohannis de caelo erat an ex hominibus respondete mihi
clem: Baptismus Joannis, de clo erat, an ex hominibus? Respondete mihi.
tr: το βαπτισμα ιωαννου εξ ουρανου ην η εξ ανθρωπων αποκριθητε μοι
kjv: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.

vulg: at illi cogitabant secum dicentes si dixerimus de caelo dicet quare ergo non credidistis ei
clem: At illi cogitabant secum, dicentes: Si dixerimus: De clo, dicet: Quare non credidistis ei?
tr: και ελογιζοντο προς εαυτους λεγοντες εαν ειπωμεν εξ ουρανου ερει δια τι ουν ουκ επιστευσατε αυτω
kjv: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?

vulg: sed dicemus ex hominibus timebant populum omnes enim habebant Iohannem quia vere propheta esset
clem: Si dixerimus: Ex hominibus, timemus populum: omnes enim habebant Joannem quia vere propheta esset.
tr: αλλ εαν ειπωμεν εξ ανθρωπων εφοβουντο τον λαον απαντες γαρ ειχον τον ιωαννην οτι οντως προφητης ην
kjv: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.

vulg: et respondentes dicunt Iesu nescimus respondens Iesus ait illis neque ego dico vobis in qua potestate haec faciam
clem: Et respondentes dicunt Jesu: Nescimus. Et respondens Jesus ait illis: Neque ego dico vobis in qua potestate hc faciam.
tr: και αποκριθεντες λεγουσιν τω ιησου ουκ οιδαμεν και ο ιησους αποκριθεις λεγει αυτοις ουδε εγω λεγω υμιν εν ποια εξουσια ταυτα ποιω
kjv: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

vulg: et coepit illis in parabolis loqui vineam pastinavit homo et circumdedit sepem et fodit lacum et aedificavit turrem et locavit eam agricolis et peregre profectus est
clem: Et cpit illis in parabolis loqui: Vineam pastinavit homo, et circumdedit sepem, et fodit lacum, et dificavit turrim, et locavit eam agricolis, et peregre profectus est.
tr: και ηρξατο αυτοις εν παραβολαις λεγειν αμπελωνα εφυτευσεν ανθρωπος και περιεθηκεν φραγμον και ωρυξεν υποληνιον και ωκοδομησεν πυργον και εξεδοτο αυτον γεωργοις και απεδημησεν
kjv: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.

vulg: et misit ad agricolas in tempore servum ut ab agricolis acciperet de fructu vineae
clem: Et misit ad agricolas in tempore servum ut ab agricolis acciperet de fructu vine.
tr: και απεστειλεν προς τους γεωργους τω καιρω δουλον ινα παρα των γεωργων λαβη απο του καρπου του αμπελωνος
kjv: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.

vulg: qui adprehensum eum ceciderunt et dimiserunt vacuum
clem: Qui apprehensum eum ceciderunt, et dimiserunt vacuum.
tr: οι δε λαβοντες αυτον εδειραν και απεστειλαν κενον
kjv: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.

vulg: et iterum misit ad illos alium servum et illum capite vulneraverunt et contumeliis adfecerunt
clem: Et iterum misit ad illos alium servum: et illum in capite vulneraverunt, et contumeliis affecerunt.
tr: και παλιν απεστειλεν προς αυτους αλλον δουλον κακεινον λιθοβολησαντες εκεφαλαιωσαν και απεστειλαν ητιμωμενον
kjv: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.

vulg: et rursum alium misit et illum occiderunt et plures alios quosdam caedentes alios vero occidentes
clem: Et rursum alium misit, et illum occiderunt: et plures alios: quosdam cdentes, alios vero occidentes.
tr: και παλιν αλλον απεστειλεν κακεινον απεκτειναν και πολλους αλλους τους μεν δεροντες τους δε αποκτεινοντες
kjv: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.

vulg: adhuc ergo unum habens filium carissimum et illum misit ad eos novissimum dicens quia reverebuntur filium meum
clem: Adhuc ergo unum habens filium carissimum, et illum misit ad eos novissimum, dicens: Quia reverebuntur filium meum.
tr: ετι ουν ενα υιον εχων αγαπητον αυτου απεστειλεν και αυτον προς αυτους εσχατον λεγων οτι εντραπησονται τον υιον μου
kjv: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.

vulg: coloni autem dixerunt ad invicem hic est heres venite occidamus eum et nostra erit hereditas
clem: Coloni autem dixerunt ad invicem: Hic est hres: venite, occidamus eum: et nostra erit hreditas.
tr: εκεινοι δε οι γεωργοι ειπον προς εαυτους οτι ουτος εστιν ο κληρονομος δευτε αποκτεινωμεν αυτον και ημων εσται η κληρονομια
kjv: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.'

vulg: et adprehendentes eum occiderunt et eiecerunt extra vineam
clem: Et apprehendentes eum, occiderunt: et ejecerunt extra vineam.
tr: και λαβοντες αυτον απεκτειναν και εξεβαλον εξω του αμπελωνος
kjv: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

vulg: quid ergo faciet dominus vineae veniet et perdet colonos et dabit vineam aliis
clem: Quid ergo faciet dominus vine? Veniet, et perdet colonos, et dabit vineam aliis.
tr: τι ουν ποιησει ο κυριος του αμπελωνος ελευσεται και απολεσει τους γεωργους και δωσει τον αμπελωνα αλλοις
kjv: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.

vulg: nec scripturam hanc legistis lapidem quem reprobaverunt aedificantes hic factus est in caput anguli
clem: Nec scripturam hanc legistis: Lapidem quem reprobaverunt dificantes, hic factus est in caput anguli:
tr: ουδε την γραφην ταυτην ανεγνωτε λιθον ον απεδοκιμασαν οι οικοδομουντες ουτος εγενηθη εις κεφαλην γωνιας
kjv: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:

vulg: a Domino factum est istud et est mirabile in oculis nostris
clem: a Domino factum est istud, et est mirabile in oculis nostris?
tr: παρα κυριου εγενετο αυτη και εστιν θαυμαστη εν οφθαλμοις ημων
kjv: This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

vulg: et quaerebant eum tenere et timuerunt turbam cognoverunt enim quoniam ad eos parabolam hanc dixerit et relicto eo abierunt
clem: Et qurebant eum tenere: et timuerunt turbam: cognoverunt enim quoniam ad eos parabolam hanc dixerit. Et relicto eo abierunt.
tr: και εζητουν αυτον κρατησαι και εφοβηθησαν τον οχλον εγνωσαν γαρ οτι προς αυτους την παραβολην ειπεν και αφεντες αυτον απηλθον
kjv: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.

vulg: et mittunt ad eum quosdam ex Pharisaeis et Herodianis ut eum caperent in verbo
clem: Et mittunt ad eum quosdam ex pharisis, et herodianis, ut eum caperent in verbo.
tr: και αποστελλουσιν προς αυτον τινας των φαρισαιων και των ηρωδιανων ινα αυτον αγρευσωσιν λογω
kjv: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.

vulg: qui venientes dicunt ei magister scimus quoniam verax es et non curas quemquam nec enim vides in faciem hominis sed in veritate viam Dei doces licet dari tributum Caesari an non dabimus
clem: Qui venientes dicunt ei: Magister, scimus quia verax es, et non curas quemquam: nec enim vides in faciem hominum, sed in veritate viam Dei doces. Licet dari tributum Csari, an non dabimus?
tr: οι δε ελθοντες λεγουσιν αυτω διδασκαλε οιδαμεν οτι αληθης ει και ου μελει σοι περι ουδενος ου γαρ βλεπεις εις προσωπον ανθρωπων αλλ επ αληθειας την οδον του θεου διδασκεις εξεστιν κηνσον καισαρι δουναι η ου
kjv: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?

vulg: qui sciens versutiam eorum ait illis quid me temptatis adferte mihi denarium ut videam
clem: Qui sciens versutiam illorum, ait illos: Quid me tentatis? afferte mihi denarium ut videam.
tr: δωμεν η μη δωμεν ο δε ειδως αυτων την υποκρισιν ειπεν αυτοις τι με πειραζετε φερετε μοι δηναριον ινα ιδω
kjv: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.

vulg: at illi adtulerunt et ait illis cuius est imago haec et inscriptio dicunt illi Caesaris
clem: At illi attulerunt ei. Et ait illis: Cujus est imago hc, et inscriptio? Dicunt ei: Csaris.
tr: οι δε ηνεγκαν και λεγει αυτοις τινος η εικων αυτη και η επιγραφη οι δε ειπον αυτω καισαρος
kjv: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.

vulg: respondens autem Iesus dixit illis reddite igitur quae sunt Caesaris Caesari et quae sunt Dei Deo et mirabantur super eo
clem: Respondens autem Jesus dixit illis: Reddite igitur qu sunt Csaris, Csari: et qu sunt Dei, Deo. Et mirabantur super eo.
tr: και αποκριθεις ο ιησους ειπεν αυτοις αποδοτε τα καισαρος καισαρι και τα του θεου τω θεω και εθαυμασαν επ αυτω
kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.

vulg: et venerunt ad eum Sadducaei qui dicunt resurrectionem non esse et interrogabant eum dicentes
clem: Et venerunt ad eum sadduci, qui dicunt resurrectionem non esse: et interrogabant eum, dicentes:
tr: και ερχονται σαδδουκαιοι προς αυτον οιτινες λεγουσιν αναστασιν μη ειναι και επηρωτησαν αυτον λεγοντες
kjv: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,

vulg: magister Moses nobis scripsit ut si cuius frater mortuus fuerit et dimiserit uxorem et filios non reliquerit accipiat frater eius uxorem ipsius et resuscitet semen fratri suo
clem: Magister, Moyses nobis scripsit, ut si cujus frater mortuus fuerit, et dimiserit uxorem, et filios non reliquerit, accipiat frater ejus uxorem ipsius, et resuscitet semen fratri suo.
tr: διδασκαλε μωσης εγραψεν ημιν οτι εαν τινος αδελφος αποθανη και καταλιπη γυναικα και τεκνα μη αφη ινα λαβη ο αδελφος αυτου την γυναικα αυτου και εξαναστηση σπερμα τω αδελφω αυτου
kjv: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

vulg: septem ergo fratres erant et primus accepit uxorem et mortuus est non relicto semine
clem: Septem ergo fratres erant: et primus accepit uxorem, et mortuus est non relicto semine.
tr: επτα  ουν  αδελφοι ησαν και ο πρωτος ελαβεν γυναικα και αποθνησκων ουκ αφηκεν σπερμα
kjv: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.

vulg: et secundus accepit eam et mortuus est et nec iste reliquit semen et tertius similiter
clem: Et secundus accepit eam, et mortuus est: et nec iste reliquit semen. Et tertius similiter.
tr: και ο δευτερος ελαβεν αυτην και απεθανεν και ουδε αυτος αφηκεν σπερμα και ο τριτος ωσαυτως
kjv: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.

vulg: et acceperunt eam similiter septem et non reliquerunt semen novissima omnium defuncta est et mulier
clem: Et acceperunt eam similiter septem: et non reliquerunt semen. Novissima omnium defuncta est et mulier.
tr: και ελαβον αυτην οι επτα και ουκ αφηκαν σπερμα εσχατη παντων απεθανεν και η γυνη
kjv: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.

vulg: in resurrectione ergo cum resurrexerint cuius de his erit uxor septem enim habuerunt eam uxorem
clem: In resurrectione ergo cum resurrexerint, cujus de his erit uxor? septem enim habuerunt eam uxorem.
tr: εν τη ουν αναστασει οταν αναστωσιν τινος αυτων εσται γυνη οι γαρ επτα εσχον αυτην γυναικα
kjv: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.

vulg: et respondens Iesus ait illis non ideo erratis non scientes scripturas neque virtutem Dei
clem: Et respondens Jesus, ait illis: Nonne ideo erratis, non scientes Scripturas, neque virtutem Dei?
tr: και αποκριθεις ο ιησους ειπεν αυτοις ου δια τουτο πλανασθε μη ειδοτες τας γραφας μηδε την δυναμιν του θεου
kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?

vulg: cum enim a mortuis resurrexerint neque nubent neque nubentur sed sunt sicut angeli in caelis
clem: Cum enim a mortuis resurrexerint, neque nubent, neque nubentur, sed sunt sicut angeli in clis.
tr: οταν γαρ εκ νεκρων αναστωσιν ουτε γαμουσιν ουτε γαμισκονται αλλ εισιν ως αγγελοι οι εν τοις ουρανοις
kjv: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.

vulg: de mortuis autem quod resurgant non legistis in libro Mosi super rubum quomodo dixerit illi Deus inquiens ego sum Deus Abraham et Deus Isaac et Deus Iacob
clem: De mortuis autem quod resurgant, non legistis in libro Moysi, super rubum, quomodo dixerit illi Deus, inquiens: Ego sum Deus Abraham, et Deus Isaac, et Deus Jacob?
tr: περι δε των νεκρων οτι εγειρονται ουκ ανεγνωτε εν τη βιβλω μωσεως επι της βατου ως ειπεν αυτω ο θεος λεγων εγω ο θεος αβρααμ και ο θεος ισαακ και ο θεος ιακωβ
kjv: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?

vulg: non est Deus mortuorum sed vivorum vos ergo multum erratis
clem: Non est Deus mortuorum, sed vivorum. Vos ergo multum erratis.
tr: ουκ εστιν ο θεος νεκρων αλλα θεος ζωντων υμεις ουν πολυ πλανασθε
kjv: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.

vulg: et accessit unus de scribis qui audierat illos conquirentes et videns quoniam bene illis responderit interrogavit eum quod esset primum omnium mandatum
clem: Et accessit unus de scribis, qui audierat illos conquirentes, et videns quoniam bene illis responderit, interrogavit eum quod esset primum omnium mandatum.
tr: και προσελθων εις των γραμματεων ακουσας αυτων συζητουντων ειδως οτι καλως αυτοις απεκριθη επηρωτησεν αυτον ποια εστιν πρωτη πασων εντολη
kjv: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?

vulg: Iesus autem respondit ei quia primum omnium mandatum est audi Israhel Dominus Deus noster Deus unus est
clem: Jesus autem respondit ei: Quia primum omnium mandatum est: Audi Isral, Dominus Deus tuus, Deus unus est:
tr: ο δε ιησους απεκριθη αυτω οτι πρωτη πασων των εντολων ακουε ισραηλ κυριος ο θεος ημων κυριος εις εστιν
kjv: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:

vulg: et diliges Dominum Deum tuum ex toto corde tuo et ex tota anima tua et ex tota mente tua et ex tota virtute tua hoc est primum mandatum
clem: et diliges Dominum Deum tuum ex tota corde tuo, et ex tota anima tua, et ex tota mente tua, et ex tota virtute tua. Hoc est primum mandatum.
tr: και αγαπησεις κυριον τον θεον σου εξ ολης της καρδιας σου και εξ ολης της ψυχης σου και εξ ολης της διανοιας σου και εξ ολης της ισχυος σου αυτη πρωτη εντολη
kjv: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.

vulg: secundum autem simile illi diliges proximum tuum tamquam te ipsum maius horum aliud mandatum non est
clem: Secundum autem simile est illi: Diliges proximum tuum tamquam teipsum. Majus horum aliud mandatum non est.
tr: και δευτερα ομοια αυτη αγαπησεις τον πλησιον σου ως σεαυτον μειζων τουτων αλλη εντολη ουκ εστιν
kjv: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.

vulg: et ait illi scriba bene magister in veritate dixisti quia unus est et non est alius praeter eum
clem: Et ait illi scriba: Bene, Magister, in veritate dixisti, quia unus est Deus, et non est alius prter eum.
tr: και ειπεν αυτω ο γραμματευς καλως διδασκαλε επ αληθειας ειπας οτι εις εστιν θεος και ουκ εστιν αλλος πλην αυτου
kjv: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:

vulg: et ut diligatur ex toto corde et ex toto intellectu et ex tota anima et ex tota fortitudine et diligere proximum tamquam se ipsum maius est omnibus holocaustomatibus et sacrificiis
clem: Et ut diligatur ex toto corde, et ex toto intellectu, et ex tota anima, et ex tota fortitudine, et diligere proximum tamquam seipsum, majus est omnibus holocautomatibus, et sacrificiis.
tr: και το αγαπαν αυτον εξ ολης της καρδιας και εξ ολης της συνεσεως και εξ ολης της ψυχης και εξ ολης της ισχυος και το αγαπαν τον πλησιον ως εαυτον πλειον εστιν παντων των ολοκαυτωματων και των θυσιων
kjv: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.

vulg: Iesus autem videns quod sapienter respondisset dixit illi non es longe a regno Dei et nemo iam audebat eum interrogare
clem: Jesus autem videns quod sapienter respondisset, dixit illi: Non es longe a regno Dei. Et nemo jam audebat eum interrogare.
tr: και ο ιησους ιδων αυτον οτι νουνεχως απεκριθη ειπεν αυτω ου μακραν ει απο της βασιλειας του θεου και ουδεις ουκετι ετολμα αυτον επερωτησαι
kjv: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.

vulg: et respondens Iesus dicebat docens in templo quomodo dicunt scribae Christum Filium esse David
clem: Et respondens Jesus dicebat, docens in templo: Quomodo dicunt scrib Christum filium esse David?
tr: και αποκριθεις ο ιησους ελεγεν διδασκων εν τω ιερω πως λεγουσιν οι γραμματεις οτι ο χριστος υιος εστιν δαβιδ
kjv: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the son of David?

vulg: ipse enim David dicit in Spiritu Sancto dixit Dominus Domino meo sede a dextris meis donec ponam inimicos tuos scabillum pedum tuorum
clem: Ipse enim David dicit in Spiritu Sancto: Dixit Dominus Domino meo: Sede a dextris meis, donec ponam inimicos tuos scabellum pedum tuorum.
tr: αυτος γαρ δαβιδ ειπεν εν τω πνευματι τω αγιω ειπεν ο κυριος τω κυριω μου καθου εκ δεξιων μου εως αν θω τους εχθρους σου υποποδιον των ποδων σου
kjv: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The Lord said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

vulg: ipse ergo David dicit eum Dominum et unde est filius eius et multa turba eum libenter audivit
clem: Ipse ergo David dicit eum Dominum, et unde est filius ejus? Et multa turba eum libenter audivit.
tr: αυτος ουν δαβιδ λεγει αυτον κυριον και ποθεν υιος αυτου εστιν και ο πολυς οχλος ηκουεν αυτου ηδεως
kjv: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.

vulg: et dicebat eis in doctrina sua cavete a scribis qui volunt in stolis ambulare et salutari in foro
clem: Et dicebat eis in doctrina sua: Cavete a scribis, qui volunt in stolis ambulare, et salutari in foro,
tr: και ελεγεν αυτοις εν τη διδαχη αυτου βλεπετε απο των γραμματεων των θελοντων εν στολαις περιπατειν και ασπασμους εν ταις αγοραις
kjv: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,

vulg: et in primis cathedris sedere in synagogis et primos discubitus in cenis
clem: et in primis cathedris sedere in synagogis, et primos discubitus in cnis:
tr: και πρωτοκαθεδριας εν ταις συναγωγαις και πρωτοκλισιας εν τοις δειπνοις
kjv: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:

vulg: qui devorant domos viduarum sub obtentu prolixae orationis hii accipient prolixius iudicium
clem: qui devorant domos viduarum sub obtentu prolix orationis: hi accipient prolixius judicium.
tr: οι κατεσθιοντες τας οικιας των χηρων και προφασει μακρα προσευχομενοι ουτοι ληψονται περισσοτερον κριμα
kjv: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.

vulg: et sedens Iesus contra gazofilacium aspiciebat quomodo turba iactaret aes in gazofilacium et multi divites iactabant multa
clem: Et sedens Jesus contra gazophylacium, aspiciebat quomodo turba jactaret s in gazophylacium, et multi divites jactabant multa.
tr: και καθισας ο ιησους κατεναντι του γαζοφυλακιου εθεωρει πως ο οχλος βαλλει χαλκον εις το γαζοφυλακιον και πολλοι πλουσιοι εβαλλον πολλα
kjv: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.

vulg: cum venisset autem una vidua pauper misit duo minuta quod est quadrans
clem: Cum venisset autem vidua una pauper, misit duo minuta, quod est quadrans,
tr: και ελθουσα μια χηρα πτωχη εβαλεν λεπτα δυο ο εστιν κοδραντης
kjv: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.

vulg: et convocans discipulos suos ait illis amen dico vobis quoniam vidua haec pauper plus omnibus misit qui miserunt in gazofilacium
clem: et convocans discipulos suos, ait illis: Amen dico vobis, quoniam vidua hc pauper plus omnibus misit, qui miserunt in gazophylacium.
tr: και προσκαλεσαμενος τους μαθητας αυτου λεγει αυτοις αμην λεγω υμιν οτι η χηρα αυτη η πτωχη πλειον παντων βεβληκεν των βαλοντων εις το γαζοφυλακιον
kjv: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:

vulg: omnes enim ex eo quod abundabat illis miserunt haec vero de penuria sua omnia quae habuit misit totum victum suum
clem: Omnes enim ex eo, quod abundabat illis, miserunt: hc vero de penuria sua omnia qu habuit misit totum victum suum.
tr: παντες γαρ εκ του περισσευοντος αυτοις εβαλον αυτη δε εκ της υστερησεως αυτης παντα οσα ειχεν εβαλεν ολον τον βιον αυτης
kjv: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.

vulg: et cum egrederetur de templo ait illi unus ex discipulis suis magister aspice quales lapides et quales structurae
clem: Et cum egrederetur de templo, ait illi unus ex discipulis suis: Magister, aspice quales lapides, et quales structur.
tr: και εκπορευομενου αυτου εκ του ιερου λεγει αυτω εις των μαθητων αυτου διδασκαλε ιδε ποταποι λιθοι και ποταπαι οικοδομαι
kjv: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!

vulg: et respondens Iesus ait illi vides has omnes magnas aedificationes non relinquetur lapis super lapidem qui non destruatur
clem: Et respondens Jesus, ait illi: Vides has omnes magnas dificationes? Non relinquetur lapis super lapidem, qui non destruatur.
tr: και ο ιησους αποκριθεις ειπεν αυτω βλεπεις ταυτας τας μεγαλας οικοδομας ου μη αφεθη λιθος επι λιθω ος ου μη καταλυθη
kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

vulg: et cum sederet in montem Olivarum contra templum interrogabant eum separatim Petrus et Iacobus et Iohannes et Andreas
clem: Et cum sederet in monte Olivarum contra templum, interrogabant eum separatim Petrus, et Jacobus, et Joannes, et Andreas:
tr: και καθημενου αυτου εις το ορος των ελαιων κατεναντι του ιερου επηρωτων αυτον κατ ιδιαν πετρος και ιακωβος και ιωαννης και ανδρεας
kjv: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,

vulg: dic nobis quando ista fient et quod signum erit quando haec omnia incipient consummari
clem: Dic nobis, quando ista fient? et quod signum erit, quando hc omnia incipient consummari?
tr: ειπε ημιν ποτε ταυτα εσται και τι το σημειον οταν μελλη παντα ταυτα συντελεισθαι
kjv: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?

vulg: et respondens Iesus coepit dicere illis videte ne quis vos seducat
clem: Et respondens Jesus cpit dicere illis: Videte ne quid vos seducat:
tr: ο δε ιησους αποκριθεις αυτοις ηρξατο λεγειν βλεπετε μη τις υμας πλανηση
kjv: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:

vulg: multi enim venient in nomine meo dicentes quia ego sum et multos seducent
clem: multi enim venient in nomine meo, dicentes quia ego sum: et multos seducent.
tr: πολλοι γαρ ελευσονται επι τω ονοματι μου λεγοντες οτι εγω ειμι και πολλους πλανησουσιν
kjv: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.

vulg: cum audieritis autem bella et opiniones bellorum ne timueritis oportet enim fieri sed nondum finis
clem: Cum audieritis autem bella, et opiniones bellorum, ne timueritis: oportet enim hc fieri: sed nondum finis.
tr: οταν δε ακουσητε πολεμους και ακοας πολεμων μη θροεισθε δει γαρ γενεσθαι αλλ ουπω το τελος
kjv: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.

vulg: exsurget autem gens super gentem et regnum super regnum et erunt terraemotus per loca et fames initium dolorum haec
clem: Exsurget enim gens contra gentem, et regnum super regnum, et erunt terrmotus per loca, et fames. Initium dolorum hc.
tr: εγερθησεται γαρ εθνος επι εθνος και βασιλεια επι βασιλειαν και εσονται σεισμοι κατα τοπους και εσονται λιμοι και ταραχαι αρχαι ωδινων ταυτα
kjv: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.

vulg: videte autem vosmet ipsos tradent enim vos conciliis et in synagogis vapulabitis et ante praesides et reges stabitis propter me in testimonium illis
clem: Videte autem vosmetipsos. Tradent enim vos in consiliis, et in synagogis vapulabitis, et ante prsides et reges stabitis propter me, in testimonium illis.
tr: βλεπετε δε υμεις εαυτους παραδωσουσιν γαρ υμας εις συνεδρια και εις συναγωγας δαρησεσθε και επι ηγεμονων και βασιλεων σταθησεσθε  αχθησεσθε  ενεκεν εμου εις μαρτυριον αυτοις
kjv: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.

vulg: et in omnes gentes primum oportet praedicari evangelium
clem: Et in omnes gentes primum oportet prdicari Evangelium.
tr: και εις παντα τα εθνη δει πρωτον κηρυχθηναι το ευαγγελιον
kjv: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.

vulg: et cum duxerint vos tradentes nolite praecogitare quid loquamini sed quod datum vobis fuerit in illa hora id loquimini non enim estis vos loquentes sed Spiritus Sanctus
clem: Et cum duxerint vos tradentes, nolite prcogitare quid loquamini: sed quod datum vobis fuerit in illa hora, id loquimini: non enim vos estis loquentes, sed Spiritus Sanctus.
tr: οταν δε αγαγωσιν υμας παραδιδοντες μη προμεριμνατε τι λαλησητε μηδε μελετατε αλλ ο εαν δοθη υμιν εν εκεινη τη ωρα τουτο λαλειτε ου γαρ εστε υμεις οι λαλουντες αλλα το πνευμα το αγιον
kjv: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.

vulg: tradet autem frater fratrem in mortem et pater filium et consurgent filii in parentes et morte adficient eos
clem: Tradet autem frater fratrem in mortem, et pater filium: et consurgent filii in parentes, et morte afficient eos.
tr: παραδωσει δε αδελφος αδελφον εις θανατον και πατηρ τεκνον και επαναστησονται τεκνα επι γονεις και θανατωσουσιν αυτους
kjv: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.

vulg: et eritis odio omnibus propter nomen meum qui autem sustinuerit in finem hic salvus erit
clem: Et eritis odio omnibus propter nomen meum. Qui autem sustinuerit in finem, hic salvus erit.
tr: και εσεσθε μισουμενοι υπο παντων δια το ονομα μου ο δε υπομεινας εις τελος ουτος σωθησεται
kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

vulg: cum autem videritis abominationem desolationis stantem ubi non debet qui legit intellegat tunc qui in Iudaea sunt fugiant in montes
clem: Cum autem videritis abominationem desolationis stantem, ubi non debet, qui legit, intelligat: tunc qui in Juda sunt, fugiant in montes:
tr: οταν δε ιδητε το βδελυγμα της ερημωσεως το ρηθεν υπο δανιηλ του προφητου εστος  εστως  οπου ου δει ο αναγινωσκων νοειτω τοτε οι εν τη ιουδαια φευγετωσαν εις τα ορη
kjv: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:

vulg: et qui super tectum ne descendat in domum nec introeat ut tollat quid de domo sua
clem: et qui super tectum, ne descendat in domum, nec introat ut tollat quid de domo sua:
tr: ο δε επι του δωματος μη καταβατω εις την οικιαν μηδε εισελθετω αραι τι εκ της οικιας αυτου
kjv: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:

vulg: et qui in agro erit non revertatur retro tollere vestimentum suum
clem: et qui in agro erit, non revertatur retro tollere vestimentum suum.
tr: και ο εις τον αγρον ων μη επιστρεψατω εις τα οπισω αραι το ιματιον αυτου
kjv: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.

vulg: vae autem praegnatibus et nutrientibus in illis diebus
clem: V autem prgnantibus et nutrientibus in illis diebus.
tr: ουαι δε ταις εν γαστρι εχουσαις και ταις θηλαζουσαις εν εκειναις ταις ημεραις
kjv: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

vulg: orate vero ut hieme non fiant
clem: Orate vero ut hieme non fiant.
tr: προσευχεσθε δε ινα μη γενηται η φυγη υμων χειμωνος
kjv: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.

vulg: erunt enim dies illi tribulationes tales quales non fuerunt ab initio creaturae quam condidit Deus usque nunc neque fient
clem: Erunt enim dies illi tribulationes tales quales non fuerunt ab initio creatur, quam condidit Deus usque nunc, neque fient.
tr: εσονται γαρ αι ημεραι εκειναι θλιψις οια ου γεγονεν τοιαυτη απ αρχης κτισεως ης εκτισεν ο θεος εως του νυν και ου μη γενηται
kjv: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.

vulg: et nisi breviasset Dominus dies non fuisset salva omnis caro sed propter electos quos elegit breviavit dies
clem: Et nisi breviasset Dominus dies, non fuisset salva omnis caro: sed propter electos, quos elegit, breviavit dies.
tr: και ει μη κυριος εκολοβωσεν τας ημερας ουκ αν εσωθη πασα σαρξ αλλα δια τους εκλεκτους ους εξελεξατο εκολοβωσεν τας ημερας
kjv: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.

vulg: et tunc si quis vobis dixerit ecce hic est Christus ecce illic ne credideritis
clem: Et tunc si quis vobis dixerit: Ecce hic est Christus, ecce illic, ne credideritis.
tr: και τοτε εαν τις υμιν ειπη ιδου ωδε ο χριστος η ιδου εκει μη πιστευσητε
kjv: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:

vulg: exsurgent enim pseudochristi et pseudoprophetae et dabunt signa et portenta ad seducendos si potest fieri etiam electos
clem: Exsurgent enim pseudochristi et pseudoprophet, et dabunt signa et portenta ad seducendos, si fieri potest, etiam electos.
tr: εγερθησονται γαρ ψευδοχριστοι και ψευδοπροφηται και δωσουσιν σημεια και τερατα προς το αποπλαναν ει δυνατον και τους εκλεκτους
kjv: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.

vulg: vos ergo videte ecce praedixi vobis omnia
clem: Vos ergo videte: ecce prdixi vobis omnia.
tr: υμεις δε βλεπετε ιδου προειρηκα υμιν παντα
kjv: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.

vulg: sed in illis diebus post tribulationem illam sol contenebrabitur et luna non dabit splendorem suum
clem: Sed in illis diebus, post tribulationem illam, sol contenebrabitur, et luna non dabit splendorem suum:
tr: αλλ εν εκειναις ταις ημεραις μετα την θλιψιν εκεινην ο ηλιος σκοτισθησεται και η σεληνη ου δωσει το φεγγος αυτης
kjv: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,

vulg: et erunt stellae caeli decidentes et virtutes quae sunt in caelis movebuntur
clem: et stell cli erunt decidentes, et virtutes, qu in clis sunt, movebuntur.
tr: και οι αστερες του ουρανου εσονται εκπιπτοντες και αι δυναμεις αι εν τοις ουρανοις σαλευθησονται
kjv: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.

vulg: et tunc videbunt Filium hominis venientem in nubibus cum virtute multa et gloria
clem: Et tunc videbunt Filium hominis venientem in nubibus cum virtute multa et gloria.
tr: και τοτε οψονται τον υιον του ανθρωπου ερχομενον εν νεφελαις μετα δυναμεως πολλης και δοξης
kjv: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

vulg: et tunc mittet angelos suos et congregabit electos suos a quattuor ventis a summo terrae usque ad summum caeli
clem: Et tunc mittet angelos suos, et congregabit electos suos a quatuor ventis, a summo terr usque ad summum cli.
tr: και τοτε αποστελει τους αγγελους αυτου και επισυναξει τους εκλεκτους αυτου εκ των τεσσαρων ανεμων απ ακρου γης εως ακρου ουρανου
kjv: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.

vulg: a ficu autem discite parabolam cum iam ramus eius tener fuerit et nata fuerint folia cognoscitis quia in proximo sit aestas
clem: A ficu autem discite parabolam. Cum jam ramus ejus tener fuerit, et nata fuerint folia, cognoscitis quia in proximo sit stas:
tr: απο δε της συκης μαθετε την παραβολην οταν αυτης ηδη ο κλαδος απαλος γενηται και εκφυη τα φυλλα γινωσκετε οτι εγγυς το θερος εστιν
kjv: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:

vulg: sic et vos cum videritis haec fieri scitote quod in proximo sit in ostiis
clem: sic et vos cum videritis hc fieri, scitote quod in proximo sit, in ostiis.
tr: ουτως και υμεις οταν ταυτα ιδητε γινομενα γινωσκετε οτι εγγυς εστιν επι θυραις
kjv: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.

vulg: amen dico vobis quoniam non transiet generatio haec donec omnia ista fiant
clem: Amen dico vobis, quoniam non transibit generatio hc, donec omnia ista fiant.
tr: αμην λεγω υμιν οτι ου μη παρελθη η γενεα αυτη μεχρις ου παντα ταυτα γενηται
kjv: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.

vulg: caelum et terra transibunt verba autem mea non transibunt
clem: Clum et terra transibunt, verba autem mea non transibunt.
tr: ο ουρανος και η γη παρελευσονται οι δε λογοι μου ου μη παρελθωσιν
kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

vulg: de die autem illo vel hora nemo scit neque angeli in caelo neque Filius nisi Pater
clem: De die autem illo vel hora nemo scit, neque angeli in clo, neque Filius, nisi Pater.
tr: περι δε της ημερας εκεινης και της ωρας ουδεις οιδεν ουδε οι αγγελοι οι εν ουρανω ουδε ο υιος ει μη ο πατηρ
kjv: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.

vulg: videte vigilate et orate nescitis enim quando tempus sit
clem: Videte, vigilate, et orate: nescitis enim quando tempus sit.
tr: βλεπετε αγρυπνειτε και προσευχεσθε ουκ οιδατε γαρ ποτε ο καιρος εστιν
kjv: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.

vulg: sicut homo qui peregre profectus reliquit domum suam et dedit servis suis potestatem cuiusque operis et ianitori praecipiat ut vigilet
clem: Sicut homo qui peregre profectus reliquit domum suam, et dedit servis suis potestatem cujusque operis, et janitori prcepit ut vigilet,
tr: ως ανθρωπος αποδημος αφεις την οικιαν αυτου και δους τοις δουλοις αυτου την εξουσιαν και εκαστω το εργον αυτου και τω θυρωρω ενετειλατο ινα γρηγορη
kjv: For the Son of Man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.

vulg: vigilate ergo nescitis enim quando dominus domus veniat sero an media nocte an galli cantu an mane
clem: vigilate ergo (nescitis enim quando dominus domus veniat: sero, an media nocte, an galli cantu, an mane),
tr: γρηγορειτε ουν ουκ οιδατε γαρ ποτε ο κυριος της οικιας ερχεται οψε η μεσονυκτιου η αλεκτοροφωνιας η πρωι
kjv: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:

vulg: ne cum venerit repente inveniat vos dormientes
clem: ne, cum venerit repente, inveniat vos dormientes.
tr: μη ελθων εξαιφνης ευρη υμας καθευδοντας
kjv: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.

vulg: quod autem vobis dico omnibus dico vigilate
clem: Quod autem vobis dico, omnibus dico: Vigilate.
tr: α δε υμιν λεγω πασιν λεγω γρηγορειτε
kjv: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.

vulg: erat autem pascha et azyma post biduum et quaerebant summi sacerdotes et scribae quomodo eum dolo tenerent et occiderent
clem: Erat autem Pascha et azyma post biduum: et qurebant summi sacerdotes et scrib quomodo eum dolo tenerent, et occiderent.
tr: ην δε το πασχα και τα αζυμα μετα δυο ημερας και εζητουν οι αρχιερεις και οι γραμματεις πως αυτον εν δολω κρατησαντες αποκτεινωσιν
kjv: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.

vulg: dicebant enim non in die festo ne forte tumultus fieret populi
clem: Dicebant autem: Non in die festo, ne forte tumultus fieret in populo.
tr: ελεγον δε μη εν τη εορτη μηποτε θορυβος εσται του λαου
kjv: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.

vulg: et cum esset Bethaniae in domo Simonis leprosi et recumberet venit mulier habens alabastrum unguenti nardi spicati pretiosi et fracto alabastro effudit super caput eius
clem: Et cum esset Bethani in domo Simonis leprosi, et recumberet, venit mulier habens alabastrum unguenti nardi spicati pretiosi: et fracto alabastro, effudit super caput ejus.
tr: και οντος αυτου εν βηθανια εν τη οικια σιμωνος του λεπρου κατακειμενου αυτου ηλθεν γυνη εχουσα αλαβαστρον μυρου ναρδου πιστικης πολυτελους και συντριψασα το αλαβαστρον κατεχεεν αυτου κατα της κεφαλης
kjv: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.

vulg: erant autem quidam indigne ferentes intra semet ipsos et dicentes ut quid perditio ista unguenti facta est
clem: Erant autem quidam indigne ferentes intra semetipsos, et dicentes: Ut quid perditio ista unguenti facta est?
tr: ησαν δε τινες αγανακτουντες προς εαυτους και λεγοντες εις τι η απωλεια αυτη του μυρου γεγονεν
kjv: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?

vulg: poterat enim unguentum istud veniri plus quam trecentis denariis et dari pauperibus et fremebant in eam
clem: poterat enim unguentum istud venundari plus quam trecentis denariis, et dari pauperibus. Et fremebant in eam.
tr: ηδυνατο γαρ τουτο πραθηναι επανω τριακοσιων δηναριων και δοθηναι τοις πτωχοις και ενεβριμωντο αυτη
kjv: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.

vulg: Iesus autem dixit sinite eam quid illi molesti estis bonum opus operata est in me
clem: Jesus autem dixit: Sinite eam, quid illi molesti estis? Bonum opus operata est in me:
tr: ο δε ιησους ειπεν αφετε αυτην τι αυτη κοπους παρεχετε καλον εργον ειργασατο εις εμε
kjv: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.

vulg: semper enim pauperes habetis vobiscum et cum volueritis potestis illis benefacere me autem non semper habetis
clem: semper enim pauperes habetis vobiscum: et cum volueritis, potestis illis benefacere: me autem non semper habetis.
