tr: παντοτε γαρ τους πτωχους εχετε μεθ εαυτων και οταν θελητε δυνασθε αυτους ευ ποιησαι εμε δε ου παντοτε εχετε
kjv: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.

vulg: quod habuit haec fecit praevenit unguere corpus meum in sepulturam
clem: Quod habuit hc, fecit: prvenit ungere corpus meum in sepulturam.
tr: ο ειχεν αυτη εποιησεν προελαβεν μυρισαι μου το σωμα εις τον ενταφιασμον
kjv: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.

vulg: amen dico vobis ubicumque praedicatum fuerit evangelium istud in universum mundum et quod fecit haec narrabitur in memoriam eius
clem: Amen dico vobis: Ubicumque prdicatum fuerit Evangelium istud in universo mundo, et quod fecit hc, narrabitur in memoriam ejus.
tr: αμην λεγω υμιν οπου αν κηρυχθη το ευαγγελιον τουτο εις ολον τον κοσμον και ο εποιησεν αυτη λαληθησεται εις μνημοσυνον αυτης
kjv: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.

vulg: et Iudas Scariotis unus de duodecim abiit ad summos sacerdotes ut proderet eum illis
clem: Et Judas Iscariotes, unus de duodecim, abiit ad summos sacerdotes, ut proderet eum illis.
tr: και ο ιουδας ο ισκαριωτης εις των δωδεκα απηλθεν προς τους αρχιερεις ινα παραδω αυτον αυτοις
kjv: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.

vulg: qui audientes gavisi sunt et promiserunt ei pecuniam se daturos et quaerebat quomodo illum oportune traderet
clem: Qui audientes gavisi sunt: et promiserunt ei pecuniam se daturos. Et qurebat quomodo illum opportune traderet.
tr: οι δε ακουσαντες εχαρησαν και επηγγειλαντο αυτω αργυριον δουναι και εζητει πως ευκαιρως αυτον παραδω
kjv: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.

vulg: et primo die azymorum quando pascha immolabant dicunt ei discipuli quo vis eamus et paremus tibi ut manduces pascha
clem: Et primo die azymorum quando Pascha immolabant, dicunt ei discipuli: Quo vis eamus, et paremus tibi ut manduces Pascha?
tr: και τη πρωτη ημερα των αζυμων οτε το πασχα εθυον λεγουσιν αυτω οι μαθηται αυτου που θελεις απελθοντες ετοιμασωμεν ινα φαγης το πασχα
kjv: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?

vulg: et mittit duos ex discipulis suis et dicit eis ite in civitatem et occurret vobis homo laguenam aquae baiulans sequimini eum
clem: Et mittit duos ex discipulis suis, et dicit eis: Ite in civitatem, et occurret vobis homo lagenam aqu bajulans: sequimini eum,
tr: και αποστελλει δυο των μαθητων αυτου και λεγει αυτοις υπαγετε εις την πολιν και απαντησει υμιν ανθρωπος κεραμιον υδατος βασταζων ακολουθησατε αυτω
kjv: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.

vulg: et quocumque introierit dicite domino domus quia magister dicit ubi est refectio mea ubi pascha cum discipulis meis manducem
clem: et quocumque introierit, dicite domino domus, quia magister dicit: Ubi est refectio mea, ubi Pascha cum discipulis meis manducem?
tr: και οπου εαν εισελθη ειπατε τω οικοδεσποτη οτι ο διδασκαλος λεγει που εστιν το καταλυμα οπου το πασχα μετα των μαθητων μου φαγω
kjv: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

vulg: et ipse vobis demonstrabit cenaculum grande stratum et illic parate nobis
clem: Et ipse vobis demonstrabit cnaculum grande, stratum: et illic parate nobis.
tr: και αυτος υμιν δειξει ανωγεον μεγα εστρωμενον ετοιμον εκει ετοιμασατε ημιν
kjv: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.

vulg: et abierunt discipuli eius et venerunt in civitatem et invenerunt sicut dixerat illis et praeparaverunt pascha
clem: Et abierunt discipuli ejus, et venerunt in civitatem: et invenerunt sicut dixerat illis, et paraverunt Pascha.
tr: και εξηλθον οι μαθηται αυτου και ηλθον εις την πολιν και ευρον καθως ειπεν αυτοις και ητοιμασαν το πασχα
kjv: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

vulg: vespere autem facto venit cum duodecim
clem: Vespere autem facto, venit cum duodecim.
tr: και οψιας γενομενης ερχεται μετα των δωδεκα
kjv: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.

vulg: et discumbentibus eis et manducantibus ait Iesus amen dico vobis quia unus ex vobis me tradet qui manducat mecum
clem: Et discumbentibus eis, et manducantibus, ait Jesus: Amen dico vobis, quia unus ex vobis tradet me, qui manducat mecum.
tr: και ανακειμενων αυτων και εσθιοντων ειπεν ο ιησους αμην λεγω υμιν οτι εις εξ υμων παραδωσει με ο εσθιων μετ εμου
kjv: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.

vulg: at illi coeperunt contristari et dicere ei singillatim numquid ego
clem: At illi cperunt contristari, et dicere ei singulatim: Numquid ego?
tr: οι δε ηρξαντο λυπεισθαι και λεγειν αυτω εις καθ εις μητι εγω και αλλος μητι εγω
kjv: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?

vulg: qui ait illis unus ex duodecim qui intinguit mecum in catino
clem: Qui ait illis: Unus ex duodecim, qui intingit mecum manum in catino.
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν αυτοις εις εκ των δωδεκα ο εμβαπτομενος μετ εμου εις το τρυβλιον
kjv: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.

vulg: et Filius quidem hominis vadit sicut scriptum est de eo vae autem homini illi per quem Filius hominis traditur bonum ei si non esset natus homo ille
clem: Et Filius quidem hominis vadit sicut scriptum est de eo: v autem homini illi per quem Filius hominis tradetur! bonum erat ei, si non esset natus homo ille.
tr: ο μεν υιος του ανθρωπου υπαγει καθως γεγραπται περι αυτου ουαι δε τω ανθρωπω εκεινω δι ου ο υιος του ανθρωπου παραδιδοται καλον ην αυτω ει ουκ εγεννηθη ο ανθρωπος εκεινος
kjv: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.

vulg: et manducantibus illis accepit Iesus panem et benedicens fregit et dedit eis et ait sumite hoc est corpus meum
clem: Et manducantibus illis, accepit Jesus panem: et benedicens fregit, et dedit eis, et ait: Sumite, hoc est corpus meum.
tr: και εσθιοντων αυτων λαβων ο ιησους αρτον ευλογησας εκλασεν και εδωκεν αυτοις και ειπεν λαβετε φαγετε τουτο εστιν το σωμα μου
kjv: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.

vulg: et accepto calice gratias agens dedit eis et biberunt ex illo omnes
clem: Et accepto calice, gratias agens dedit eis: et biberunt ex illo omnes.
tr: και λαβων το ποτηριον ευχαριστησας εδωκεν αυτοις και επιον εξ αυτου παντες
kjv: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.

vulg: et ait illis hic est sanguis meus novi testamenti qui pro multis effunditur
clem: Et ait illis: Hic est sanguis meus novi testamenti, qui pro multis effundetur.
tr: και ειπεν αυτοις τουτο εστιν το αιμα μου το της καινης διαθηκης το περι πολλων εκχυνομενον
kjv: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.

vulg: amen dico vobis quod iam non bibam de genimine vitis usque in diem illum cum illud bibam novum in regno Dei
clem: Amen dico vobis, quia jam non bibam de hoc genimine vitis usque in diem illum, cum illud bibam novum in regno Dei.
tr: αμην λεγω υμιν οτι ουκετι ου μη πιω εκ του γεννηματος της αμπελου εως της ημερας εκεινης οταν αυτο πινω καινον εν τη βασιλεια του θεου
kjv: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.

vulg: et hymno dicto exierunt in montem Olivarum
clem: Et hymno dicto exierunt in montem Olivarum.
tr: και υμνησαντες εξηλθον εις το ορος των ελαιων
kjv: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.

vulg: et ait eis Iesus omnes scandalizabimini in nocte ista quia scriptum est percutiam pastorem et dispergentur oves
clem: Et ait eis Jesus: Omnes scandalizabimini in me in nocte ista: quia scriptum est: Percutiam pastorem, et dispergentur oves.
tr: και λεγει αυτοις ο ιησους οτι παντες σκανδαλισθησεσθε εν εμοι εν τη νυκτι ταυτη οτι γεγραπται παταξω τον ποιμενα και διασκορπισθησεται τα προβατα
kjv: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.

vulg: sed posteaquam resurrexero praecedam vos in Galilaeam
clem: Sed postquam resurrexero, prcedam vos in Galilam.
tr: αλλα μετα το εγερθηναι με προαξω υμας εις την γαλιλαιαν
kjv: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.

vulg: Petrus autem ait ei et si omnes scandalizati fuerint sed non ego
clem: Petrus autem ait illi: Et si omnes scandalizati fuerint in te, sed non ego.
tr: ο δε πετρος εφη αυτω και ει παντες σκανδαλισθησονται αλλ ουκ εγω
kjv: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.

vulg: et ait illi Iesus amen dico tibi quia tu hodie in nocte hac priusquam bis gallus vocem dederit ter me es negaturus
clem: Et ait illi Jesus: Amen dico tibi, quia tu hodie in nocte hac, priusquam gallus vocem bis dederit, ter me es negaturus.
tr: και λεγει αυτω ο ιησους αμην λεγω σοι οτι σημερον εν τη νυκτι ταυτη πριν η δις αλεκτορα φωνησαι τρις απαρνηση με
kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.

vulg: at ille amplius loquebatur et si oportuerit me simul conmori tibi non te negabo similiter autem et omnes dicebant
clem: At ille amplius loquebatur: Et si oportuerit me simul commori tibi, non te negabo. Similiter autem et omnes dicebant.
tr: ο δε εκ περισσου ελεγεν μαλλον εαν με δεη συναποθανειν σοι ου μη σε απαρνησομαι ωσαυτως δε και παντες ελεγον
kjv: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.

vulg: et veniunt in praedium cui nomen Gethsemani et ait discipulis suis sedete hic donec orem
clem: Et veniunt in prdium, cui nomen Gethsemani. Et ait discipulis suis: Sedete hic donec orem.
tr: και ερχονται εις χωριον ου το ονομα γεθσημανη και λεγει τοις μαθηταις αυτου καθισατε ωδε εως προσευξωμαι
kjv: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.

vulg: et adsumit Petrum et Iacobum et Iohannem secum et coepit pavere et taedere
clem: Et assumit Petrum, et Jacobum, et Joannem secum: et cpit pavere et tdere.
tr: και παραλαμβανει τον πετρον και τον ιακωβον και ιωαννην μεθ εαυτου και ηρξατο εκθαμβεισθαι και αδημονειν
kjv: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;

vulg: et ait illis tristis est anima mea usque ad mortem sustinete hic et vigilate
clem: Et ait illis: Tristis est anima mea usque ad mortem: sustinete hic, et vigilate.
tr: και λεγει αυτοις περιλυπος εστιν η ψυχη μου εως θανατου μεινατε ωδε και γρηγορειτε
kjv: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.

vulg: et cum processisset paululum procidit super terram et orabat ut si fieri posset transiret ab eo hora
clem: Et cum processisset paululum, procidit super terram: et orabat ut, si fieri posset, transiret ab eo hora:
tr: και προελθων μικρον επεσεν επι της γης και προσηυχετο ινα ει δυνατον εστιν παρελθη απ αυτου η ωρα
kjv: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.

vulg: et dixit Abba Pater omnia possibilia tibi sunt transfer calicem hunc a me sed non quod ego volo sed quod tu
clem: et dixit: Abba pater, omnia tibi possibilia sunt, transfer calicem hunc a me: sed non quod ego volo, sed quod tu.
tr: και ελεγεν αββα ο πατηρ παντα δυνατα σοι παρενεγκε το ποτηριον απ εμου τουτο αλλ ου τι εγω θελω αλλα τι συ
kjv: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.

vulg: et venit et invenit eos dormientes et ait Petro Simon dormis non potuisti una hora vigilare
clem: Et venit, et invenit eos dormientes. Et ait Petro: Simon, dormis? non potuisti una hora vigilare?
tr: και ερχεται και ευρισκει αυτους καθευδοντας και λεγει τω πετρω σιμων καθευδεις ουκ ισχυσας μιαν ωραν γρηγορησαι
kjv: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?

vulg: vigilate et orate ut non intretis in temptationem spiritus quidem promptus caro vero infirma
clem: Vigilate et orate, ut non intretis in tentationem. Spiritus quidem promptus est, caro vero infirma.
tr: γρηγορειτε και προσευχεσθε ινα μη εισελθητε εις πειρασμον το μεν πνευμα προθυμον η δε σαρξ ασθενης
kjv: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.

vulg: et iterum abiens oravit eundem sermonem dicens
clem: Et iterum abiens oravit, eumdem sermonem dicens.
tr: και παλιν απελθων προσηυξατο τον αυτον λογον ειπων
kjv: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.

vulg: et reversus denuo invenit eos dormientes erant enim oculi illorum ingravati et ignorabant quid responderent ei
clem: Et reversus, denuo invenit eos dormientes (erant enim oculi eorum gravati), et ignorabant quid responderent ei.
tr: και υποστρεψας ευρεν αυτους παλιν καθευδοντας ησαν γαρ οι οφθαλμοι αυτων βεβαρημενοι και ουκ ηδεισαν τι αυτω αποκριθωσιν
kjv: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.

vulg: et venit tertio et ait illis dormite iam et requiescite sufficit venit hora ecce traditur Filius hominis in manus peccatorum
clem: Et venit tertio, et ait illis: Dormite jam, et requiescite. Sufficit: venit hora: ecce Filius hominis tradetur in manus peccatorum.
tr: και ερχεται το τριτον και λεγει αυτοις καθευδετε  το λοιπον και αναπαυεσθε  απεχει ηλθεν η ωρα ιδου παραδιδοται ο υιος του ανθρωπου εις τας χειρας των αμαρτωλων
kjv: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

vulg: surgite eamus ecce qui me tradit prope est
clem: Surgite, eamus: ecce qui me tradet, prope est.
tr: εγειρεσθε αγωμεν ιδου ο παραδιδους με ηγγικεν
kjv: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.

vulg: et adhuc eo loquente venit Iudas Scarioth unus ex duodecim et cum illo turba cum gladiis et lignis a summis sacerdotibus et a scribis et a senioribus
clem: Et, adhuc eo loquente, venit Judas Iscariotes unus de duodecim, et cum eo turba multa cum gladiis et lignis, a summis sacerdotibus, et scribis, et senioribus.
tr: και ευθεως ετι αυτου λαλουντος παραγινεται ιουδας εις ων των δωδεκα και μετ αυτου οχλος πολυς μετα μαχαιρων και ξυλων παρα των αρχιερεων και των γραμματεων και των πρεσβυτερων
kjv: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.

vulg: dederat autem traditor eius signum eis dicens quemcumque osculatus fuero ipse est tenete eum et ducite
clem: Dederat autem traditor ejus signum eis, dicens: Quemcumque osculatus fuero, ipse est, tenete eum, et ducite caute.
tr: δεδωκει δε ο παραδιδους αυτον συσσημον αυτοις λεγων ον αν φιλησω αυτος εστιν κρατησατε αυτον και απαγαγετε ασφαλως
kjv: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.

vulg: et cum venisset statim accedens ad eum ait rabbi et osculatus est eum
clem: Et cum venisset, statim accedens ad eum, ait: Ave Rabbi: et osculatus est eum.
tr: και ελθων ευθεως προσελθων αυτω λεγει ραββι ραββι και κατεφιλησεν αυτον
kjv: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.

vulg: at illi manus iniecerunt in eum et tenuerunt eum
clem: At illi manus injecerunt in eum, et tenuerunt eum.
tr: οι δε επεβαλον επ αυτον τας χειρας αυτων και εκρατησαν αυτον
kjv: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.

vulg: unus autem quidam de circumstantibus educens gladium percussit servum summi sacerdotis et amputavit illi auriculam
clem: Unus autem quidam de circumstantibus educens gladium, percussit servum summi sacerdotis: et amputavit illi auriculam.
tr: εις δε τις των παρεστηκοτων σπασαμενος την μαχαιραν επαισεν τον δουλον του αρχιερεως και αφειλεν αυτου το ωτιον
kjv: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

vulg: et respondens Iesus ait illis tamquam ad latronem existis cum gladiis et lignis conprehendere me
clem: Et respondens Jesus, ait illis: Tamquam ad latronem existis cum gladiis et lignis comprehendere me?
tr: και αποκριθεις ο ιησους ειπεν αυτοις ως επι ληστην εξηλθετε μετα μαχαιρων και ξυλων συλλαβειν με
kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?

vulg: cotidie eram apud vos in templo docens et non me tenuistis sed ut adimpleantur scripturae
clem: quotidie eram apud vos in templo docens, et non me tenuistis. Sed ut impleantur Scriptur.
tr: καθ ημεραν ημην προς υμας εν τω ιερω διδασκων και ουκ εκρατησατε με αλλ ινα πληρωθωσιν αι γραφαι
kjv: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.

vulg: tunc discipuli eius relinquentes eum omnes fugerunt
clem: Tunc discipuli ejus relinquentes eum, omnes fugerunt.
tr: και αφεντες αυτον παντες εφυγον
kjv: And they all forsook him, and fled.

vulg: adulescens autem quidam sequebatur illum amictus sindone super nudo et tenuerunt eum
clem: Adolescens autem quidam sequebatur eum amictus sindone super nudo: et tenuerunt eum.
tr: και εις τις νεανισκος ηκολουθει αυτω περιβεβλημενος σινδονα επι γυμνου και κρατουσιν αυτον οι νεανισκοι
kjv: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:

vulg: at ille reiecta sindone nudus profugit ab eis
clem: At ille rejecta sindone, nudus profugit ab eis.
tr: ο δε καταλιπων την σινδονα γυμνος εφυγεν απ αυτων
kjv: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.

vulg: et adduxerunt Iesum ad summum sacerdotem et conveniunt omnes sacerdotes et scribae et seniores
clem: Et adduxerunt Jesum ad summum sacerdotem: et convenerunt omnes sacerdotes, et scrib, et seniores.
tr: και απηγαγον τον ιησουν προς τον αρχιερεα και συνερχονται αυτω παντες οι αρχιερεις και οι πρεσβυτεροι και οι γραμματεις
kjv: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.

vulg: Petrus autem a longe secutus est eum usque intro in atrium summi sacerdotis et sedebat cum ministris et calefaciebat se ad ignem
clem: Petrus autem a longe secutus est eum usque intro in atrium summi sacerdotis: et sedebat cum ministris ad ignem, et calefaciebat se.
tr: και ο πετρος απο μακροθεν ηκολουθησεν αυτω εως εσω εις την αυλην του αρχιερεως και ην συγκαθημενος μετα των υπηρετων και θερμαινομενος προς το φως
kjv: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.

vulg: summi vero sacerdotes et omne concilium quaerebant adversum Iesum testimonium ut eum morti traderent nec inveniebant
clem: Summi vero sacerdotes et omne concilium qurebant adversus Jesum testimonium, ut eum morti traderent, nec inveniebant.
tr: οι δε αρχιερεις και ολον το συνεδριον εζητουν κατα του ιησου μαρτυριαν εις το θανατωσαι αυτον και ουχ ευρισκον
kjv: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.

vulg: multi enim testimonium falsum dicebant adversus eum et convenientia testimonia non erant
clem: Multi enim testimonium falsum dicebant adversus eum: et convenientia testimonia non erant.
tr: πολλοι γαρ εψευδομαρτυρουν κατ αυτου και ισαι αι μαρτυριαι ουκ ησαν
kjv: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.

vulg: et quidam surgentes falsum testimonium ferebant adversus eum dicentes
clem: Et quidam surgentes, falsum testimonium ferebant adversus eum, dicentes:
tr: και τινες ανασταντες εψευδομαρτυρουν κατ αυτου λεγοντες
kjv: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,

vulg: quoniam nos audivimus eum dicentem ego dissolvam templum hoc manufactum et per triduum aliud non manufactum aedificabo
clem: Quoniam nos audivimus eum dicentem: Ego dissolvam templum hoc manu factum, et per triduum aliud non manu factum dificabo.
tr: οτι ημεις ηκουσαμεν αυτου λεγοντος οτι εγω καταλυσω τον ναον τουτον τον χειροποιητον και δια τριων ημερων αλλον αχειροποιητον οικοδομησω
kjv: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.

vulg: et non erat conveniens testimonium illorum
clem: Et non erat conveniens testimonium illorum.
tr: και ουδε ουτως ιση ην η μαρτυρια αυτων
kjv: But neither so did their witness agree together.

vulg: et exsurgens summus sacerdos in medium interrogavit Iesum dicens non respondes quicquam ad ea quae tibi obiciuntur ab his
clem: Et exsurgens summus sacerdos in medium, interrogavit Jesum, dicens: Non respondes quidquam ad ea qu tibi objiciuntur ab his?
tr: και αναστας ο αρχιερευς εις το μεσον επηρωτησεν τον ιησουν λεγων ουκ αποκρινη ουδεν τι ουτοι σου καταμαρτυρουσιν
kjv: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?

vulg: ille autem tacebat et nihil respondit rursum summus sacerdos interrogabat eum et dicit ei tu es Christus Filius Benedicti
clem: Ille autem tacebat, et nihil respondit. Rursum summus sacerdos interrogabat eum, et dixit ei: Tu es Christus Filius Dei benedicti?
tr: ο δε εσιωπα και ουδεν απεκρινατο παλιν ο αρχιερευς επηρωτα αυτον και λεγει αυτω συ ει ο χριστος ο υιος του ευλογητου
kjv: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?

vulg: Iesus autem dixit illi ego sum et videbitis Filium hominis a dextris sedentem Virtutis et venientem cum nubibus caeli
clem: Jesus autem dixit illi: Ego sum: et videbitis Filium hominis sedentem a dextris virtutis Dei, et venientem cum nubibus cli.
tr: ο δε ιησους ειπεν εγω ειμι και οψεσθε τον υιον του ανθρωπου καθημενον εκ δεξιων της δυναμεως και ερχομενον μετα των νεφελων του ουρανου
kjv: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

vulg: summus autem sacerdos scindens vestimenta sua ait quid adhuc desideramus testes
clem: Summus autem sacerdos scindens vestimenta sua, ait: Quid adhuc desideramus testes?
tr: ο δε αρχιερευς διαρρηξας τους χιτωνας αυτου λεγει τι ετι χρειαν εχομεν μαρτυρων
kjv: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?

vulg: audistis blasphemiam quid vobis videtur qui omnes condemnaverunt eum esse reum mortis
clem: Audistis blasphemiam: quid vobis videtur? Qui omnes condemnaverunt eum esse reum mortis.
tr: ηκουσατε της βλασφημιας τι υμιν φαινεται οι δε παντες κατεκριναν αυτον ειναι ενοχον θανατου
kjv: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.

vulg: et coeperunt quidam conspuere eum et velare faciem eius et colaphis eum caedere et dicere ei prophetiza et ministri alapis eum caedebant
clem: Et cperunt quidam conspuere eum, et velare faciem ejus, et colaphis eum cdere, et dicere ei: Prophetiza: et ministri alapis eum cdebant.
tr: και ηρξαντο τινες εμπτυειν αυτω και περικαλυπτειν το προσωπον αυτου και κολαφιζειν αυτον και λεγειν αυτω προφητευσον και οι υπηρεται ραπισμασιν αυτον εβαλλον
kjv: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.

vulg: et cum esset Petrus in atrio deorsum venit una ex ancillis summi sacerdotis
clem: Et cum esset Petrus in atrio deorsum, venit una ex ancillis summi sacerdotis:
tr: και οντος του πετρου εν τη αυλη κατω ερχεται μια των παιδισκων του αρχιερεως
kjv: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:

vulg: et cum vidisset Petrum calefacientem se aspiciens illum ait et tu cum Iesu Nazareno eras
clem: et cum vidisset Petrum calefacientem se, aspiciens illum, ait: Et tu cum Jesu Nazareno eras.
tr: και ιδουσα τον πετρον θερμαινομενον εμβλεψασα αυτω λεγει και συ μετα του ναζαρηνου ιησου ησθα
kjv: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.

vulg: at ille negavit dicens neque scio neque novi quid dicas et exiit foras ante atrium et gallus cantavit
clem: At ille negavit, dicens: Neque scio, neque novi quid dicas. Et exiit foras ante atrium, et gallus cantavit.
tr: ο δε ηρνησατο λεγων ουκ οιδα ουδε επισταμαι τι συ λεγεις και εξηλθεν εξω εις το προαυλιον και αλεκτωρ εφωνησεν
kjv: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.

vulg: rursus autem cum vidisset illum ancilla coepit dicere circumstantibus quia hic ex illis est
clem: Rursus autem cum vidisset illum ancilla, cpit dicere circumstantibus: Quia hic ex illis est.
tr: και η παιδισκη ιδουσα αυτον παλιν ηρξατο λεγειν τοις παρεστηκοσιν οτι ουτος εξ αυτων εστιν
kjv: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.

vulg: at ille iterum negavit et post pusillum rursus qui adstabant dicebant Petro vere ex illis es nam et Galilaeus es
clem: At ille iterum negavit. Et post pusillum rursus qui astabant, dicebant Petro: Vere ex illis es: nam et Galilus es.
tr: ο δε παλιν ηρνειτο και μετα μικρον παλιν οι παρεστωτες ελεγον τω πετρω αληθως εξ αυτων ει και γαρ γαλιλαιος ει και η λαλια σου ομοιαζει
kjv: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.

vulg: ille autem coepit anathematizare et iurare quia nescio hominem istum quem dicitis
clem: Ille autem cpit anathematizare et jurare: Quia nescio hominem istum, quem dicitis.
tr: ο δε ηρξατο αναθεματιζειν και ομνυειν οτι ουκ οιδα τον ανθρωπον τουτον ον λεγετε
kjv: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.

vulg: et statim iterum gallus cantavit et recordatus est Petrus verbi quod dixerat ei Iesus priusquam gallus cantet bis ter me negabis et coepit flere
clem: Et statim gallus iterum cantavit. Et recordatus est Petrus verbi, quod dixerat ei Jesus: Priusquam gallus cantet bis, ter me negabis. Et cpit flere.
tr: και εκ δευτερου αλεκτωρ εφωνησεν και ανεμνησθη ο πετρος του ρηματος ου ειπεν αυτω ο ιησους οτι πριν αλεκτορα φωνησαι δις απαρνηση με τρις και επιβαλων εκλαιεν
kjv: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.

vulg: et confestim mane consilium facientes summi sacerdotes cum senioribus et scribis et universo concilio vincientes Iesum duxerunt et tradiderunt Pilato
clem: Et confestim, mane consilium facientes summi sacerdotes cum senioribus, et scribis, et universo concilio, vincientes Jesum, duxerunt, et tradiderunt Pilato.
tr: και ευθεως επι το πρωι συμβουλιον ποιησαντες οι αρχιερεις μετα των πρεσβυτερων και γραμματεων και ολον το συνεδριον δησαντες τον ιησουν απηνεγκαν και παρεδωκαν τω πιλατω
kjv: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.

vulg: et interrogavit eum Pilatus tu es rex Iudaeorum at ille respondens ait illi tu dicis
clem: Et interrogavit eum Pilatus: Tu es rex Judorum? At ille respondens, ait illi: Tu dicis.
tr: και επηρωτησεν αυτον ο πιλατος συ ει ο βασιλευς των ιουδαιων ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν αυτω συ λεγεις
kjv: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto them, Thou sayest it.

vulg: et accusabant eum summi sacerdotes in multis
clem: Et accusabant eum summi sacerdotes in multis.
tr: και κατηγορουν αυτου οι αρχιερεις πολλα  αυτος δε ουδεν απεκρινατο
kjv: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.

vulg: Pilatus autem rursum interrogavit eum dicens non respondes quicquam vide in quantis te accusant
clem: Pilatus autem rursum interrogavit eum, dicens: Non respondes quidquam? vide in quantis te accusant.
tr: ο δε πιλατος παλιν επηρωτησεν αυτον λεγων ουκ αποκρινη ουδεν ιδε ποσα σου καταμαρτυρουσιν
kjv: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.

vulg: Iesus autem amplius nihil respondit ita ut miraretur Pilatus
clem: Jesus autem amplius nihil respondit, ita ut miraretur Pilatus.
tr: ο δε ιησους ουκετι ουδεν απεκριθη ωστε θαυμαζειν τον πιλατον
kjv: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.

vulg: per diem autem festum dimittere solebat illis unum ex vinctis quemcumque petissent
clem: Per diem autem festum solebat dimittere illis unum ex vinctis, quemcumque petissent.
tr: κατα δε εορτην απελυεν αυτοις ενα δεσμιον ονπερ ητουντο
kjv: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.

vulg: erat autem qui dicebatur Barabbas qui cum seditiosis erat vinctus qui in seditione fecerant homicidium
clem: Erat autem qui dicebatur Barrabas, qui cum seditiosis erat vinctus, qui in seditione fecerat homicidium.
tr: ην δε ο λεγομενος βαραββας μετα των συστασιαστων δεδεμενος οιτινες εν τη στασει φονον πεποιηκεισαν
kjv: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.

vulg: et cum ascendisset turba coepit rogare sicut semper faciebat illis
clem: Et cum ascendisset turba, cpit rogare, sicut semper faciebat illis.
tr: και αναβοησας ο οχλος ηρξατο αιτεισθαι καθως αει εποιει αυτοις
kjv: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.

vulg: Pilatus autem respondit eis et dixit vultis dimittam vobis regem Iudaeorum
clem: Pilatus autem respondit eis, et dixit: Vultis dimittam vobis regem Judorum?
tr: ο δε πιλατος απεκριθη αυτοις λεγων θελετε απολυσω υμιν τον βασιλεα των ιουδαιων
kjv: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

vulg: sciebat enim quod per invidiam tradidissent eum summi sacerdotes
clem: Sciebat enim quod per invidiam tradidissent eum summi sacerdotes.
tr: εγινωσκεν γαρ οτι δια φθονον παραδεδωκεισαν αυτον οι αρχιερεις
kjv: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.

vulg: pontifices autem concitaverunt turbam ut magis Barabban dimitteret eis
clem: Pontifices autem concitaverunt turbam, ut magis Barabbam dimitteret eis.
tr: οι δε αρχιερεις ανεσεισαν τον οχλον ινα μαλλον τον βαραββαν απολυση αυτοις
kjv: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.

vulg: Pilatus autem iterum respondens ait illis quid ergo vultis faciam regi Iudaeorum
clem: Pilatus autem iterum respondens, ait illis: Quid ergo vultis faciam regi Judorum?
tr: ο δε πιλατος αποκριθεις παλιν ειπεν αυτοις τι ουν θελετε ποιησω ον λεγετε βασιλεα των ιουδαιων
kjv: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?

vulg: at illi iterum clamaverunt crucifige eum
clem: At illi iterum clamaverunt: Crucifige eum.
tr: οι δε παλιν εκραξαν σταυρωσον αυτον
kjv: And they cried out again, Crucify him.

vulg: Pilatus vero dicebat eis quid enim mali fecit at illi magis clamabant crucifige eum
clem: Pilatus vero dicebat illis: Quid enim mali fecit? At illi magis clamabant: Crucifige eum.
tr: ο δε πιλατος ελεγεν αυτοις τι γαρ κακον εποιησεν οι δε περισσοτερως εκραξαν σταυρωσον αυτον
kjv: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.

vulg: Pilatus autem volens populo satisfacere dimisit illis Barabban et tradidit Iesum flagellis caesum ut crucifigeretur
clem: Pilatus autem volens populo satisfacere, dimisit illis Barabbam, et tradidit Jesum flagellis csum, ut crucifigeretur.
tr: ο δε πιλατος βουλομενος τω οχλω το ικανον ποιησαι απελυσεν αυτοις τον βαραββαν και παρεδωκεν τον ιησουν φραγελλωσας ινα σταυρωθη
kjv: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.

vulg: milites autem duxerunt eum intro in atrium praetorii et convocant totam cohortem
clem: Milites autem duxerunt eum in atrium prtorii, et convocant totam cohortem,
tr: οι δε στρατιωται απηγαγον αυτον εσω της αυλης ο εστιν πραιτωριον και συγκαλουσιν ολην την σπειραν
kjv: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.

vulg: et induunt eum purpuram et inponunt ei plectentes spineam coronam
clem: et induunt eum purpura, et imponunt ei plectentes spineam coronam.
tr: και ενδυουσιν αυτον πορφυραν και περιτιθεασιν αυτω πλεξαντες ακανθινον στεφανον
kjv: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head,

vulg: et coeperunt salutare eum have rex Iudaeorum
clem: Et cperunt salutare eum: Ave rex Judorum.
tr: και ηρξαντο ασπαζεσθαι αυτον χαιρε βασιλευ των ιουδαιων
kjv: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!

vulg: et percutiebant caput eius harundine et conspuebant eum et ponentes genua adorabant eum
clem: Et percutiebant caput ejus arundine: et conspuebant eum, et ponentes genua, adorabant eum.
tr: και ετυπτον αυτου την κεφαλην καλαμω και ενεπτυον αυτω και τιθεντες τα γονατα προσεκυνουν αυτω
kjv: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.

vulg: et postquam inluserunt ei exuerunt illum purpuram et induerunt eum vestimentis suis et educunt illum ut crucifigerent eum
clem: Et postquam illuserunt ei, exuerunt illum purpura, et induerunt eum vestimentis suis: et educunt illum ut crucifigerent eum.
tr: και οτε ενεπαιξαν αυτω εξεδυσαν αυτον την πορφυραν και ενεδυσαν αυτον τα ιματια τα ιδια και εξαγουσιν αυτον ινα σταυρωσωσιν αυτον
kjv: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.

vulg: et angariaverunt praetereuntem quempiam Simonem Cyreneum venientem de villa patrem Alexandri et Rufi ut tolleret crucem eius
clem: Et angariaverunt prtereuntem quempiam, Simonem Cyrenum venientem de villa, patrem Alexandri et Rufi, ut tolleret crucem ejus.
tr: και αγγαρευουσιν παραγοντα τινα σιμωνα κυρηναιον ερχομενον απ αγρου τον πατερα αλεξανδρου και ρουφου ινα αρη τον σταυρον αυτου
kjv: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.

vulg: et perducunt illum in Golgotha locum quod est interpretatum Calvariae locus
clem: Et perducunt illum in Golgotha locum: quod est interpretatum Calvari locus.
tr: και φερουσιν αυτον επι γολγοθα τοπον ο εστιν μεθερμηνευομενον κρανιου τοπος
kjv: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.

vulg: et dabant ei bibere murratum vinum et non accepit
clem: Et dabant ei bibere myrrhatum vinum: et non accepit.
tr: και εδιδουν αυτω πιειν εσμυρνισμενον οινον ο δε ουκ ελαβεν
kjv: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.

vulg: et crucifigentes eum diviserunt vestimenta eius mittentes sortem super eis quis quid tolleret
clem: Et crucifigentes eum, diviserunt vestimenta ejus, mittentes sortem super eis, quis quid tolleret.
tr: και σταυρωσαντες αυτον διεμεριζον τα ιματια αυτου βαλλοντες κληρον επ αυτα τις τι αρη
kjv: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.

vulg: erat autem hora tertia et crucifixerunt eum
clem: Erat autem hora tertia: et crucifixerunt eum.
tr: ην δε ωρα τριτη και εσταυρωσαν αυτον
kjv: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.

vulg: et erat titulus causae eius inscriptus rex Iudaeorum
clem: Et erat titulus caus ejus inscriptus: Rex Judorum.
tr: και ην η επιγραφη της αιτιας αυτου επιγεγραμμενη ο βασιλευς των ιουδαιων
kjv: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, The King Of The Jews.

vulg: et cum eo crucifigunt duos latrones unum a dextris et alium a sinistris eius
clem: Et cum eo crucifigunt duos latrones: unum a dextris, et alium a sinistris ejus.
tr: και συν αυτω σταυρουσιν δυο ληστας ενα εκ δεξιων και ενα εξ ευωνυμων αυτου
kjv: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.

vulg: et adimpleta est scriptura quae dicit et cum iniquis reputatus est
clem: Et impleta est Scriptura, qu dicit: Et cum iniquis reputatus est.
tr: και επληρωθη η γραφη η λεγουσα και μετα ανομων ελογισθη
kjv: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.

vulg: et praetereuntes blasphemabant eum moventes capita sua et dicentes va qui destruit templum et in tribus diebus aedificat
clem: Et prtereuntes blasphemabant eum, moventes capita sua, et dicentes: Vah qui destruis templum Dei, et in tribus diebus redificas:
tr: και οι παραπορευομενοι εβλασφημουν αυτον κινουντες τας κεφαλας αυτων και λεγοντες ουα ο καταλυων τον ναον και εν τρισιν ημεραις οικοδομων
kjv: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,

vulg: salvum fac temet ipsum descendens de cruce
clem: salvum fac temetipsum descendens de cruce.
tr: σωσον σεαυτον και καταβα απο του σταυρου
kjv: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.

vulg: similiter et summi sacerdotes ludentes ad alterutrum cum scribis dicebant alios salvos fecit se ipsum non potest salvum facere
clem: Similiter et summi sacerdotes illudentes, ad alterutrum cum scribis dicebant: Alios salvos fecit, seipsum non potest salvum facere.
tr: ομοιως δε και οι αρχιερεις εμπαιζοντες προς αλληλους μετα των γραμματεων ελεγον αλλους εσωσεν εαυτον ου δυναται σωσαι
kjv: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.

vulg: Christus rex Israhel descendat nunc de cruce ut videamus et credamus et qui cum eo crucifixi erant conviciabantur ei
clem: Christus rex Isral descendat nunc de cruce, ut videamus, et credamus. Et qui cum eo crucifixi erant, convitiabantur ei.
tr: ο χριστος ο βασιλευς του ισραηλ καταβατω νυν απο του σταυρου ινα ιδωμεν και πιστευσωμεν και οι συνεσταυρωμενοι αυτω ωνειδιζον αυτον
kjv: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.

vulg: et facta hora sexta tenebrae factae sunt per totam terram usque in horam nonam
clem: Et facta hora sexta, tenebr fact sunt per totam terram usque in horam nonam.
tr: γενομενης δε ωρας εκτης σκοτος εγενετο εφ ολην την γην εως ωρας εννατης
kjv: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

vulg: et hora nona exclamavit Iesus voce magna dicens Heloi Heloi lama sabacthani quod est interpretatum Deus meus Deus meus ut quid dereliquisti me
clem: Et hora nona exclamavit Jesus voce magna, dicens: Eloi, eloi, lamma sabacthani? quod est interpretatum: Deus meus, Deus meus, ut quid dereliquisti me?
tr: και τη ωρα τη εννατη εβοησεν ο ιησους φωνη μεγαλη λεγων ελωι ελωι λαμμα σαβαχθανι ο εστιν μεθερμηνευομενον ο θεος μου ο θεος μου εις τι με εγκατελιπες
kjv: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

vulg: et quidam de circumstantibus audientes dicebant ecce Heliam vocat
clem: Et quidam de circumstantibus audientes, dicebant: Ecce Eliam vocat.
tr: και τινες των παρεστηκοτων ακουσαντες ελεγον ιδου ηλιαν φωνει
kjv: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.

vulg: currens autem unus et implens spongiam aceto circumponensque calamo potum dabat ei dicens sinite videamus si veniat Helias ad deponendum eum
clem: Currens autem unus, et implens spongiam aceto, circumponensque calamo, potum dabat ei, dicens: Sinite, videamus si veniat Elias ad deponendum eum.
tr: δραμων δε εις και γεμισας σπογγον οξους περιθεις τε καλαμω εποτιζεν αυτον λεγων αφετε ιδωμεν ει ερχεται ηλιας καθελειν αυτον
kjv: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.

vulg: Iesus autem emissa voce magna exspiravit
clem: Jesus autem emissa voce magna expiravit.
tr: ο δε ιησους αφεις φωνην μεγαλην εξεπνευσεν
kjv: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.

vulg: et velum templi scissum est in duo a sursum usque deorsum
clem: Et velum templi scissum est in duo, a summo usque deorsum.
tr: και το καταπετασμα του ναου εσχισθη εις δυο απο ανωθεν εως κατω
kjv: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.

vulg: videns autem centurio qui ex adverso stabat quia sic clamans exspirasset ait vere homo hic Filius Dei erat
clem: Videns autem centurio, qui ex adverso stabat, quia sic clamans expirasset, ait: Vere hic homo Filius Dei erat.
tr: ιδων δε ο κεντυριων ο παρεστηκως εξ εναντιας αυτου οτι ουτως κραξας εξεπνευσεν ειπεν αληθως ο ανθρωπος ουτος υιος ην θεου
kjv: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.

vulg: erant autem et mulieres de longe aspicientes inter quas et Maria Magdalene et Maria Iacobi minoris et Ioseph mater et Salome
clem: Erant autem et mulieres de longe aspicientes: inter quas erat Maria Magdalene, et Maria Jacobi minoris, et Joseph mater, et Salome:
tr: ησαν δε και γυναικες απο μακροθεν θεωρουσαι εν αις ην και μαρια η μαγδαληνη και μαρια η του ιακωβου του μικρου και ιωση μητηρ και σαλωμη
kjv: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

vulg: et cum esset in Galilaea sequebantur eum et ministrabant ei et aliae multae quae simul cum eo ascenderant Hierosolyma
clem: et cum esset in Galila, sequebantur eum, et ministrabant ei, et ali mult, qu simul cum eo ascenderant Jerosolymam.
tr: αι και οτε ην εν τη γαλιλαια ηκολουθουν αυτω και διηκονουν αυτω και αλλαι πολλαι αι συναναβασαι αυτω εις ιεροσολυμα
kjv: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.

vulg: et cum iam sero esset factum quia erat parasceve quod est ante sabbatum
clem: Et cum jam sero esset factum (quia erat parasceve, quod est ante sabbatum),
tr: και ηδη οψιας γενομενης επει ην παρασκευη ο εστιν προσαββατον
kjv: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,

vulg: venit Ioseph ab Arimathia nobilis decurio qui et ipse erat expectans regnum Dei et audacter introiit ad Pilatum et petiit corpus Iesu
clem: venit Joseph ab Arimatha nobilis decurio, qui et ipse erat exspectans regnum Dei, et audacter introivit ad Pilatum, et petiit corpus Jesu.
tr: ηλθεν ιωσηφ ο απο αριμαθαιας ευσχημων βουλευτης ος και αυτος ην προσδεχομενος την βασιλειαν του θεου τολμησας εισηλθεν προς πιλατον και ητησατο το σωμα του ιησου
kjv: Joseph of Arimathaea, an honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.

vulg: Pilatus autem mirabatur si iam obisset et accersito centurione interrogavit eum si iam mortuus esset
clem: Pilatus autem mirabatur si jam obiisset. Et accersito centurione, interrogavit eum si jam mortuus esset.
tr: ο δε πιλατος εθαυμασεν ει ηδη τεθνηκεν και προσκαλεσαμενος τον κεντυριωνα επηρωτησεν αυτον ει παλαι απεθανεν
kjv: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.

vulg: et cum cognovisset a centurione donavit corpus Ioseph
clem: Et cum cognovisset a centurione, donavit corpus Joseph.
tr: και γνους απο του κεντυριωνος εδωρησατο το σωμα τω ιωσηφ
kjv: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.

vulg: Ioseph autem mercatus sindonem et deponens eum involvit sindone et posuit eum in monumento quod erat excisum de petra et advolvit lapidem ad ostium monumenti
clem: Joseph autem mercatus sindonem, et deponens eum involvit sindone, et posuit eum in monumento quod erat excisum de petra, et advolvit lapidem ad ostium monumenti.
tr: και αγορασας σινδονα και καθελων αυτον ενειλησεν τη σινδονι και κατεθηκεν αυτον εν μνημειω ο ην λελατομημενον εκ πετρας και προσεκυλισεν λιθον επι την θυραν του μνημειου
kjv: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.

vulg: Maria autem Magdalene et Maria Ioseph aspiciebant ubi poneretur
clem: Maria autem Magdalene et Maria Joseph aspiciebant ubi poneretur.
tr: η δε μαρια η μαγδαληνη και μαρια ιωση εθεωρουν που τιθεται
kjv: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.

vulg: et cum transisset sabbatum Maria Magdalene et Maria Iacobi et Salome emerunt aromata ut venientes unguerent eum
clem: Et cum transisset sabbatum, Maria Magdalene, et Maria Jacobi, et Salome emerunt aromata ut venientes ungerent Jesum.
tr: και διαγενομενου του σαββατου μαρια η μαγδαληνη και μαρια η του ιακωβου και σαλωμη ηγορασαν αρωματα ινα ελθουσαι αλειψωσιν αυτον
kjv: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.

vulg: et valde mane una sabbatorum veniunt ad monumentum orto iam sole
clem: Et valde mane una sabbatorum, veniunt ad monumentum, orto jam sole.
tr: και λιαν πρωι της μιας σαββατων ερχονται επι το μνημειον ανατειλαντος του ηλιου
kjv: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.

vulg: et dicebant ad invicem quis revolvet nobis lapidem ab ostio monumenti
clem: Et dicebant ad invicem: Quis revolvet nobis lapidem ab ostio monumenti?
tr: και ελεγον προς εαυτας τις αποκυλισει ημιν τον λιθον εκ της θυρας του μνημειου
kjv: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?

vulg: et respicientes vident revolutum lapidem erat quippe magnus valde
clem: Et respicientes viderunt revolutum lapidem. Erat quippe magnus valde.
tr: και αναβλεψασαι θεωρουσιν οτι αποκεκυλισται ο λιθος ην γαρ μεγας σφοδρα
kjv: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.

vulg: et introeuntes in monumento viderunt iuvenem sedentem in dextris coopertum stola candida et obstipuerunt
clem: Et intrountes in monumentum viderunt juvenem sedentem in dextris, coopertum stola candida, et obstupuerunt.
tr: και εισελθουσαι εις το μνημειον ειδον νεανισκον καθημενον εν τοις δεξιοις περιβεβλημενον στολην λευκην και εξεθαμβηθησαν
kjv: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.

vulg: qui dicit illis nolite expavescere Iesum quaeritis Nazarenum crucifixum surrexit non est hic ecce locus ubi posuerunt eum
clem: Qui dicit illis: Nolite expavescere: Jesum quritis Nazarenum, crucifixum: surrexit, non est hic, ecce locus ubi posuerunt eum.
tr: ο δε λεγει αυταις μη εκθαμβεισθε ιησουν ζητειτε τον ναζαρηνον τον εσταυρωμενον ηγερθη ουκ εστιν ωδε ιδε ο τοπος οπου εθηκαν αυτον
kjv: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.

vulg: sed ite et dicite discipulis eius et Petro quia praecedit vos in Galilaeam ibi eum videbitis sicut dixit vobis
clem: Sed ite, dicite discipulis ejus, et Petro, quia prcedit vos in Galilam: ibi eum videbitis, sicut dixit vobis.
tr: αλλ υπαγετε ειπατε τοις μαθηταις αυτου και τω πετρω οτι προαγει υμας εις την γαλιλαιαν εκει αυτον οψεσθε καθως ειπεν υμιν
kjv: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.

vulg: at illae exeuntes fugerunt de monumento invaserat enim eas tremor et pavor et nemini quicquam dixerunt timebant enim
clem: At ill exeuntes, fugerunt de monumento: invaserat enim eas tremor et pavor: et nemini quidquam dixerunt: timebant enim.
tr: και εξελθουσαι ταχυ εφυγον απο του μνημειου ειχεν δε αυτας τρομος και εκστασις και ουδενι ουδεν ειπον εφοβουντο γαρ
kjv: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.

vulg: surgens autem mane prima sabbati apparuit primo Mariae Magdalenae de qua eiecerat septem daemonia
clem: Surgens autem mane prima sabbati, apparuit primo Mari Magdalene, de qua ejecerat septem dmonia.
tr: αναστας δε πρωι πρωτη σαββατου εφανη πρωτον μαρια τη μαγδαληνη αφ ης εκβεβληκει επτα δαιμονια
kjv: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.

vulg: illa vadens nuntiavit his qui cum eo fuerant lugentibus et flentibus
clem: Illa vadens nuntiavit his, qui cum eo fuerant, lugentibus et flentibus.
tr: εκεινη πορευθεισα απηγγειλεν τοις μετ αυτου γενομενοις πενθουσιν και κλαιουσιν
kjv: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

vulg: et illi audientes quia viveret et visus esset ab ea non crediderunt
clem: Et illi audientes quia viveret, et visus esset ab ea, non crediderunt.
tr: κακεινοι ακουσαντες οτι ζη και εθεαθη υπ αυτης ηπιστησαν
kjv: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.

vulg: post haec autem duobus ex eis ambulantibus ostensus est in alia effigie euntibus in villam
clem: Post hc autem duobus ex his ambulantibus ostensus est in alia effigie, euntibus in villam:
tr: μετα δε ταυτα δυσιν εξ αυτων περιπατουσιν εφανερωθη εν ετερα μορφη πορευομενοις εις αγρον
kjv: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.

vulg: et illi euntes nuntiaverunt ceteris nec illis crediderunt
clem: et illi euntes nuntiaverunt ceteris: nec illis crediderunt.
tr: κακεινοι απελθοντες απηγγειλαν τοις λοιποις ουδε εκεινοις επιστευσαν
kjv: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.

vulg: novissime recumbentibus illis undecim apparuit et exprobravit incredulitatem illorum et duritiam cordis quia his qui viderant eum resurrexisse non crediderant
clem: Novissime recumbentibus illis undecim apparuit: et exprobravit incredulitatem eorum et duritiam cordis: quia iis, qui viderant eum resurrexisse, non crediderunt.
tr: υστερον ανακειμενοις αυτοις τοις ενδεκα εφανερωθη και ωνειδισεν την απιστιαν αυτων και σκληροκαρδιαν οτι τοις θεασαμενοις αυτον εγηγερμενον ουκ επιστευσαν
kjv: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.

vulg: et dixit eis euntes in mundum universum praedicate evangelium omni creaturae
clem: Et dixit eis: Euntes in mundum universum prdicate Evangelium omni creatur.
tr: και ειπεν αυτοις πορευθεντες εις τον κοσμον απαντα κηρυξατε το ευαγγελιον παση τη κτισει
kjv: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.

vulg: qui crediderit et baptizatus fuerit salvus erit qui vero non crediderit condemnabitur
clem: Qui crediderit, et baptizatus fuerit, salvus erit: qui vero non crediderit, condemnabitur.
tr: ο πιστευσας και βαπτισθεις σωθησεται ο δε απιστησας κατακριθησεται
kjv: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.

vulg: signa autem eos qui crediderint haec sequentur in nomine meo daemonia eicient linguis loquentur novis
clem: Signa autem eos qui crediderint, hc sequentur: in nomine meo dmonia ejicient: linguis loquentur novis:
tr: σημεια δε τοις πιστευσασιν ταυτα παρακολουθησει εν τω ονοματι μου δαιμονια εκβαλουσιν γλωσσαις λαλησουσιν καιναις
kjv: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;

vulg: serpentes tollent et si mortiferum quid biberint non eos nocebit super aegrotos manus inponent et bene habebunt
clem: serpentes tollent: et si mortiferum quid biberint, non eis nocebit: super gros manus imponent, et bene habebunt.
tr: οφεις αρουσιν καν θανασιμον τι πιωσιν ου μη αυτους βλαψει επι αρρωστους χειρας επιθησουσιν και καλως εξουσιν
kjv: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.

vulg: et Dominus quidem postquam locutus est eis adsumptus est in caelum et sedit a dextris Dei
clem: Et Dominus quidem Jesus postquam locutus est eis, assumptus est in clum, et sedet a dextris Dei.
tr: ο μεν ουν κυριος μετα το λαλησαι αυτοις ανεληφθη εις τον ουρανον και εκαθισεν εκ δεξιων του θεου
kjv: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.

vulg: illi autem profecti praedicaverunt ubique Domino cooperante et sermonem confirmante sequentibus signis
clem: Illi autem profecti prdicaverunt ubique, Domino cooperante, et sermonem confirmante, sequentibus signis.
tr: εκεινοι δε εξελθοντες εκηρυξαν πανταχου του κυριου συνεργουντος και τον λογον βεβαιουντος δια των επακολουθουντων σημειων αμην
kjv: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
